0.7 M NaCl で RP・RiBi 遺伝子（rESR）は一過性に抑えられ、: In 0.7 M NaCl, RP and RiBi genes (rESR) are transiently repressed, and this repression is weaker in msn2Δmsn4Δ. Msn2/4 bind the DOT6 promoter to maintain Dot6 and are required for full repression of Dot6 targets and other growth genes (41813847). There is no statement that Msn2/4 increase RP gene expression.

Clusters f and g are enriched in RP genes (42239353).
1,3-β-D-グルカン合成酵素の活性を調節する GTP 結合タンパク質は Rh: The GTP-binding protein that regulates 1,3-β-D-glucan synthase activity is Rho1, which co-purifies and co-immunoprecipitates with Fks1. ADP-ribosylation of Rho1 by C3 abolishes the synthase activity of FKS1 and FKS2 (8662910). Geranylgeranylation of Rho1 is a prerequisite for binding to Fks1 and activation of the synthase (10608882). Consistent with the GO direction (activation).
10 サブユニットのエキソソームは S1/KH キャップ Rrp4/40/Csl: The 10-subunit exosome consists of the S1/KH cap Rrp4/40/Csl4 and others (36861343).
119 のキナーゼから Crz1 をリン酸化するものとして Hrr25 を見つけ: Hrr25 was identified among 119 kinases as one that phosphorylates Crz1. Hrr25 binds Crz1 and phosphorylates it in vitro and in vivo. Hrr25 overexpression blocks Crz1-dependent transcription and Ca2+-induced nuclear accumulation, and loss of Hrr25 enhances calcineurin-mediated Crz1 activation (14597664). BioGRID's 16319894 is a protein-chip-based large-scale screen.
14-3-3 の Bmh1 が Pes4 に結合する。Pes4 は第二分裂での翻: The 14-3-3 protein Bmh1 binds Pes4. Pes4 regulates the timing of translation in meiosis II and is required to maintain meiotic commitment (35240051).
14-3-3 の Bmh1・Bmh2 はリン酸化された Nth1 と複合体をつく: The 14-3-3 proteins Bmh1 and Bmh2 form a complex with phosphorylated Nth1 and increase its activity. Loss of both abolishes trehalase activation and phosphorylation (23155055, 22320399).
14-3-3（Bmh）はリン酸化された Nha1 の S481 に結合し（Bmh: 14-3-3 (Bmh) binds phosphorylated S481 of Nha1 (crystal structure with Bmh1) and orders the Nha1 C-terminus. The S481A mutation greatly increases Nha1-mediated cation efflux. 14-3-3 binding appears essential for inhibiting Nha1 activity (31446061).
18S NRD には uS3 の K212 への Mag2 によるモノユビキチン: 18S NRD requires Mag2-mediated monoubiquitination of uS3 at K212, followed by K63 polyubiquitination by Hel2 and Rsp5 (30893611).
2 つの GID E3 が Gid7 を介して Chelator-GIDSR4: Two GID E3s assemble via Gid7 into Chelator-GIDSR4, bind multiple degrons of tetrameric Fbp1, and ubiquitinate multiple subunits simultaneously (33905682, title and abstract). Full text: adding Gid7 greatly enhances Fbp1 ubiquitination in vitro; in vivo, glucose-induced Fbp1 ubiquitination is impaired by loss of Gid7, and Fbp1 was the only substrate strongly stabilized by Gid7 loss (Mdh2 and Pck1 barely changed).
2 つのシス型プレニル転移酵素は Nus1 と Rer2 または Srt1 のヘ: The two cis-prenyltransferases are heterodimers of Nus1 with Rer2 or Srt1 (28978675).
2 つのチロシンホスファターゼ Ptp2 と Ptp3 は、MAPK の Hog: The two tyrosine phosphatases Ptp2 and Ptp3 inactivate the MAPKs Hog1 and Fus3 with different specificities (introductory statement, 10523653).
2 つの酵母フォスデューシン相同体のうち Plp1 が Gβγ に最もよく結合し: Of the two yeast phosducin homologs, Plp1 binds Gβγ best, and binding is enhanced by pheromone stimulation and GTPγS. PLP1 overexpression reduces pheromone-induced gene induction by 70–80% (10749875).
2 ハイブリッドで Mid2 の細胞質尾部に結合する Zeo1 を同定。ZEO1: Zeo1 was identified by two-hybrid as binding the cytoplasmic tail of Mid2. Disrupting ZEO1 confers CFW resistance and causes constitutive Mid2-dependent phosphorylation of Mpk1. zeo1 deletion suppresses the growth defect of rom2 and worsens sac7Δ; MID2 and ZEO1 have opposite roles (12949174).
2 ハイブリッドで Pcl1 と結合する Ncp1・Hms1・Epa1 を同定。: Ncp1, Hms1, and Epa1 were identified by two-hybrid as binding Pcl1. The Pcl1–Pho85 complex specifically phosphorylates them (15082539).
2 ハイブリッドと試験管内の結合で Clf1p は Mud2p と結合（1044: Clf1p binds Mud2p in two-hybrid and in vitro binding assays (10445879).
2 ハイブリッドと試験管内の結合で Clf1p は U1 snRNP の Prp: Clf1p binds the U1 snRNP protein Prp40p in two-hybrid and in vitro binding assays (10445879).
2% グルコースでは HXT4 は Mig1 だけが抑えるが、10% グルコース: In 2% glucose, HXT4 is repressed only by Mig1, but in 10% glucose Mig2 also contributes to repression (19087243, deletion-strain microarrays).
2,4-D ストレスでの PDR18 の活性化は主に Nrg1 が、より弱く Y: Activation of PDR18 under 2,4-D stress is controlled mainly by Nrg1 and more weakly by Yap1 and Pdr3 (21831043).
2,4-D ストレスでの PDR18 の活性化を Nrg1 が主に、Yap1・P: Activation of PDR18 under 2,4-D stress is controlled mainly by Nrg1 and weakly by Yap1 and Pdr3 (21831043).
25 MPa の高圧で Tat1 が Rsp5 と End3 に依存して分解され: At a high pressure of 25 MPa, Tat1 is degraded in an Rsp5- and End3-dependent manner (23666621). Both Tat1 and Tat2 are degraded at high pressure in an Rsp5-dependent manner (14560004).
25S rRNA ドメイン I の転写後、Noc1/Noc2 がその RNA と: After transcription of 25S rRNA domain I, Noc1/Noc2 bind both that RNA and Rrp5, changing the binding mode of Rrp5 (31217256).
2DG で起こる Hxt1・Hxt3 の輸送（エンドサイトーシスと液胞での分解）: 2DG-induced trafficking of Hxt1 and Hxt3 (endocytosis and vacuolar degradation) requires Rod1 and Rog3, and does not occur with mutants unable to bind Rsp5 (25547292).
3' NHTR では Msh2-Msh3 と Saw1 が Rad1-Rad10: In 3' NHTR, Msh2-Msh3 and Saw1 recruit Rad1-Rad10. Altered interactions impair recruitment and removal (29660012).
4 つのタンパク質の結合を試験管内で確かめ、Rpf2 と Rrs1 が rpL5: Binding of the four proteins was confirmed in vitro, showing that Rpf2 and Rrs1 are required for incorporation of rpL5, rpL11, and 5S rRNA into pre-ribosomes (17938242).
5' スプライス部位での切断には Sen2 の触媒三つ組に加えて Sen34 由: Cleavage at the 5' splice site requires a cation-pi sandwich from Sen34 in addition to the catalytic triad of Sen2 (16710424).
AAA ATPase の SAP1 が SIN1（SPT2）と直接結合する（tw: The AAA ATPase SAP1 binds SIN1 (SPT2) directly (two-hybrid and recombinant proteins) (8654588).
AAC2 の発現には HAP2・HAP3 が必要（HAP1 は不要）。UAS が: AAC2 expression requires HAP2 and HAP3 (HAP1 is not required). The UAS is required for activation by HAP2 and heme (7758459).
AAC2（PET9）の UAS に HAP2/3/4 と ABF1 の結合配列が: The AAC2 (PET9) UAS contains binding sites for HAP2/3/4 and ABF1 and mediates transcriptional regulation by oxygen and carbon source (7758459). The title of 9090846 indicates transcriptional activation of AAC2 by ABF1.
AAC3 の発現の抑制はヘムと ROX1 に依存する（8477727）: Repression of AAC3 expression depends on heme and ROX1 (8477727).
AAD 遺伝子はジアミド・DEME で誘導され、その応答は Yap1 に依存する: AAD genes are induced by diamide and DEME, and this response depends on Yap1. AAD4 and AAD6 respond to oxidative stress (10581269).
AAP1 の多コピーでグリコーゲンの蓄積と SSA3 プロモーターからの転写が増: Multicopy AAP1 increases glycogen accumulation and transcription from the SSA3 promoter (8100228).
ABF1 は QCR8 の抑制・脱抑制時の転写と、異化代謝産物抑制から抜けるとき: ABF1 is required for QCR8 transcription under repressed and derepressed conditions and for induction upon release from catabolite repression (1317009).
ABFI（Abf1）が SPR3 プロモーターの ABFI 配列に結合し、その配: ABFI (Abf1) binds the ABFI site in the SPR3 promoter, and this site is essential for SPR3 expression during sporulation (7590307, 9032242).
AC40（Rpc40）と AC19（Rpc19）はツーハイブリッドで結合し、変異: AC40 (Rpc40) and AC19 (Rpc19) interact in two-hybrid, and the in vivo interaction was also confirmed by mutant suppression (8516295).
ACH1 を欠くと酢酸が細胞質にたまり、Acs2 が過剰に活性化してヒストンのア: Loss of ACH1 causes acetate to accumulate in the cytoplasm, leading to excessive Acs2 activation, histone acetylation, and repression of autophagy genes (24606900).
ACT1 の変異スクリーニングでアクチン上の新しい Aip1 結合部位を同定。A: A mutational screen of ACT1 identified a new Aip1-binding site on actin. Aip1 actively promotes actin filament turnover (17483419).
ADA2 は ADR1 の TAD II に結合する。ada2・gcn5 の欠失: ADA2 binds TAD II of ADR1. Deletion of ada2 or gcn5 impairs ADR1-mediated activation of the ADH2 promoter (8943299).
ADE 遺伝子の活性化には Bas1 と Pho2 が必要で、アデニンに応じて: Activation of ADE genes requires Bas1 and Pho2, and their binding to the ADE5,7 promoter increases in response to adenine (17573544). When adenine is sufficient, ADE genes are repressed (9154826).
ADE 遺伝子の脱抑制には Bas1 と Pho2 が要り、Pho2 は Bas: Derepression of ADE genes requires Bas1 and Pho2; Pho2 comes to the promoter only under derepressing conditions and in a Bas1-dependent manner (16215179).
ADE 遺伝子の脱抑制には Bas1 と Pho2 が要る。ChIP で Bas: Derepression of ADE genes requires Bas1 and Pho2. ChIP shows Bas1 bound to the promoters of ADE4 and others (16215179).
ADE1・ADE2・ADE5,7・ADE8 の発現はアデニンで抑えられ、最大の発: Expression of ADE1, ADE2, ADE5,7, and ADE8 is repressed by adenine, and maximal expression requires both BAS1 and BAS2 (1495962).
ADE2 の最大の発現には Bas1・Bas2・Gcn4 が必要で、Yap1 の: Maximal ADE2 expression requires Bas1, Bas2, and Gcn4; the effect of Yap1 is small (8299166).
ADE3 プロモーターの GCRE に Gcn4・Bas1 が直接結合し、Bas: Gcn4 and Bas1 bind directly to the GCRE in the ADE3 promoter, and Bas1 is required for basal expression (19525417).
ADE3 プロモーターの GCRE に Gcn4・Bas1 が直接結合し、Gcn: Gcn4 and Bas1 bind directly to the GCRE in the ADE3 promoter; Gcn4 is required for basal and induced expression, and Bas1 for basal expression (19525417).
ADE8 などプリン経路の遺伝子の最大の発現には BAS1 と BAS2/PHO: Maximal expression of purine pathway genes such as ADE8 requires both BAS1 and BAS2/PHO2 (1495962).
ADH1 の 2 か所の ABF1 結合部位の欠失・変異で転写が下がり、ABF1: Deletion or mutation of the two ABF1-binding sites in ADH1 reduces transcription, and ABF1 binds both in vitro (7663308).
ADI1 mRNA は Rnt1 による切断で転写後に制御され、Rnt1・Xrn: ADI1 mRNA is post-transcriptionally regulated by Rnt1 cleavage and increases in the absence of Rnt1, Xrn1, or Rat1 (15967792).
ADK1 と ADO1 は PHO5 の発現を負に制御し、PHO81 の上流で働: ADK1 and ADO1 negatively regulate PHO5 expression and appear to act upstream of PHO81 (15695358).
AEP1 は ミトコンドリアの oli1 mRNA の翻訳に必要（8358819: AEP1 is required for translation of the mitochondrial oli1 mRNA (8358819).
AEP2 の変異で成熟型 oli1 mRNA が大きく減る。oli1 の 5'U: AEP2 mutations greatly reduce mature oli1 mRNA. A point mutation in the oli1 5'UTR suppresses aep2-ts1 (10101162).
AFT1 は FET3 ほか FRE1・FRE2・FTR1・FTH1・CCC2: AFT1 binds a consensus sequence in the 5' regions of FET3 as well as FRE1, FRE2, FTR1, FTH1, and CCC2. Under iron deprivation it binds the FET3 promoter and activates transcription (8670839).
AFT1 は FRE1・FRE2・FTR1・FTH1・CCC2 の 5′ 領域の: AFT1 binds a consensus sequence in the 5′ regions of FRE1, FRE2, FTR1, FTH1, and CCC2, which form a regulon under AFT1 control (8670839).
AGP2・AGP3 の転写は低いが、Gap1 か Agp1 を欠く細胞では上がる: AGP2 and AGP3 transcription is low but increases in cells lacking Gap1 or Agp1 (14697254).
AHP1 は過酸化物で Yap1・Skn7 に依存して誘導される（9988687: AHP1 is induced by peroxides in a Yap1- and Skn7-dependent manner (9988687).
ALD2・ALD3 の発現は Msn2・Msn4 に依存し、HOG 経路には依存: ALD2 and ALD3 expression depends on Msn2 and Msn4 and not on the HOG pathway (10407263).
ALT1 と ALT2 はどちらも抑制因子 Nrg1 に負に制御される（2304: ALT1 and ALT2 are both negatively regulated by the repressor Nrg1 (23049841).
ALT1・ALT2 はどちらも Nrg1 に負に制御される。ALT2 はアラニン: ALT1 and ALT2 are both negatively regulated by Nrg1. ALT2 is repressed by alanine (23049841).
ANC2（CCT4）は TCP-1 族の必須遺伝子。anc2-1 でアクチンの構: ANC2 (CCT4) is an essential gene of the TCP-1 family. anc2-1 disrupts actin organization, and Anc2 overexpression alleviates defects caused by actin overproduction (7916461).
ANT1 プロモーターに Pip2-Oaf1 が結合する変則的な ORE があり: The ANT1 promoter has an atypical ORE bound by Pip2-Oaf1 that mediates activation. Oleate induction is weakened in pip2Δ oaf1Δ (12071844).
AP-2 が Mid2 に結合して取り込みと再配置を助ける。apm4Δ で Mi: AP-2 binds Mid2 and aids its internalization and redistribution. Mid2 redistribution does not occur in apm4Δ, and Mid2 binds the μ domain of Apm4 directly (24460703).
AP-3 の核は小・中サブユニットと二つの大サブユニット β3（Apl6）・δ（: The AP-3 core consists of the small and medium subunits and two large subunits, β3 (Apl6) and δ (Apl5) (39330471).
AP-3 変異体では Vtc5 が ESCRT で液胞内腔へ送られ Pep4 で: In AP-3 mutants, Vtc5 is sent to the vacuolar lumen by ESCRT and degraded by Pep4 (34544285).
AP-3 複合体は Vtc5 を液胞膜に局在させるのに要る。本文: aps3Δ: The AP-3 complex is required to localize Vtc5 to the vacuolar membrane. Full text: in aps3Δ, GFP-Vtc5 mislocalizes to the vacuolar lumen (34544285).
APC のリン酸化は分裂期の Cdc28 に依存し、Cdc16・Cdc23・Cd: APC phosphorylation depends on mitotic Cdc28; when the Cdc28 sites in Cdc16, Cdc23, and Cdc27 are mutated together, the APC is not phosphorylated, and its G1 activity is normal but its mitotic Cdc20-dependent activity is impaired. Cdc28 activates the APC to initiate anaphase (10871279). The contributions of individual subunits were not separated.
APC(Cdh1) は G1 の初めに D ボックスを介して転写抑制因子 Nrm: APC(Cdh1) degrades the transcriptional repressors Nrm1 and Yhp1 via their D boxes in early G1, and this degradation coincides with activation of Mcm1 target genes. Non-degradable Yhp1 causes insufficient activation of G1 genes and reduced growth (21562221).
APC(Cdh1) は G1 期の初めに D-box を介して Nrm1 を分解: APC(Cdh1) degrades Nrm1 via its D-box in early G1, coinciding with the onset of transcription of MBF target genes (21562221).
APC-Cdh1 は G1 に Ndd1 をユビキチン化して分解させ、Ndd1: APC-Cdh1 ubiquitinates Ndd1 in G1 for degradation and limits accumulation of the products of Ndd1 target genes. This forms a feed-forward loop that represses through both transcription and degradation (25959309).
APC/C による Spo13 の分解が Spc72 の除去を通してメイオティッ: APC/C-mediated degradation of Spo13 promotes meiotic plaque formation through removal of Spc72 (35023198). Full text: for Spo13 to block Spc72 removal, binding to Cdc5 is required. Both Spo13 and Cdk1-Clb1 are required for Spc72 at the SPB in metaphase I.
APC/C(Cdh1) の基質候補として Ybr138C を同定。N 末端領域が: Ybr138C was identified as a candidate APC/C(Cdh1) substrate. Its N-terminal region is required for its instability (23049888).
APC/C-Cdc20 は Pds1 と S 期サイクリン Clb5 の分解を担: APC/C-Cdc20 mediates degradation of Pds1 and the S-phase cyclin Clb5, and Clb5 degradation is required for Cdc14 to overcome Cdk1 (10647015). Among APC/C-Cdc20 substrates, Clb5 begins to be degraded early in mitosis, which requires its Cdc20-binding ABBA motif (25287299).
APC/C-Cdh1 の活性化が Polo キナーゼ Cdc5 の分解を引き起こ: APC/C-Cdh1 activation triggers degradation of the Polo kinase Cdc5 and promotes the return of Cdc14 to the nucleolus after mitotic exit (18172166).
APC/C-Cdh1 は G1 に細胞周期のタンパク質を標的にする E3。G1: APC/C-Cdh1 is an E3 that targets cell cycle proteins in G1. APC/C-Cdh1-mediated degradation of Clb5 in G1 is accelerated in ubp15Δ, and Ubp15 antagonizes it by deubiquitinating Clb5, allowing timely S-phase entry (25877870). The abstract of 23751495 does not mention Clb5.
APS キナーゼ Met14p は SCF(Skp2) の基質で、skp2 変異: The APS kinase Met14p is a substrate of SCF(Skp2) and is more stable in skp2 mutants than in wild type (20936605).
APT 複合体では Pti1・Swd2・Glc7・Ssu72・Ref2・Syc1: In the APT complex, Pti1, Swd2, Glc7, Ssu72, Ref2, and Syc1 are associated with the CPF subunit Pta1 (12819204).
AQR1 の転写はアミノ酸で数倍誘導され、Gcn4 の負の制御を受けるらしい（1: AQR1 transcription is induced several-fold by amino acids and appears to be negatively regulated by Gcn4 (15590823).
ARB1 は核と細胞質を行き来し、生体内で TIF6・LSG1 などのリボソーム: ARB1 shuttles between the nucleus and cytoplasm and associates in vivo with ribosome biogenesis factors such as TIF6 and LSG1 (16260602).
ARB1 は生体内で TIF6・LSG1 と結合する（16260602）: ARB1 associates with TIF6 and LSG1 in vivo (16260602).
ARD1 と NAT1 は複合体を作り、両方が N 末端アセチル転移酵素の活性に: ARD1 and NAT1 form a complex, and both are required for N-terminal acetyltransferase activity (1600941).
ARE2 の最適な発現には HAP1 が必要。rox1 変異で ARE1・ARE: Optimal ARE2 expression requires HAP1. A rox1 mutation derepresses both ARE1 and ARE2 (11489845).
ARG1・ARG4 は Gcn4 の標的で、ChIP で Gcn4 の結合が見え: ARG1 and ARG4 are Gcn4 targets; ChIP shows Gcn4 binding, and reduced binding impairs transcriptional activation (16314536). ARG1 is activated by amino acid starvation, and Paf1 reduces Gcn4 binding (22252319).
ARG4 は Gcn4 の標的で、ChIP で Gcn4 の結合が見える（163: ARG4 is a Gcn4 target, and ChIP shows Gcn4 binding (16314536).
ARGRIII（Arg82）の破壊で α 型・a 型特異的遺伝子（MFα1・ST: Disruption of ARGRIII (Arg82) strongly reduces transcription of α- and a-specific genes (MFα1, STE2). Mcm1 levels and binding decrease, and Mcm1 overexpression restores them (8043104).
ARO10 は ARO9 と同じく Aro80 による正の転写制御を受ける（10: Like ARO9, ARO10 is positively regulated at the transcriptional level by Aro80 (10207060).
ARO2 はアミノ酸生合成の一般制御を受け、GCN4 が ARO2 プロモーター: ARO2 is subject to general control of amino acid biosynthesis, and GCN4 binds three sites in the ARO2 promoter (1837329).
ARO3 は ABF1 が試験管内で結合する配列を通して活性化され、URS1 を: ARO3 is activated through a sequence bound by ABF1 in vitro and repressed through URS1, independently of GCN4 (7752892).
ARO3 は一般制御で、プロモーターの 1 か所の GCN4 結合部位を通して制: ARO3 is under general control, regulated through a single GCN4-binding site in its promoter (7752892).
ARO4 は一般アミノ酸制御で制御され、プロモーターの GCN4 認識配列 1: ARO4 is regulated by general amino acid control; a single GCN4 recognition sequence in its promoter mediates derepression under amino acid starvation. GCN4 does not contribute to basal transcription (1348717).
ARO80 の変異で ARO9 の芳香族アミノ酸による誘導がなくなり、ARO9: ARO80 mutations abolish aromatic amino acid induction of ARO9, and ARO9 and ARO10 are positively regulated by Aro80 (10207060).
ARO9 の発現は芳香族アミノ酸の存在下と、アンモニア最少培地の aro8 変異: ARO9 expression is induced in the presence of aromatic amino acids and in aro8 mutants on ammonium minimal medium (9491083).
ART ファミリーは PY モチーフで Rsp5 を呼び込み、積荷をユビキチン化: The ART family recruits Rsp5 via PY motifs to ubiquitinate cargo (18976803). Diubiquitination of Art1 enhances substrate-induced recruitment of Rsp5 to the plasma membrane (35770973).
ARV1 の欠失は脂質二重層ストレスを起こして UPR を活性化し、Ire1 依: ARV1 deletion causes lipid bilayer stress, activating the UPR, and the HOG pathway is also activated in an Ire1-dependent manner (38588806).
ASA1→MEC1 と同じ論文。Asa1 は新しく作られた Tel1 の安定化に: Same paper as ASA1→MEC1. Asa1 plays a major role in stabilizing newly synthesized Tel1 (28827813).
ASH1 mRNA はクラス V ミオシン Myo4 によって芽の先端へ運ばれる: ASH1 mRNA is transported to the bud tip by the class V myosin Myo4 (20457760).
ASP3 の完全な転写には Gln3 と Nil1（Gat1）が両方必要。酵素の: Full transcription of ASP3 requires both Gln3 and Nil1 (Gat1). Enzyme formation depends on GLN3 (12489124).
ASP3 の完全な転写には Gln3 と Nil1（Gat1）が両方必要（124: Full transcription of ASP3 requires both Gln3 and Nil1 (Gat1) (12489124).
ATO3 の発現は 2 段階で制御され、GCN4 は発現の大部分に要り、Ssy1: ATO3 expression is regulated in two steps: GCN4 is required for most of the expression, and the Ssy1-Ptr3-Ssy5 system is required for high expression in rho0 (12966084).
ATP 合成酵素の小さなタンパク質の相互作用相手を調べて Mco10 を見つけ、: Screening for interaction partners of small ATP synthase proteins identified Mco10, proposed as an auxiliary subunit that acts only in permeability transition. Full text: Mco10 co-purifies with ATP synthase and is found mainly in monomers (36882574).
ATP 型 Rok1 が Rrp5 の 40S への結合を安定化し、ATP 加水: ATP-bound Rok1 stabilizes Rrp5 binding to the 40S, and ATP hydrolysis releases Rrp5 to act in 60S assembly (27280440).
AUA1 の過剰発現（aua1-1 変異を含む）でアンモニアによる GAP1 の: Overexpression of AUA1 (including the aua1-1 mutation) relieves ammonia-induced inactivation of GAP1 without changing GAP1 transcription (8497191).
AUR1 抑制時に HOG 経路依存で FMP48 が誘導され、過剰発現で RO: Upon AUR1 inhibition, FMP48 is induced in a HOG pathway-dependent manner, and its overexpression reduces ROS accumulation and cell death (42715150).
AUR1 抑制時に HOG 経路依存で誘導される遺伝子として FMP48・UIP: FMP48, UIP4, and MGA1 were identified as genes induced in a HOG pathway-dependent manner upon AUR1 inhibition (42715150).
AVT4 プロモーターの GATA 結合配列の変異で発現が下がり、ChIP で: Mutation of GATA-binding sequences in the AVT4 promoter reduces expression, and ChIP shows Gat1 binding to the AVT4 promoter (33624780).
Aar2 は Prp8 の RNaseH ドメインに、Brr2 は Jab1/M: Aar2 binds the RNaseH domain of Prp8, and Brr2 binds its Jab1/MPN domain (21764848).
Aar2–RNaseH 複合体が Jab1/MPN ドメインを隠して Brr2: The Aar2–RNaseH complex masks the Jab1/MPN domain and prevents Brr2 binding. S253E shifts the balance toward the Brr2–Prp8 complex (21764848).
Aat2 を欠くと eIF2α のリン酸化と GCN4 の活性化が強まり、統合ス: Loss of Aat2 enhances eIF2α phosphorylation and GCN4 activation, causing an abnormally strong integrated stress response. A catalytically inactive Aat2 mutant remains bound to polysomes and is normal (35621265).
Abp1 と Aim3 が組んでアクチン繊維の反矢じり端の伸長を抑える。本文:: Abp1 and Aim3 together inhibit barbed-end elongation of actin filaments. Full text: Abp1 pulls down Aim3, and Aim3 is not seen in actin tails in abp1Δ (23333351).
Abp1 の SH3 を介した結合が Prk1・Ark1 のアクチン皮質パッチへ: SH3-mediated binding by Abp1 is essential for localization of Prk1 and Ark1 to cortical actin patches (11668184).
Ace2 が主に制御する 4 遺伝子（YER124C = DSE1 を含む）の発: Expression of four genes mainly regulated by Ace2 (including YER124C = DSE1) is repressed by Swi5 (11309124).
Ace2 は CTS1・YHR143W（DSE2）・SCW11・YER124C（: Ace2 is the main regulator of CTS1, YHR143W (DSE2), SCW11, and YER124C (DSE1) (11309124).
Ace2 は SCW11 を含む 4 遺伝子の主な制御因子（11309124）: Ace2 is the main regulator of four genes including SCW11 (11309124).
Ace2 は YHR143W（DSE2）を含む 4 遺伝子の主な制御因子（113: Ace2 is the main regulator of four genes including YHR143W (DSE2) (11309124).
Ace2・Swi5 の 34 の標的遺伝子のうち、MCR1 の欠失は静置発酵での: Among 34 Ace2/Swi5 target genes, deletion of MCR1 reduces ethanol yield in static fermentation (26975390) (PMID: 26975390).
Acl1 と Bcl1 は協調して Rpl1 に直接結合し、Acl1-Rpl1-: Acl1 and Bcl1 cooperatively bind Rpl1 directly, forming an Acl1-Rpl1-Bcl1 ternary complex that enables nuclear import of Rpl1 (41909949).
Acm1 は APC-Cdh1 の阻害因子。Acm1 は Cdc28 と Cdc: Acm1 is an inhibitor of APC-Cdh1. Acm1 is a substrate of Cdc28 and Cdc14 (in vivo and in vitro); phosphorylation by Cdc28 stabilizes Acm1 through Bmh1/2 binding, and when Cdc14 is inactivated, Acm1 is neither dephosphorylated nor degraded. Antagonism between Cdc28 and Cdc14 restricts Acm1 to the period from G1/S to the end of mitosis (18287090). BioGRID's 22117071 concerns Cdc14 substrate specificity (Acm1 used for site validation), and 26085509 is a paper on Iqg1.
Acm1 は APC-Cdh1 の阻害因子。Cdc28 のリン酸化部位の変異や: Acm1 is an inhibitor of APC-Cdh1. Mutation of Cdc28 phosphorylation sites or Cdc28 inactivation destabilizes Acm1. Cdc28 promotes 14-3-3 (Bmh1, Bmh2) binding to stabilize Acm1, and Cdc14 acts in the opposite way (18287090).
Acm1 は Cdh1 に結合して阻害する。Acm1 の分解配列が APC-Cd: Acm1 binds and inhibits Cdh1. The Acm1 degradation sequence promotes ubiquitination by APC-Cdc20, and Acm1 disappears in early anaphase. Later, APC-Cdh1 also targets Acm1 for degradation (18498748).
Acm1 は偽基質モチーフなどで Cdh1 に結合して抑える（Cdc20 は抑え: Acm1 binds and inhibits Cdh1 via motifs including a pseudosubstrate motif (it does not inhibit Cdc20) (18498748).
Acm1 は後期の初めに APC(Cdc20) で分解され、分裂期の後半には A: Acm1 is degraded by APC(Cdc20) in early anaphase, and APC(Cdh1) also promotes its degradation in late mitosis (18498748). Acm1 is an inhibitor that binds Cdh1 and blocks substrate binding, and is not itself a substrate (21460798) (PMID: 18498748, 21460798).
Acm1 は擬似基質のモチーフで Cdh1 に結合して阻害し、Cdc20 は阻害: Acm1 binds and inhibits Cdh1 via a pseudosubstrate motif and does not inhibit Cdc20. It is degraded by APC-Cdc20 in early anaphase (18498748). Acm1 appears at the end of G1 and disappears at the end of M phase (17030612). It competes with substrates for binding to Cdh1 (18519589).
Acp1 枯渇でミトコンドリアの FeS タンパク質の形成が落ち、Nfs1 タン: Acp1 depletion reduces formation of mitochondrial FeS proteins and greatly lowers Nfs1 protein levels and/or persulfide-forming activity (39251117).
Acr1（Sko1）は Cyc8-Tup1 を呼ぶこと、および標的部位を Aca: Acr1 (Sko1) represses transcription by recruiting Cyc8-Tup1 and by directly competing with Aca1 and Aca2 for target sites (10825197).
Acr3 のエンドサイトーシスによる分解は Rsp5 が促し、複数のリシンの K: Endocytic degradation of Acr3 is promoted by Rsp5 and requires K63-linked polyubiquitination of multiple lysines (30776335).
Acr3 の分解は Art3/Aly2 と Art4/Rod1 に依存する（30: Acr3 degradation depends on Art3/Aly2 and Art4/Rod1 (30776335).
Acr3 の分解は Rsp5 を呼ぶアレスチン Art3/Aly2 と Art4: Acr3 degradation depends on the Rsp5-recruiting arrestins Art3/Aly2 and Art4/Rod1 (30776335).
Ada2 の中央領域の変異（RLR）で Gcn5 によるヒストンのアセチル化が試: A mutation in the central region of Ada2 (RLR) reduces Gcn5-mediated histone acetylation in vitro to about 40%, and in vivo also reduces acetylation of H2B K16 and H3 K9/K18 (18950642).
Adk1 はクロマチンに結合し Orc3 と物理的に結合する。Adk1 を減らす: Adk1 binds chromatin and physically associates with Orc3. Depleting Adk1 prevents pre-RC assembly (20659900).
Adr1 と Cat8 の二重欠失で脱抑制条件での ADY2 mRNA の蓄積が: Double deletion of Adr1 and Cat8 completely abolishes ADY2 mRNA accumulation under derepressing conditions (22306658).
Adr1p も CYB2 の転写制御に必要と示唆（10972830）: Adr1p is also suggested to be required for transcriptional regulation of CYB2 (10972830).
Ady3 は減数第二分裂の紡錘体のまわりに Don1 と同じリングをつくり、ad: Ady3 forms the same ring as Don1 around the meiosis II spindle, and the Don1 ring is absent in ady3Δ/Δ (11973299).
Ady4 が脂質キナーゼ Mss4 を MOP に呼び込む。MSS4 の過剰発現: Ady4 recruits the lipid kinase Mss4 to the MOP. MSS4 overexpression suppresses the sporulation defect of ady4Δ (36857169).
Aep3 は ATP8-ATP6 mRNA を安定化し、ATP8 の翻訳を特異的: Aep3 stabilizes ATP8-ATP6 mRNA and specifically activates ATP8 translation (28404747).
Afi1 は GTP 型 Arf3 と特異的に結合し、Arf3 の極性のある分布: Afi1 specifically binds GTP-bound Arf3 and is required for the polarized distribution of Arf3. Mutants in the Arf3-binding site fail to maintain the distribution (18397879).
Aft1 と Aft2 が DDL1 を拮抗的に制御。本文: Aft1 は DD: Aft1 and Aft2 antagonistically regulate DDL1. Full text: Aft1 represses DDL1 expression and Aft2 promotes it. ChIP and EMSA show both binding the DDL1 promoter (27402848).
Aft1・Aft2 の両方が共通の FeRE を介して FET3・FIT3 の発: Both Aft1 and Aft2 drive FET3 and FIT3 expression in vivo via a common FeRE (12756250).
Aft1・Aft2 はどちらも変形した FeRE を介して MRS4 を調節し、: Aft1 and Aft2 both regulate MRS4 via a variant FeRE, and Aft2 is the stronger activator from this sequence (12756250). Aft2 directly activates MRS4, but Aft1 does not (16024809).
Aga2 は Aga1 断片とジスルフィド結合の複合体を作ると比活性が 43 倍: The specific activity of Aga2 increases 43-fold when it forms a disulfide-linked complex with an Aga1 fragment (11278672).
Agp2 は DUR3・SAM3 などの輸送体遺伝子の発現を制御し、ポリアミン輸: Agp2 regulates expression of transporter genes such as DUR3 and SAM3 and positively regulates polyamine transport at the transcriptional level (23755272).
Aha1 の NxNNWHW・RKxK モチーフが Hsp90 の ATPase: The NxNNWHW and RKxK motifs of Aha1 mediate stimulation of the Hsp90 ATPase. Full text: the ATPase activity of purified Hsc82 and Hsc82 S25P increases with Aha1 concentration, and Aha1 overexpression rescues the temperature-sensitive growth of a strain carrying only Hsc82 S25P (41123251).
Ahc1 は ADA 複合体（Ada2・Ada3・Gcn5 を含む）の新しいサブ: Ahc1 is a new subunit of the ADA complex (containing Ada2, Ada3, and Gcn5). Its deletion disrupts the integrity of the ADA complex (10490601).
Ahk1 は Hkr1 の細胞質ドメインに結合する足場タンパク質。ahk1Δ で: Ahk1 is a scaffold protein that binds the cytoplasmic domain of Hkr1. In ahk1Δ, Hkr1 inappropriately activates Kss1 (26787842).
Ahp1 はアルキルヒドロペルオキシドの受容体として働き、Cad1 の分子間ジス: Ahp1 acts as an alkyl hydroperoxide receptor and is required for intermolecular disulfide bond formation in Cad1. Cad1-mediated transcriptional activation of HSP82 depends on Ahp1 (20145245).
Aim21 と Tda2 は一緒に反矢じり端の伸長を抑え、Cap1/Cap2 と: Aim21 and Tda2 together inhibit barbed-end elongation and also interact with Cap1/Cap2 (29467252).
Aim21 は SH3 を持つ Bbc1 と Abp1 でパッチに呼び込まれ、T: Aim21 is recruited to patches by the SH3-containing Bbc1 and Abp1 and, with Tda2, inhibits barbed-end elongation (29467252).
Aim24 は MICOS と相互作用し、その完全性に必要。本文: Triton: Aim24 interacts with MICOS and is required for its integrity. Full text: upon solubilization with Triton X-100, Aim24 co-immunoprecipitates with Mic10, and without Aim24, Mic10 dissociates from MICOS (24714493).
Aim29 は GTP 結合型 eEF1A を認識する Zpr1 の補助シャペロ: Aim29 is a co-chaperone of Zpr1 that recognizes GTP-bound eEF1A and helps release eEF1A (37597513).
Aim32 は Osm1・Tim17・Tim23・Tim22 と結合（34461: Aim32 binds Osm1, Tim17, Tim23, and Tim22 (34461091).
Aim44 は Hof1 と共沈降し、欠失で Hof1 のリン酸化の遅れと局在の: Aim44 co-immunoprecipitates with Hof1, and its deletion delays Hof1 phosphorylation and alters its localization. Dbf2 overexpression rescues the cytokinesis defect of aim44 (24451263).
Aip1 のコフィリン結合だけを失う変異体を得た。Aip1–コフィリン界面の変異: A mutant of Aip1 that loses only cofilin binding was obtained. Mutations at the Aip1–cofilin interface yielded hyperactive forms of cof1 and aip1, supporting a ternary complex model (16421248, 17483419).
Aip2/Dld2 は試験管内・生体内で F アクチンと結合し、免疫沈降でアクチ: Aip2/Dld2 binds F-actin in vitro and in vivo and associates with actin by immunoprecipitation (15158445).
Aip5 は N 末端で Spa2、C 末端で Bud6 と結合し、両方で芽の先: Aip5 binds Spa2 via its N terminus and Bud6 via its C terminus, localizes with both to the bud tip and neck, and promotes actin cable formation (31362951).
Aip5 はフォルミン Bni1 と相乗的にアクチン重合を促し、C 末端で G: Aip5 promotes actin polymerization synergistically with the formin Bni1 and binds G-actin and Bni1 via its C terminus (31699995).
Air1 の ZnK4・5 と IWRXY モチーフが Trf4 との相互作用に: The ZnK4/5 and IWRXY motifs of Air1 are required for interaction with Trf4, and the Air1-Trf4 interaction is important for maintaining the TRAMP complex (21878619).
Ait1 は TORC1-Gtr1/2 に結合し、アミノ酸飢餓では SLC38A: Ait1 binds TORC1-Gtr1/2 and, under amino acid starvation, inhibits TORC1 via Gtr1/2 through a loop resembling the RagA/C-binding region of SLC38A9 (36047762). On proline medium, Ait1 and Gcn2 lower TORC1 activity (41318596).
Akl1 は Sla1/Pan1/End3 複合体の Pan1 のリン酸化を促し: Akl1 promotes phosphorylation of Pan1 in the Sla1/Pan1/End3 complex and, like Prk1, attenuates endocytosis (17178891). Inhibition of Akl1 by TORC2-Fpk1 reduces Pan1 phosphorylation (29895620) (17178891;29895620).
Akr1 がないと Cpp1 は分解され、この分解はプロテアソームで Rsp5: Without Akr1, Cpp1 is degraded, and this degradation is proteasomal and Rsp5-dependent (38159851).
Akr2 は Lcb4 に強く結合し、Akr2 を過剰発現すると Lcb4 が液: Akr2 binds Lcb4 strongly, and Akr2 overexpression causes Lcb4 to be transported to the vacuole and degraded (16227572).
Alf1 は α チューブリンとツーハイブリッドと免疫沈降で相互作用。本文: T: Alf1 interacts with α-tubulin by two-hybrid and immunoprecipitation. Full text: it interacts directly with TUB1 by two-hybrid (9885248).
Alg1 を含む複合体の一方が Alg11 を含む（15044395）: One of the Alg1-containing complexes contains Alg11 (15044395).
Alg14 は膜のアンカーとして Alg13 を ER の細胞質側に呼び込む。A: Alg14 acts as a membrane anchor that recruits Alg13 to the cytoplasmic face of the ER. Alg14 is necessary and sufficient for ER localization of Alg13 (16100110).
Alo1 は Myo2 の積荷結合ドメインと断片相補法で結合し、Myo2 をミト: Alo1 binds the cargo-binding domain of Myo2 by fragment complementation, and a role in recruiting Myo2 to mitochondria is proposed (39775849).
Alr1・Alr2 はともに細胞膜にあり、ホモ・ヘテロオリゴマーを作る。野生型: Alr1 and Alr2 are both in the plasma membrane and form homo- and hetero-oligomers. Wild-type Alr2 can dominantly inhibit the activity of wild-type Alr1 (16903865).
Aly1 と Aly2 は AP-1 の γ サブユニット Apl4 と直接結合: Aly1 and Aly2 bind directly to the AP-1 γ subunit Apl4. AP-1 is required for Aly2-dependent trafficking of Gap1 (20739461).
Aly1 and Aly2 bind directly to the AP-1 γ subunit Apl4 (20739461).
Aly1 はカルシニューリンに結合し脱リン酸化される。一部の部位の脱リン酸化は: Aly1 binds calcineurin and is dephosphorylated. Dephosphorylation of some sites is required for Aly1-mediated trafficking of Dip5 to the vacuole but does not affect Rsp5 binding or stability (23824189).
Aly2 は通常時に Git1 の液胞への輸送を促し、GPI を加えると Aly: Aly2 promotes vacuolar trafficking of Git1 under normal conditions, and when GPI is added, either Aly1 or Aly2 promotes it (34562280).
Ama1 は前胞子膜で Ssp2/Smk1 複合体の形成を促し、Smk1 の Y: Ama1 promotes formation of the Ssp2/Smk1 complex at the prospore membrane and activates Smk1 autophosphorylation at Y209 (29118076). Ama1, a meiosis-specific APC/C activator, promotes Smk1 activation during meiosis. A weak CDC28 allele suppresses the sporulation defect of ama1Δ and increases the activation state of Smk1 (16079231).
Ams1 は液胞で Pep4 依存のプロセシングにより翻訳後に活性化される（26: Ams1 is post-translationally activated in the vacuole by Pep4-dependent processing (26947009).
Any1 は Neo1 と共免疫沈降し、不活性化変異 D84G で結合が失われる: Any1 co-immunoprecipitates with Neo1, and binding is lost with the inactivating mutation D84G. any1Δ allows neo1Δ to survive (30824614).
Apc1 が足場となり、Apc2（カリン）・Apc11（RING）・Doc1/A: Apc1 serves as a scaffold, binding both a subcomplex of Apc2 (cullin), Apc11 (RING), and Doc1/Apc10 and a subcomplex of the three TPR subunits (16481473).
Apc4・Apc5・Cdc23・Apc1 は相互依存的に会合し、1 つを欠くと残: Apc4, Apc5, Cdc23, and Apc1 associate interdependently; loss of one greatly reduces the binding of the other three (16481473).
Ape4 は第 3 の Cvt カーゴ。Atg19 の Ape1・Ams1 とは: Ape4 is a third Cvt cargo. It binds Atg19 at a site distinct from those for Ape1 and Ams1 and piggybacks on the Ape1 transport system to the vacuole (21343297).
Apg13（ATG13）は Apg1（ATG1）に結合して活性化する。この結合は: Apg13 (ATG13) binds and activates Apg1 (ATG1). This binding is required for autophagy (but not for the Cvt pathway).
Apg17 は two-hybrid で Apg1 と結合し、apg17Δ では: Apg17 binds Apg1 by two-hybrid, and in apg17Δ rapamycin-induced activation of Apg1 drops to about 20% of wild type (10995454).
Apm1p はクラスリンと同じ小胞の画分に分かれ、CHC1 欠失株では小胞との結: Apm1p fractionates with the same vesicles as clathrin, and its association with vesicles is lost in CHC1 deletion strains (7749194).
Arc1 は MetRS（MES1）と GluRS に結合し、tRNA 結合因子: Arc1 binds MetRS (MES1) and GluRS and acts as a tRNA-binding factor (15184019).
Arc15 は Arp2 と Arc40 が Arp2/3 複合体に結合するのに: Arc15 is required for Arp2 and Arc40 to associate with the Arp2/3 complex (10377407).
Arc15p は Arp2p と Arc40p の複合体への結びつきに必要（ほか: Arc15p is required for association of Arp2p and Arc40p with the complex (but not of other subunits) (10377407).
Arc1p が結合していない GluRS はアミノアシル化が 10 倍低い。Ar: GluRS without bound Arc1p has 10-fold lower aminoacylation. Arc1p binding increases tRNA affinity 100-fold (15667228).
Arc1p のビオチン化は Bpl1p が担い、部位は K86。ビオチン化のない: Biotinylation of Arc1p is carried out by Bpl1p at K86. Non-biotinylated Arc1p is also functional (15272000).
Arc35 と Cmd1 は結合し、Arc35 はカルモジュリンの細胞表層への局: Arc35 and Cmd1 bind, and Arc35 is required for localization of calmodulin to the cell cortex (10749918).
Arf1 の活性化因子 Gea2 の Sec7 領域の上流の変異で順行輸送が止ま: Mutations upstream of the Sec7 region of the Arf1 activator Gea2 block anterograde transport. Brefeldin A binds Gea2 and blocks Arf1 activation (15930122).
Arf1 は Pik1-Frq1 PI4K 複合体を直接呼び込んでゴルジでの P: Arf1 directly recruits the Pik1-Frq1 PI4K complex to tightly control PI4P production at the Golgi (33788598). Full text: Sec7-dependent Arf1 activation recruits Pik1 to the late Golgi/TGN.
Arf1・Arf2 の試験管内の GTPase 活性は Gcs1 で促される（9: The in vitro GTPase activity of Arf1 and Arf2 is stimulated by Gcs1 (9927415).
ArgRII（Arg81）は ArgRI（Arg80）・Mcm1・アルギニンと相: ArgRII (Arg81) interacts with ArgRI (Arg80), Mcm1, and arginine to form the ArgR-Mcm1-DNA complex and serves as the arginine sensor (10688655). ArgRI and ArgRII bind by two-hybrid (10632874).
Ark1 は Sla2 に結合する蛋白質として見つかった。Ark1・Prk1 は: Ark1 was found as a protein that binds Sla2. Ark1 and Prk1 localize to actin patches (10087264).
Arl1 が Drs2 に結合して活性化し、Arl1-Drs2-Gea2 の結合: Arl1 binds and activates Drs2, and Arl1-Drs2-Gea2 binding is essential for flippase activity (23345439).
Arl3 のゴルジ体への局在には NatC による N 末端アセチル化とゴルジ体: Localization of Arl3 to the Golgi requires NatC-mediated N-terminal acetylation and the Golgi membrane protein Sys1 (15077114).
Arn1 の液胞の内腔への輸送は Rsp5 によるユビキチン化に依存し、ユビキチ: Transport of Arn1 to the vacuolar lumen depends on Rsp5-mediated ubiquitination; without ubiquitination, Arn1 stays at the plasma membrane and is functional for transport (17344478).
Arn1p-4p は鉄欠乏で発現し、Aft1 に制御される。Arn2 は TAF: Arn1p–4p are expressed under iron deprivation and are regulated by Aft1. Arn2 mediates TAFC uptake (10748025).
Arp10 は Arp1 ほかのダイナクチンのサブユニットと結合する（16291: Arp10 binds Arp1 and other dynactin subunits (16291862).
Arp1p のアラニン置換で、Jnm1p と Nip100p との結合に必要な: Alanine substitutions in Arp1p revealed a unique Arp1p surface required for binding Jnm1p and Nip100p (15975903).
Arp3 側・Arp2-ARPC1 側の Las17 結合部位の変異で Las1: Mutations in the Las17-binding sites on the Arp3 side and the Arp2-ARPC1 side reduce Las17 binding and activation and cause endocytosis defects (38367669).
Arp4 を枯渇させると SWR1 複合体への Bdf1・Yaf9・Swc4 の: Arp4 depletion greatly impairs binding of Bdf1, Yaf9, and Swc4 to the SWR1 complex (19088068).
Arp5 と Ies6 は生体内で豊富な独立のサブ複合体を作り、試験管内で IN: Arp5 and Ies6 form an abundant independent subcomplex in vivo and enhance INO80 function in vitro. Expression of glycolytic genes is reduced in arp5Δ, ies6Δ, and ino80Δ (26755556).
Arp6 を欠くと GAL1 の活性化と核周辺への局在がともに下がる（20419: Loss of Arp6 reduces both GAL1 activation and its perinuclear localization (20419146).
Arr4（GET3）は G タンパク質に直接結合し、グアニンヌクレオチドの交換を: Arr4 (GET3) is a GEF that binds G proteins directly, accelerates guanine nucleotide exchange, and stabilizes the nucleotide-free state of the α subunit. Arr4 enhances G protein-dependent responses such as MAPK phosphorylation, new gene transcription, and mating (18261907).
Art1・Art4・Art5 は Rsp5 による K63 型のジユビキチン化を: Art1, Art4, and Art5 undergo Rsp5-mediated K63-linked diubiquitination. This modification enhances substrate-induced recruitment of Rsp5 to the plasma membrane by Art1 and is required for cargo ubiquitination (35770973).
Art2 は基質・ストレスで誘導される Thi7・Nrt1・Thi72 のユビキ: Art2 is the main regulator of substrate- and stress-induced ubiquitination and endocytosis of Thi7, Nrt1, and Thi72 (31658248).
Art5 はイノシトールで起こる Itr1 の取り込みに必要な唯一のアレスチン（: Art5 is the only arrestin required for inositol-induced internalization of Itr1 (19912579, full text).
Asa1 は Tel2 と同じく新しく作られた Mec1 と Tel1 の安定化: Like Tel2, Asa1 plays a major role in stabilizing newly synthesized Mec1 and Tel1, and Pih1 contributes to stability at high temperature. Asa1 and Pih1 are required for DNA damage checkpoint signaling (28827813).
Asc1 はアデニル酸シクラーゼ Cyr1 に結合し、グルコース刺激での cAM: Asc1 binds the adenylate cyclase Cyr1 and reduces glucose-stimulated cAMP production (17591772).
Ase1 とセパラーゼ-Slk19 が紡錘体中央部をつくる。分裂後期の始めに C: Ase1 and separase-Slk19 build the spindle midzone. Dephosphorylation of Ase1 by Cdc14 at anaphase onset is important for midzone formation; without dephosphorylation, midzone proteins become dispersed and late anaphase B is delayed (17562791).
Asf1 は SNZ1/SNO1 の発現に必須。Rpd3 は発現の時期に必要（1: Asf1 is essential for SNZ1/SNO1 expression. Rpd3 is required for the timing of expression (18408055).
Asg1 は β 酸化（POX1 など）の遺伝子の完全な活性化に要り、そのプロモ: Asg1 is required for full activation of β-oxidation genes (such as POX1) and binds their promoters (26875874).
Asg1 は糖新生の PCK1 の完全な活性化に要り、糖新生の遺伝子のプロモータ: Asg1 is required for full activation of the gluconeogenic gene PCK1 and binds the promoters of gluconeogenic genes (26875874).
Asg7 は G タンパク質 β サブユニット（Ste4）からの信号を止め、その: Asg7 shuts off signaling from the G protein β subunit (Ste4) and alters its localization (11073983). Asg7, together with the a-factor receptor Ste3, inhibits Gβγ signaling (13680367).
Ash1 は活性のある Cdc28 と結合し、Cdc28 に依存して SCF-C: Ash1 binds active Cdc28 and, in a Cdc28-dependent manner, is recognized by SCF-Cdc4 for ubiquitination and degradation. Mutation of the CDK site T290 delays degradation and reduces mating-type switching (21098119). BioGRID's 12695666 is a paper on the DASH subunit Ask1, not Ash1.
Asi1/Asi2/Asi3 のユビキチンリガーゼ複合体は、核内膜に紛れ込んだ: The Asi1/Asi2/Asi3 ubiquitin ligase complex removes ER membrane proteins that have strayed into the inner nuclear membrane. Unassembled single proteins and complex subunits enter the inner nuclear membrane and are degraded by Asi; Asi2 binds their transmembrane segments directly, and Asi1/Asi3 ubiquitinate them and extract them from the membrane (31679820). Full text: Erg11 is constitutively degraded in an Asi-dependent manner.
Asi1・Asi2・Asi3 のどれかを欠く細胞では、切断されていない全長の S: In cells lacking any of Asi1, Asi2, or Asi3, uncleaved full-length Stp1 and Stp2 constitutively induce SPS target genes. Asi maintains the repressed state in the absence of an inducing signal (17085444).

In cells lacking any of Asi1, Asi2, or Asi3, uncleaved full-length Stp1 and Stp2 constitutively induce SPS target genes. Asi maintains the repressed state in the absence of an inducing signal (17085444). The RI motif of Stp1 acts as both a cytoplasmic retention signal and a signal for Asi-dependent nuclear degradation (25253722).
Asi2 は基質の膜貫通部分に直接結合し、Asi1/Asi3 によるユビキチン化: Asi2 binds substrate transmembrane segments directly and directs them to ubiquitination and membrane extraction by Asi1/Asi3 (31679820). Full text: Asi2Δ4, which enters the Asi complex but lacks the substrate-binding site, cannot promote degradation of the Asi substrate Erg11.
Asn1 と Asn2 は栄養制限で共に繊維を作り、Asn2 の繊維化は Asn: Asn1 and Asn2 form filaments together under nutrient limitation, and Asn2 filament formation depends on Asn1 (30670751).
Asn1 の最初の 35 アミノ酸の翻訳が Tma108 の呼び込みに必要十分。: Translation of the first 35 amino acids of Asn1 is necessary and sufficient for recruitment of Tma108. Tma108 binds the nascent chain directly (27580715).
Ast1p は Pma1p と直接結合し SDS/Triton 不溶の多量体にま: Ast1p binds Pma1p directly and assembles it into SDS/Triton-insoluble oligomers. Multicopy AST1 restores surface delivery and raft association of Pma1-7 (11739806). Multicopy AST1 redirects mutant ATPase from the vacuole to the cell surface (7822420).
Atg1 による Atg13 のリン酸化で Atg1 複合体が解離し（34798: Phosphorylation of Atg13 by Atg1 dissociates the Atg1 complex (34798055), and during prolonged starvation, rephosphorylation of Atg13 by Atg1 terminates autophagy (33536246).
Atg1 にリン酸化された Atg9 は Atg8 と Atg18 を PAS: Atg9 phosphorylated by Atg1 is required for efficient recruitment of Atg8 and Atg18 to the PAS and for expansion of the isolation membrane (24440502). Full text: non-phosphorylatable Atg9 mutants cannot bind Atg18 and fail to recruit it to the PAS.

Atg9 phosphorylated by Atg1 is required for efficient recruitment of Atg8 and Atg18 to the PAS (24440502). Full text: in atg9Δ and phosphorylation-site mutants, Atg8 puncta do not form. Atg5-Atg12 conjugation and Atg8 lipidation are normal.
Atg1 のリン酸化は Atg4 の働きを抑え、オートファゴソームができる場所で: Phosphorylation by Atg1 inhibits Atg4 function and prevents Atg8-PE from being cleaved at sites of autophagosome formation (28821724).
Atg1 は Atg11 の CC4 ドメインの S949・S1057・S106: Atg1 phosphorylates S949, S1057, and S1064 in the CC4 domain of Atg11 (in vitro kinase assays and mutants). Changing all three to A suppresses selective autophagy, and Atg11 cannot bind receptors (35427192). Under phosphate starvation, Pho81 promotes Atg1-mediated phosphorylation of Atg11 and is required for pexophagy (38316984).
Atg1 は Ykt6 を直接リン酸化して不活性に保ち、液胞の SNARE との: Atg1 directly phosphorylates Ykt6 to keep it inactive, preventing its assembly with vacuolar SNAREs and premature fusion (33274589). Ykt6 on autophagosomes is inhibited by phosphorylation by the Atg1 complex and enters fusion upon dephosphorylation (33025734).
Atg11 は Atg9 に結合し、選択的オートファジーで Atg9 の PAS: Atg11 binds Atg9 and mediates Atg9 cycling to the PAS in selective autophagy. Localization of Atg11 to the PAS requires the actin cytoskeleton (17178909). Atg11-Atg9 binding is essential for delivery of prApe1 to the vacuole (17192412).
Atg11 は Ypt1 の下流のエフェクターで、Ypt1-Atg11 の結合が: Atg11 is a downstream effector of Ypt1, and Ypt1-Atg11 binding is required for PAS formation under normal growth. Trs85, Ypt1, and Atg11 together regulate selective autophagy (22509044).
Atg12 は E1 の Atg7 に活性化されたのち Atg10 の C133: Atg12 is activated by the E1 Atg7 and then transferred to C133 of Atg10 as a thioester. In Atg10 C133S, Atg12-Atg5 is not formed, and autophagy and the Cvt pathway are defective (10508157).
Atg12 依存で PAS に来た Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 は Atg: Atg12-Atg5-Atg16, brought to the PAS in an Atg12-dependent manner, helps assemble the PAS scaffold in addition to Atg8 lipidation. Full text: ATG12 deletion or deletion of the Atg12 N terminus reduces Atg17-GFP puncta (30810528).
Atg12-Atg5 結合体は Atg3 の活性を高めて Atg8 の PE へ: The Atg12-Atg5 conjugate is an E3-like enzyme that increases Atg3 activity and strongly promotes transfer of Atg8 to PE (17986448, in vitro reconstitution). PE conjugation (lipidation) of Atg8 produces the functional form of Atg8 and is essential for autophagic membrane dynamics (11100732). Direct in vivo confirmation is not in the abstract, so confidence is medium.
Atg12-Atg5 結合体は新しい型の E3 で、E2 の Atg3 の触媒シ: The Atg12-Atg5 conjugate is a new type of E3 that reorients the catalytic cysteine of the E2 Atg3 to enhance Atg8 lipidation activity (23503366).
Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 は Atg21-PI3P を介する経路に加え、: Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 is recruited to the PAS by binding of Atg12 to the Atg1 complex, in addition to the Atg21-PI3P-mediated route. Loss of both completely abolishes PAS localization and autophagy (30810528). Full text: Atg12 binds Atg17 (two-hybrid, immunoprecipitation).
Atg13 の HORMA ドメインは Atg9 に結合する。Atg9 に結合で: The HORMA domain of Atg13 binds Atg9. HORMA mutants unable to bind Atg9 impair PAS localization of Atg9 vesicles and strongly impair starvation-induced autophagy (25737544).
Atg13 の N 末端 HORMA ドメインはオートファジーと Atg14 の: The N-terminal HORMA domain of Atg13 is required for autophagy and for recruitment of Atg14. Mutation of a conserved Arg blocks autophagy and Atg14 recruitment (23509291, 23670046).
Atg17・Atg29・Atg31 は常に三者複合体を作り、リン酸化された At: Atg17, Atg29, and Atg31 constitutively form a ternary complex containing phosphorylated Atg31. Reconstitution in E. coli gives an equimolar complex (19755117).
Atg18 は AIM で Atg8・Atg16 に弱く結合し、AIM を壊すと: Atg18 binds Atg8 and Atg16 weakly via its AIM, and disrupting the AIM reduces autophagosome formation. Atg18 aids recruitment of Atg8 to autophagosomes and Atg4-mediated cleavage of Atg8 (40956874).
Atg18-Atg8 は Atg3 で解離し、自由になった Atg18 が At: Atg18-Atg8 is dissociated by Atg3, and the freed Atg18 recruits Atg16 to autophagosomes in preparation for Atg8 lipidation (40956874).
Atg18・Atg21 の局在には Vps34 の活性が要る（15155809）: Localization of Atg18 and Atg21 requires Vps34 activity (15155809). PI3P binding by Atg18 directs the Atg18-Atg2 complex to autophagic membranes and is required for full activity (18586673).
Localization of Atg18 and Atg21 requires Vps34 activity (15155809). Vps21 regulates the upstream part of the PI3K-PI3P-Atg21-Atg16 sequence of actions (36076954).
Atg2 の C 末端と Atg1 複合体の Atg29 が結合し、この結合は: The Atg2 C terminus binds Atg29 of the Atg1 complex, and this binding is enhanced by Atg1-mediated phosphorylation of Atg29. This binding and PI3P binding by Atg18 promote PAS localization of Atg2-Atg18 (41563375).
Atg2 の C 末端の両親媒性ヘリックスが膜に結合し、Atg18 の PI3P: An amphipathic helix at the Atg2 C terminus binds membranes and aids PI3P binding by Atg18, directing the Atg2-Atg18 complex to the PAS (30254161). Atg2 bound to Atg9 concentrates at the edge of the isolation membrane, where Atg18 subsequently binds (29848619).
Atg2 は FFAT モチーフで ER の Scs2 に結合し、Atg1 がそ: Atg2 binds ER Scs2 via its FFAT motif, and phosphorylation of this motif by Atg1 strengthens binding. This binding determines Atg2 association with the ER and the onset of lipid supply (42525508). The abstracts of 24440502 and 34798055 cited by BioGRID do not describe any effect of Atg2 phosphorylation.
Atg2 は脂質結合で Atg9 とは独立にオートファゴソーム膜に付くが、Atg: Atg2 attaches to autophagosomal membranes through lipid binding independently of Atg9, but binding to Atg9 is required for its concentration at the edge of the isolation membrane and subsequent binding of Atg18. Disrupting Atg2-Atg9 binding strongly impairs autophagy (29848619).
Atg21 は 2 か所で PAS の PI3P に結合し、Atg8 と Atg: Atg21 binds PI3P at the PAS at two sites and recruits and positions Atg8 and Atg16 (part of the E3-like complex Atg12-Atg5-Atg16) (27560294).
Atg21 は Cvt 経路に必要で窒素飢餓のオートファジーには不要。Atg21: Atg21 is required for the Cvt pathway but not for nitrogen-starvation autophagy. Without Atg21, Atg8 disappears from the PAS and its conjugation to PE is slowed (15155809). Atg21 binds the PAS via PI3P and binds Atg16 and Atg8 directly, determining the site of lipidation (25691244).
Atg21 はレトロマーの積荷選択複合体（Pep8/Vps26・Vps29・Vp: Atg21 binds the retromer cargo-selection complex (Pep8/Vps26, Vps29, Vps35), and the Atg21-retromer complex has vacuolar fission activity (42135947).
Atg38 は N 末端で Atg14 と Vps34 に結合する（241659: Atg38 binds Atg14 and Vps34 via its N terminus (24165940).
Atg38 は複合体 I の安定なサブユニットで、N 末端で Atg14 と V: Atg38 is a stable subunit of complex I and binds Atg14 and Vps34 via its N terminus. In atg38Δ, complex I splits into two subcomplexes (24165940).
Atg40 は Atg8 に結合して ER の断片をオートファゴソームへ取り込ま: Atg40 binds Atg8 to incorporate ER fragments into autophagosomes and assembles through multivalent interactions with Atg8 (32620754).
Atg41 は Atg9 と相互作用し、局在も似る（26565778）: Atg41 interacts with Atg9 and has a similar localization (26565778).
Atg44 は Dnm1 によるミトコンドリアの分裂を完了させるのに必要（388: Atg44 is required to complete Dnm1-mediated mitochondrial fission (38818923).
Atg4（Apg4）は新しく作られた Atg8 の C 末端の Arg を切って: Atg4 (Apg4) cleaves the C-terminal Arg of newly synthesized Atg8 to expose Gly, which is required for conjugation to PE (membrane attachment). Atg4 also removes Atg8 from Atg8-PE (11038174). Deconjugation of Atg8-PE is also required for Atg8 supply and autophagosome maturation (22652539). BioGRID's 18971623 and 25483965 do not describe the cleavage activity in their abstracts.
Atg8 の PAS への局在には Atg8-PE と Atg12-Atg5 の: Localization of Atg8 to the PAS requires formation of Atg8-PE and Atg12-Atg5, and Vps30, Atg14, Atg9, and Atg16 are also required for PAS localization of Atg5 and Atg8 (11689437).
Atg8 は E1 の Apg7（Atg7）に活性化され、E2 の Apg3（A: Atg8 is activated by the E1 Apg7 (Atg7), transferred to the E2 Apg3 (Atg3), and conjugated to phosphatidylethanolamine. This reaction is required for Atg8-PE formation (11100732).
Atg9 は Atg1 の直接の基質で、リン酸化された Atg9 は Atg8・: Atg9 is a direct substrate of Atg1, and phosphorylated Atg9 is required for assembly of Atg8 and Atg18 and for expansion of the isolation membrane (24440502).
Atg9 小胞の主な成分は Atg9 と Atg27 で、Trs85 と Ypt: The main components of Atg9 vesicles are Atg9 and Atg27, and they also contain Trs85 and Ypt1. Trs85 binds Atg9 directly, and Trs85 and Ypt1 localize to the PAS in an Atg9-dependent manner (23129774).
Atg9・Atg23・Atg27 は共局在し、生体内で互いに結合して機能的な複合: Atg9, Atg23, and Atg27 colocalize and bind one another in vivo to form a functional complex (17426440).
Atm1 を減らした細胞では Aft2 が Aft1 より遅れて活性化する（15: In cells with reduced Atm1, Aft2 is activated later than Aft1 (15649888).
Atm1 を減らした細胞では鉄レギュロンが誘導され、その発現の大部分は Aft1: In cells with reduced Atm1, the iron regulon is induced, and most of this expression is due to Aft1. Maturation of cytosolic Fe-S proteins (Nar1, Cfd1, Nbp35) is not involved (15649888).
Atp1 を欠くミトコンドリアでは F1 β サブユニット前駆体が輸送途中で溜ま: In mitochondria lacking Atp1, the F1 β subunit precursor accumulates in transit and its import is delayed (1386080).
Atp14 を 3% 未満に減らしたミトコンドリアでは Atp6 の量が 6%: In mitochondria with Atp14 reduced to less than 3%, Atp6 levels are below 6%, mainly due to decreased translation. ATP synthase assembly and stability are impaired (18252710).
Atp22 は ATP6（ATPase サブユニット 6）の翻訳に必須で、ATP: Atp22 is essential for translation of ATP6 (ATPase subunit 6), via interaction with the 5'-UTR of ATP6 mRNA (17110482).
Atp23 と Atp10 は野生型で結合し、ATP 合成酵素の組み立てを協調し: Atp23 and Atp10 bind in wild type and cooperatively regulate ATP synthase assembly (33956347).
Atp6 は Atp10 と架橋され、この結合は Atp6 の ATPase 部: Atp6 is crosslinked to Atp10, and this binding is required for incorporation of Atp6 into the ATPase subcomplex (14998992).
Atx1p は銅を Ctr1p から Ccc2p・Fet3p へ運ぶ。ATX1: Atx1p delivers copper from Ctr1p to Ccc2p and Fet3p. ATX1 is induced by the iron-sensing transcriptional activator Aft1p (9083054).
Avo1 は Ypk2 に直接結合し（試験管内）、avo3(ts) で減った T: Avo1 binds Ypk2 directly (in vitro), and the TORC2-Ypk2 binding reduced in avo3(ts) is restored by AVO1 overexpression. Overexpressing a Ypk2 fragment containing the binding site abolishes TORC2-mediated phosphorylation of Ypk2 (mobility shift) and disrupts the cell wall and actin (22207764).
Axl2 は Bud3 と GTP 型 Cdc42 に結合し、セプチンの Cdc: Axl2 binds Bud3 and GTP-bound Cdc42, and also binds the septin Cdc10, promoting efficient septin assembly near the division site. In cdc42 mutants defective in axial budding, binding to Axl2 is reduced and G1 septin assembly is impaired.
Azf1 は CLN3 の A2GA5 配列に試験管内・生体内で結合し、AZF1: Azf1 binds the A2GA5 sequence of CLN3 in vitro and in vivo, and AZF1 deletion greatly reduces glucose-induced CLN3 induction (11839825).
B 型 CDK は Orc2・Orc6 をリン酸化し、Cdt1/Mcm2-7 の: B-type CDKs phosphorylate Orc2 and Orc6, preventing recruitment of Cdt1/Mcm2-7 and helicase loading. Orc6 phosphorylation accounts for most of the inhibition (21289063). B-type CDKs prevent re-replication by overlapping mechanisms: ORC phosphorylation, Cdc6 inhibition, and nuclear exclusion of Mcm2-7 (11429609).

B-type CDKs phosphorylate Orc2 and Orc6, preventing recruitment of Cdt1/Mcm2-7 and helicase loading. Orc6 phosphorylation accounts for most of the inhibition (21289063). B-type CDKs prevent re-replication by overlapping mechanisms: ORC phosphorylation, Cdc6 inhibition, and nuclear exclusion of Mcm2-7 (11429609). Orc2 phosphorylation is part of ORC inhibition.
BAP3 は培地のアミノ酸で誘導され、その誘導は UAS(aa) を介し Stp: BAP3 is induced by amino acids in the medium, and this induction is mediated by UAS(aa) and depends on Stp1 (10648791).
BAT1 の発現は α-IPM 結合型の Leu3 による転写の活性化で決まる（: BAT1 expression is determined by transcriptional activation by α-IPM-bound Leu3 (28912343).
BCK1 の優性変異が pkc1 欠失を抑圧する（遺伝学的）。変異は PKC の: Dominant BCK1 mutations suppress pkc1 deletion (genetic). The mutations lie near candidate PKC phosphorylation sites. Direct phosphorylation was not shown.
BCK2 過剰発現が cbk1 変異での Rlm1 活性を一部回復し、Bck2: BCK2 overexpression partially restores Rlm1 activity in cbk1 mutants, and Bck2 acts downstream of Cbk1 (22031291).
BCY1 は cAMP 依存キナーゼの調節サブユニットで、破壊株では cAMP: BCY1 is the regulatory subunit of cAMP-dependent kinase, and disruption strains lose cAMP dependence. Tpk1 is inhibited by binding Bcy1.

BET5 の高コピーで bet3-1 の増殖欠損が抑えられ、Bet3p と Be: High-copy BET5 suppresses the growth defect of bet3-1, and Bet3p and Bet5p are in the same complex (9611195).
BIN2・BIN3（CCT2）の変異で微小管とアクチンの重合が生体内で損なわれる: Mutations in BIN2 and BIN3 (CCT2) impair microtubule and actin polymerization in vivo. Bin2 and Bin3 are components of the cytosolic chaperonin (7916460).
BIO5 プロモーターにも VHRE があり、vhr1 欠失株は低ビオチンで B: The BIO5 promoter also has a VHRE, and vhr1 deletion strains cannot induce BIO5 under low biotin (16533810).
BNA1 は SIR2 によって抑えられる（発現の網羅解析、11095743）: BNA1 is repressed by SIR2 (genome-wide expression analysis, 11095743).
BTN2 欠損で Yif1 のゴルジへの回収が止まり液胞へ運ばれる（171017: Loss of BTN2 blocks retrieval of Yif1 to the Golgi, and it is transported to the vacuole (17101785).
BTN3 は Btn2 と結合する負の調節因子。Btn3 と Snc1 が Bt: BTN3 is a negative regulator that binds Btn2. Btn3 and Snc1 compete for the same binding site on Btn2, determining Btn2 localization and function (21441304).
BTS1 はゲラニルゲラニル二リン酸合成酵素で、細胞内のその量を増やして bet: BTS1 is a geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase and is thought to suppress the bet2-1 mutation by increasing its intracellular levels (7665600).
BUD5 は野生型 RSR1 の cdc24 に対する多コピー抑圧に要るが、活性: BUD5 is required for multicopy suppression of cdc24 by wild-type RSR1 but not by activated rsr1val12, showing that Bud5 acts in vivo as a GDP dissociation-promoting factor for Rsr1 (8234337). Self-association of Rsr1 and its localization to the bud neck and the next division site depend on Bud5 (20587777).
BYE1 欠失でガラクトースによる GAL 遺伝子の誘導が弱まる。本文: GAL: BYE1 deletion weakens galactose induction of GAL genes. Full text: GAL10 mRNA and Pol II occupancy decrease (25029256).
Bas1 は ADE17-lacZ などの発現を活性化し、試験管内でプロモーター: Bas1 activates expression of ADE17-lacZ and others and binds the promoters in vitro. H34L and W42A mutants cannot activate ADE17 (9705508).
Bbp1 は Cdc5 のポロボックスと結合し、Cdc5 の SPB への局在に: Bbp1 binds the polo box of Cdc5 and is required for Cdc5 localization to the SPB (Mps2 is not required) (14767068).
Bbp1 は核膜タンパク質 Mps2 と安定な複合体を作り、SPB の複製（複製: Bbp1 forms a stable complex with the nuclear envelope protein Mps2 and acts in SPB duplication (insertion of the duplication plaque into the nuclear envelope) (10654940).
Bca1（YLR077W）はミトコンドリア内膜にあって膜間腔に突き出し、複合体: Bca1 (YLR077W) is a new assembly factor located in the mitochondrial inner membrane, protruding into the intermembrane space, that controls an early step of complex III assembly (21168530).
Bcd1 は C/D snoRNP の組み立て因子で、コア蛋白 Nop58 の: Bcd1 is a C/D snoRNP assembly factor that guides loading of the core protein Nop58 onto the RNA (30700579).
Bcd1 は Rtt106 に結合し、Pol II との結合を減らして転写依存の: Bcd1 binds Rtt106, reduces its association with Pol II to control transcription-dependent recruitment, and alters H3K56ac in gene bodies. The structure of the complex was determined by NMR and X-ray (33767140).
Bch1 と Bud7 は Chs3 の輸送で重複して働き、両方を欠くと Chs: Bch1 and Bud7 act redundantly in Chs3 trafficking; loss of both causes Chs3 to dissociate from the complex (16855022).
Bch1 と Bud7 は Chs3 の輸送で重複して働く（両方を欠くと Chs: Bch1 and Bud7 act redundantly in Chs3 trafficking (loss of both causes Chs3 to dissociate from the complex) (16855022).
Bck2 は Mcm1 と物理的に結合し G1 期の遺伝子を活性化する。ChIP: Bck2 physically binds Mcm1 and activates G1 genes. ChIP shows ECB-dependent localization to promoters (23675312).
Bcp1 は uL14（Rpl23）のシャペロンで、Rkm1 と 3 者の複合体: Bcp1 is a chaperone of uL14 (Rpl23) that forms a ternary complex with Rkm1 to protect uL14, and in the nucleus simultaneously removes Rkm1 and importin from uL14 to aid its incorporation into pre-60S. In bcp1ts rkm1Δ, newly made uL14 nearly disappears (39007857).
Bcy1 を欠く（PKA が常に活性）とグルコース飢餓での Hxt1 の分解が強: Loss of Bcy1 (constitutively active PKA) strongly suppresses Hxt1 degradation under glucose starvation (24821015).
Bdf1 は BDF2 のプロモーターに結合して BDF2 の発現を負に制御する: Bdf1 binds the BDF2 promoter and negatively regulates BDF2 expression. Bdf1 and Bdf2 also bind each other (23452060).
Bdf1 はアセチル化 H4 に結合するほか、Ino2 や Gal4・Rap1・: Besides binding acetylated H4, Bdf1 is recruited by Ino2, Gal4, Rap1, Leu3, and Flo8. The binding region is in the Bdf1 N terminus (37947853).
Bdp1 は増殖中に 4 つの主な部位でリン酸化され、tRNA 遺伝子の転写を抑: Bdp1 is phosphorylated at four main sites during growth and dephosphorylated under conditions that repress tRNA gene transcription. Inhibiting sch9-as increases dephosphorylated Bdp1, and Sch9 phosphorylates Bdp1 in vitro. Alanine mutation of the four sites causes excessive repression of transcription, and Bdp1 phosphorylation counteracts Maf1-mediated repression (25970584).
Bee1/Las17 と Arp2/3 複合体の共免疫沈降には Arc15 と: Co-immunoprecipitation of Bee1/Las17 with the Arp2/3 complex requires both Arc15 and Arc19 (10322115).
Bem1 が芽の出る場所に局在するには活性化した Cdc42 が必要で、GTP: Localization of Bem1 to the bud site requires activated Cdc42, and expression of GTP-bound Cdc42 alone causes Bem1 to accumulate at the plasma membrane (11927541).
Bem1 の結合をなくす Ste20 の PxxP 変異は CRIB 変異と足し: Ste20 PxxP mutations that abolish Bem1 binding combine additively with CRIB mutations to weaken signaling, and Bem1 and Cdc42 contribute separately to Ste20 function. PxxP mutations also weaken signaling by constitutively active Ste20 (15743816).
Bem1 は Cln3 と Cdc28 の下流で、Cdk に依存してリン酸化され: Bem1 appears to be phosphorylated downstream of Cln3 and Cdc28 in a Cdk-dependent manner to promote vacuole fusion. S72D suppresses vacuole fragmentation in cln3Δ, and with S72A Cln3 cannot promote fusion (16230527).
Bem1 を局所に呼ぶと Cdc42 の自己維持的な活性化が起こる（286822: Local recruitment of Bem1 triggers self-sustaining Cdc42 activation (28682236). Bem1 mainly enhances GEF activity (24062340). The GEF-PAK complex locally converts Cdc42 to the GTP-bound form via the GEF (19013066).
Bem2・Bem3 は出芽時におそらく Cdc28-Cln2 によって過剰リン酸: Bem2 and Bem3 are hyperphosphorylated at bud emergence, probably by Cdc28-Cln2, and this phosphorylation appears to inhibit GAP activity in vivo (non-phosphorylatable Bem3 is hyperactive). The inhibitors of G1 Cdc42 activation are inactivated by the Cdc28/Cln kinase (17914457).
Bem4 は Cdc42・Rho1 ほかの Rho 型 GTPase と two: Bem4 binds Cdc42, Rho1, and other Rho-type GTPases by two-hybrid (8754839).
Bem4 は ヌクレオチドを持たない Rho1 と直接結合し、GDP・GTP 型: Bem4 binds nucleotide-free Rho1 directly and binds the GDP- and GTP-bound forms weakly. It has no GEF, GDI, or GAP activity (8754840).
Bet3p と Bet5p は TRAPP の構成要素。精製 TRAPP は Y: Bet3p and Bet5p are components of TRAPP. Purified TRAPP accelerates nucleotide exchange on Ypt1p, and in TRAPP mutants GDP release is reduced in a temperature-sensitive manner (11038176).
Bet3p・Bet5p・Trs23p・Trs31p が Ypt1p の活性化に最: Bet3p, Bet5p, Trs23p, and Trs31p are minimally required for Ypt1p activation. In the TRAPPI–Ypt1p complex structure, Bet3p, Bet5p, and Trs23p bind Ypt1p directly and stabilize the open nucleotide-binding pocket (18585354).
Bet3・Bet5・Trs23・Trs31 が Ypt1 の活性化に最低限必要。: Bet3, Bet5, Trs23, and Trs31 are minimally required for Ypt1 activation. Trs31 does not bind Ypt1 directly but allosterically regulates the TRAPPI–Ypt1 interface (18585354).
Bfa1 と Bub2 は合わせて Tem1 の 2 成分の GAP として働く: Bfa1 and Bub2 together act as a two-component GAP for Tem1 (in vitro, 12048186). The GAP activity of Bfa1-Bub2 mediates mitotic arrest in response to spindle damage (16682821).
Bfr1 の RNA 結合変異体は ERG4 mRNA に結合できず、bfr1Δ: RNA-binding mutants of Bfr1 cannot bind ERG4 mRNA, and Erg4 levels are greatly reduced in bfr1Δ (31455610).
Bfr2・Dbp4・Enp2 は 50S 複合体で一緒にあり、80S の SSU: Bfr2, Dbp4, and Enp2 are together in the 50S complex and associate with U3 snoRNA in the 80S SSU processome (24357410).
Bik1 と Pac1 は Smt3・Ubc9（E2）・Nfi1（E3）と相互作: Bik1 and Pac1 interact with Smt3, Ubc9 (E2), and Nfi1 (E3). Bik1 binds SUMO directly in vitro and is SUMOylated in vivo upon overexpression of Smt3 and Bik1 (23034179).
Bil2 は試験管内で Bnr1 によるアクチン繊維の核形成を抑えるが伸長は変え: Bil2 inhibits Bnr1-mediated actin filament nucleation in vitro but does not change elongation (33634134).
Bim1 は Ipl1 と安定な複合体を作り、リンカーの 6 つのセリンがリン酸: Bim1 forms a stable complex with Ipl1, and six serines in its linker are phosphorylated. Linker phosphorylation releases Bim1 from microtubules. Bim1 phosphorylation occurs in anaphase in vivo and is required for normal spindle elongation and efficient disassembly of the spindle midzone (19667128).
Bio2 への Fe/S クラスターの組み立ては Isu1・Isu2 に強く依存: Fe/S cluster assembly on Bio2 strongly depends on Isu1 and Isu2 (17259550).
Bir1 の局在が崩れる bir1-107 で Ipl1 が異常な点に集まる。B: In bir1-107, in which Bir1 localization is disrupted, Ipl1 concentrates at abnormal foci. Bir1 ensures correct localization of Ipl1 (19056681).
Blm10 のドーム構造が PI31（Fub1）の N 末端ドメインを包み、Fu: The dome structure of Blm10 encloses the N-terminal domain of PI31 (Fub1), and the C-terminal domain of Fub1 inhibits all six active sites within the CP. The two cooperate to inhibit the proteasome (42485378).
Blue Native 電気泳動で、OST は Ost3p か Ost6p のど: By Blue Native electrophoresis, OST consists of two forms containing either Ost3p or Ost6p (16297388).
Bmh は Adr1 の調節ドメイン（215〜260 番）に直接結合して転写の活: Bmh binds directly to the regulatory domain of Adr1 (residues 215–260) and inhibits transcriptional activation. S230 phosphorylation and Bmh are important for inactivation of Gal4-Adr1 (20855531). The abstract does not distinguish Bmh1 and Bmh2.
Bmh1 と Bmh2 は Cdc5 に結合してキナーゼ活性を高め、減数分裂のコ: Bmh1 and Bmh2 bind Cdc5, enhance its kinase activity, and establish meiotic commitment (35240051).
Bmh1 の結合は Yak1 の触媒活性を下げるが局在は変えない。T335 の自: Bmh1 binding reduces the catalytic activity of Yak1 but does not change its localization. Autophosphorylation at T335 is essential for Bmh1 binding.
Bni1 の FH1 ドメインのポリプロリンがプロフィリンに結合し、プロフィリン: Polyprolines in the FH1 domain of Bni1 bind profilin and deliver profilin-actin to the growing end (22247555).
Bni1 は GTP 型 Rho1 と結合する（8947028）。Rho1 結合: Bni1 binds GTP-bound Rho1 (8947028). Bni1 lacking the Rho1-binding site does not localize to the bud tip; Rho1 and Spa2 are involved in localizing Bni1 to growth sites (9571251).
Bni1 を止めた株で gin4 または shs1 の欠失は Bnr1 の欠失と: In strains with Bni1 inactivated, deletion of gin4 or shs1, like deletion of Bnr1, causes loss of actin cables and death, which is suppressed by constitutive activation of Bnr1. Gin4 is involved in both localization and activation of Bnr1 and binds the region of Bnr1 required for its localization, independently of its kinase activity.
Bni1 を止めた株で shs1 の欠失はアクチンケーブルを失わせ、Bnr1 の: In strains with Bni1 inactivated, deletion of shs1 causes loss of actin cables, which is suppressed by constitutive activation of Bnr1. Shs1 is required for Bnr1 activation but not for its localization.
Bni4 は Chs4 と Cdc10 に結合し、GFP-Chs4 の出芽部の環: Bni4 binds Chs4 and Cdc10, and localization of GFP-Chs4 to the ring at the bud neck depends on septins, Bni4, and Chs3 (9314530). In Bni4 mutants unable to bind Glc7, Chs4 is not anchored at the bud neck, and in bni4, GFP-Chs4 does not accumulate at the presumptive bud site (it moves to the bud neck during cytokinesis) (12529424).
Bni5 は試験管内で Elm1 の基質らしい。Bni5 があると Elm1 が: Bni5 appears to be an Elm1 substrate in vitro. In the presence of Bni5, Elm1 causes disassembly of long septin filaments (26351911).
Boi1・Boi2 を欠く細胞は芽に分泌小胞をためる。Boi1/Boi2 の P: Cells lacking Boi1 and Boi2 accumulate secretory vesicles in the bud. The PH domains of Boi1/Boi2 interact with Sec1; reducing Boi1/Boi2 causes Sec1 to lose its tip localization, which Sec1 overexpression partially compensates.
Bol1・Bol3 は Grx5・Nfu1 のどちらとも二量体の複合体を作る（2: Bol1 and Bol3 form dimeric complexes with both Grx5 and Nfu1 (27532772).
Bop3 に結合する Bmh2・Fkh1・Rts1（ツーハイブリッド）。Bop3: Bmh2, Fkh1, and Rts1 bind Bop3 (two-hybrid). Resistance conferred by Bop3 overexpression is smaller in fkh1Δ (15796894).
Bph1 はエンドソームのタンパク質で、Rab5 のアイソフォーム Ypt52: Bph1 is an endosomal protein and an effector of the Rab5 isoform Ypt52 (35343566).
Bph1 を失うと通常の増殖でもエンドソームで Atg8 が脂質化され液胞内腔に: Loss of Bph1 causes Atg8 to be lipidated at endosomes and delivered to the vacuolar lumen even under normal growth (35343566).
Bre1 がないと Lge1 の安定性が大きく下がる。Bre1 の中央部が必要で: Without Bre1, Lge1 stability is greatly reduced. The central region of Bre1 is required, but its E3 activity is not (29637554).
Bre1 の RING フィンガーは H2B のユビキチン化、H3 の K4・K: The Bre1 RING finger is required for H2B ubiquitination, H3 K4 and K79 methylation, and telomeric silencing. Bre1 recruits Rad6 to promoters (12535539). H2B ubiquitination promotes histone eviction at DSBs, and in bre1Δ, RPA and Rad51 recruitment and homologous recombination are impaired (30304473). The Bre1 RING and Rad6 binding alone can monoubiquitinate nucleosomal H2B K123 in vitro (25548288).
Bre2 と Sdc1 は直接結合し、その結合が H3K4 メチル化と遺伝子発現: Bre2 and Sdc1 bind directly, and this binding is required for H3K4 methylation and gene expression (19897479).
Brl1・Brr6・Apq12 は核膜にあり共沈し、ともに脂質の恒常性に要る（2: Brl1, Brr6, and Apq12 are in the nuclear envelope, co-precipitate, and are all required for lipid homeostasis (26432634).
Brl1・Brr6・Apq12 は核膜にあり共沈する（26432634）: Brl1, Brr6, and Apq12 are in the nuclear envelope and co-precipitate (26432634).
Brl1・Brr6・Apq12 は核膜にあり共沈降する。共に脂質の恒常性に必要（: Brl1, Brr6, and Apq12 are in the nuclear envelope and co-immunoprecipitate. All are required for lipid homeostasis (26432634).
Brl1・Brr6・Apq12 は核膜にあり共沈降する（26432634）: Brl1, Brr6, and Apq12 are in the nuclear envelope and co-immunoprecipitate (26432634).
Brx1 は前駆体リボソームへの安定な結合に Ebp2 を要するが、逆は要らない: Brx1 requires Ebp2 for stable binding to pre-ribosomes, but not vice versa. The two bind strongly by two-hybrid (22319211).
Bsp1 は Sjl2・Sjl3 と直接結合し、Sjl1 とは結合しない。両者を: Bsp1 binds Sjl2 and Sjl3 directly but not Sjl1. It is proposed as an adaptor linking them to cortical actin (12606027).
Bsp1 は Sjl2・Sjl3 と直接結合し、Sjl1 とは結合しない（126: Bsp1 binds Sjl2 and Sjl3 directly but not Sjl1 (12606027).
Btn1 は SNARE と直接は結合せず、パルミトイル化キナーゼ Yck3 を: Btn1 does not bind SNAREs directly but controls Sed5 phosphorylation by regulating the palmitoylated kinase Yck3 (21987636).
Btn2 は Snc1 v-SNARE 結合タンパク質として単離され、組換え B: Btn2 was isolated as a Snc1 v-SNARE-binding protein, and recombinant Btn2 binds GST-Snc1 in vitro (17101785).
Btn3（Tda3）は Ent3 と Ent5 の新しい相手で、エンドソームへの: Btn3 (Tda3) is a new partner of Ent3 and Ent5, and its endosomal localization depends on Ent3 and Ent5 (25512335).
Bub1 はキナーゼで、自己リン酸化と Bub3 のリン酸化を試験管内で触媒する: Bub1 is a kinase that catalyzes its own autophosphorylation and phosphorylation of Bub3 in vitro. Bub1 and Bub3 associate by immunoprecipitation and are genetically interdependent (7969164).
Bud2 は Bud1/Rsr1 の GAP で、酵母から精製した Bud2 は: Bud2 is a GAP for Bud1/Rsr1, and Bud2 purified from yeast stimulates GTP hydrolysis by Bud1. Both loss and overexpression of BUD2 randomize the budding pattern (8371782).
Bud20 は pre-60S とともに細胞質へ出て、Drg1 の働きで外れる（: Bud20 is exported to the cytoplasm with pre-60S and released by the action of Drg1 (23045392).
Bud23 が DEAH-box ヘリカーゼ Ecm16（Dhr1）と物理的・機: Bud23 is physically and functionally linked with the DEAH-box helicase Ecm16 (Dhr1) (24710271).
Bud23–Trm112 の結晶構造。両者は β ジッパーで結合して複合体を安定: Crystal structure of Bud23–Trm112. They bind via a β-zipper to stabilize the complex, and Trm112 undergoes induced fit as a coactivator. Bud23 residues required for complex formation and recruitment to pre-ribosomes were identified (25489090).
Bud27 は体内で Maf1 の主な脱リン酸化酵素 PP4 と結合し、この結合: Bud27 associates in vivo with PP4, the main Maf1 phosphatase, and this association is required for proper Maf1 dephosphorylation. Without Bud27, PP4–Maf1 binding, Maf1 dephosphorylation, and its nuclear translocation are reduced. It also affects PP4-mediated regulation of Rad53 phosphorylation (38864693).
Bud31 は ARP2・SRC1 などの一部の pre-mRNA のスプライシ: Bud31 promotes splicing of a subset of pre-mRNAs such as ARP2 and SRC1, and the short SRC1 splice form is absent in bud31 deletion (22789856).
Bud32 の S258 は Sch9 によって特異的にリン酸化され、このリン酸: S258 of Bud32 is specifically phosphorylated by Sch9; this phosphorylation does not change Bud32 catalytic activity but enhances its ability to bind and phosphorylate Grx4. EKC/KEOPS function is unchanged when this pathway is disrupted (19021767).
Bud4 は分裂期と G1 期の初めに分裂部位で軸性の目印を順に組み立てる足場。: Bud4 is a scaffold that sequentially assembles the axial landmark at the division site in mitosis and early G1. Bud4 unable to bind GTP does not bind Axl1 in vitro, and the same bud4 mutation disrupts Axl1 localization and abolishes axial budding.
Bud5 の局在は一倍体では Bud3 と Axl2 に依存する: Bud5 localization depends on Bud3 and Axl2 in haploids.
Bud5 の局在は一倍体では Bud3 と Axl2、二倍体では Bud8 と: Bud5 localization depends on Bud3 and Axl2 in haploids and on Bud8 and Bud9 in diploids, and Bud5 physically binds Axl2 (11313501). Assembly of Bud5 into the double ring depends on components of the axial landmark (11378394).
Bud5 の局在は二倍体では Bud8 と Bud9 に依存する: Bud5 localization depends on Bud8 and Bud9 in diploids.
Bud6 は Bni1 によるアクチン重合のうち伸長ではなく核形成を特異的に促す: Bud6 specifically promotes nucleation, not elongation, in Bni1-mediated actin polymerization. Both binding to Bni1 and binding to G-actin are required. With the same mutations, formin regulation by Bud6 is essential for normal levels of actin cables in vivo.
Bud9p の正常な局在は Rax1p・Rax2p にほぼ全面的に依存する（15: Normal localization of Bud9p depends almost entirely on Rax1p and Rax2p (15356260).
Bul の脱リン酸化には Sit4 が要り、Sit4 は Gap1 の分解に欠か: Bul dephosphorylation requires Sit4, and Sit4 is essential for Gap1 degradation (22966204). Through TORC1-mediated inhibition of Npr1, Bul1 and Bul2 are activated by dephosphorylation and bring Rsp5 to Gap1 (24942738).
Bul1（Bul2 ではない）が Jen1 の取り込みに寄与し、グルコースに応じ: Bul1 (not Bul2) contributes to Jen1 internalization and acts mainly at the plasma membrane in response to glucose (29514933).
Bul1（Bul2 ではない）が基質で誘導される Agp1 のエンドサイトーシス: Bul1 (not Bul2) is essential for substrate-induced endocytosis of Agp1 (33620458).
Bul3 は 2 つの ORF の読み過ごしで作られる Bul ファミリー第 3: Bul3 is a third Bul-family adaptor produced by readthrough of two ORFs. The two forms of Bul3 interact with Rsp5 differently (22307975).
Bur1 と Bur2 は共免疫沈降し two-hybrid で結合、Bur1: Bur1 and Bur2 co-immunoprecipitate and bind by two-hybrid, and Bur1 kinase activity requires BUR2 (10982824).
Bur1 は TORC1 の標的 Sch9 を直接リン酸化し、Bur1 と TO: Bur1 directly phosphorylates the TORC1 target Sch9, and both Bur1 and TORC1 are required for Sch9 activation (35166010).
Bur1 は生体内で Rpb1 のリンカー部分をリン酸化し、これが Spt6 の: Bur1 phosphorylates the linker region of Rpb1 in vivo, which strengthens binding of the Spt6 SH2 domain (31085683). Acute inactivation of Bur1 greatly reduces Ser2 phosphorylation of the Pol II CTD, and Bur1 also contributes to Ser2 phosphorylation (19581288). Classified as activation because it aids assembly of the elongation complex. BioGRID's 12972617 reports no change in CTD phosphorylation, and 28202544 and 39779918 do not show a Bur1→Rpb1 effect.
Bur1（SGV1）は体内でも伸長複合体でも Spt5 の C 末端反復領域をリ: Bur1 (SGV1) phosphorylates the C-terminal repeat region of Spt5 both in vivo and in the elongation complex; deletion of that region or mutation of the serines targeted by Bur1 reduces PAF complex recruitment and also H3K4 trimethylation (19581288). Bur1 phosphorylates the Spt5 CTR to promote Paf1C recruitment, and Kin28 enhances this through Bur1 recruitment (22796944). BioGRID's 22973055 is a paper on Sub1 and Spt5, and the role of Bur1-mediated Spt5 phosphorylation is not in its abstract.
Bur2 を欠くと COMPASS による H3K4 のメチル化が減り、Bur1: Loss of Bur2 reduces COMPASS-mediated H3K4 methylation, and Bur1/Bur2 are required for Rad6/Bre1-mediated H2B monoubiquitination. This is due to defects in Bur1/Bur2-mediated phosphorylation of Rad6 S120 and in Paf1 complex recruitment. Rad6 S120 is required for H2B monoubiquitination in vivo (16307922).
Bzz1 は Rbd2 と同じ経路で 1 型ミオシンの呼び込みとアクチン重合の開: Bzz1 acts in the same pathway as Rbd2 to set the timing of type I myosin recruitment and the onset of actin polymerization. Full text: Bzz1 arrives early in rbd2Δ (25694450).
Bzz1（Lsb7）は SH3 で Las17 に直接結合し、局在は Las17: Bzz1 (Lsb7) binds Las17 directly via its SH3 domains, and its localization is Las17-dependent. It recruits the actin polymerization machinery in vitro (12391157).
C17 と C25 は抑圧スクリーニングで遺伝学的に、共免疫精製と 2 ハイブリ: C17 and C25 interact genetically in a suppressor screen and physically by co-immunopurification and two-hybrid (12482973).
CAF-1 の Cac1 に結合した Cac2 と Cac1 の酸性領域が H3: Cac2 bound to Cac1 of CAF-1, together with the acidic region of Cac1, forms the H3-H4 binding surface. Cac2 is essential for productive histone binding (28418026).
CAF4・CAF16 は CCR4 依存に SRB9（SSN2）と結合する（11: CAF4 and CAF16 bind SRB9 (SSN2) in a CCR4-dependent manner (11113136).
CAK1 は bur1 温度感受性変異の多コピー抑圧遺伝子。Bur1 の T ル: CAK1 is a multicopy suppressor of a temperature-sensitive bur1 mutation. The T-loop threonine of Bur1 and Cak1 are required for Bur1 phosphorylation and function in vivo, and recombinant Cak1 increases the CTD kinase activity of Bur1-Bur2 (12215532).
CAP1・CAP2 の一方を欠くともう一方のサブユニットのタンパク質も失われる。: Loss of either CAP1 or CAP2 also causes loss of the other subunit protein. The phenotypes of the two deletions are similar (1447293).
CAPP の活性化（SIT4 の過剰発現でも可）で Tlg1/2 が脱リン酸化さ: Activation of CAPP (also achievable by SIT4 overexpression) dephosphorylates Tlg1/2, which are incorporated into SNARE complexes, restoring endocytosis (12006655).
CAR1 の誘導（酵素活性と mRNA）に ARG80・ARG81 が必要で、M: Induction of CAR1 (enzyme activity and mRNA) requires ARG80 and ARG81, which together with MCM1 are required for the function of UASI-A/B/C (8212891).
CAT8-lacZ 融合で CAT8 自身が Mig1（Cat4）に抑えられ、M: CAT8-lacZ fusions show that CAT8 itself is repressed by Mig1 (Cat4), and Cat8 is produced when Mig1 leaves the CAT8 promoter (7891685). Glucose repression of CAT8 expression is mainly due to Mig1 (9111319).
CBC は Cbc2（m7G キャップに結合）と Sto1 のヘテロ二量体（23: CBC is a heterodimer of Cbc2 (which binds the m7G cap) and Sto1 (23002122).
CBF1 欠損でミトコンドリアの Atp3 量が変わり、β-ガラクトシダーゼのレ: CBF1 loss alters mitochondrial Atp3 levels, and β-galactosidase reporters and western blots confirm direct transcriptional regulation of ATP3 by Cbf1 (30381292).
CBF3 の Skp1 と Ctf13 はヘテロ二量体を作る。Ctf13 が C: Skp1 and Ctf13 of CBF3 form a heterodimer. Ctf13 forms the structural core of CBF3 (10352012).
CBS1 は cob の 5' リーダーをもつミトコンドリア mRNA の翻訳に: CBS1 is required for translation of mitochondrial mRNAs carrying the cob 5' leader and activates translation by acting on the 5' leader (3033440).
CCP1 プロモーターで見つかった新しい Yap1・Skn7 の結合部位が、TS: New Yap1 and Skn7 binding sites found in the CCP1 promoter mediate Yap1- and Skn7-dependent activation of TSA1 and CTT1 (16313629).
CCT3 の内部タグで精製した酵母 CCT が、試験管内で ACT1p の折りた: Yeast CCT purified via an internal tag on CCT3 catalyzes folding of ACT1p in vitro (16762366).
CDC25 の触媒ドメインが RAS2 のグアニンヌクレオチド交換を促す（GEF: The catalytic domain of CDC25 promotes guanine nucleotide exchange on RAS2 (GEF).
CDC28 は S 期の初めに Cac1 の S94・S515 をリン酸化し、C: CDC28 phosphorylates S94 and S515 of Cac1 in early S phase and regulates chromatin binding of CAF-I (without affecting PCNA binding). In cdc28-1, chromatin binding of CAF-I is impaired, and mutation of the phosphorylation sites reduces telomeric silencing (25602519).
CDC37 は mps1-1 の多コピー抑圧遺伝子で、cdc37-1 では Mp: CDC37 is a multicopy suppressor of mps1-1; in cdc37-1, Mps1 levels are unchanged but its kinase activity is markedly reduced (9060463).
CDC40 が制御する標的は ANC1 で、ANC1 のイントロンを除くと cd: The target controlled by CDC40 is ANC1; removing the ANC1 intron relieves the cell cycle arrest of cdc40 mutants (15133121).
CDC5 がないと第一分裂で動原体が二方向に結合し、共配向に必須の Mam1 が: Without CDC5, kinetochores attach bi-oriented in meiosis I, and Mam1, essential for co-orientation, does not bind kinetochores (12663816). Cells lacking Cdc5 cannot properly localize Lrs4 and Mam1, and sister kinetochores bi-orient (12717442).
CDC5 に依存する Rec8 のリン酸化は染色体の腕部からのコヒーシンの除去に: CDC5-dependent phosphorylation of Rec8 is required for removal of cohesin from chromosome arms (23918381). Condensin enhances Cdc5-mediated cohesin phosphorylation and promotes cohesin removal before anaphase I (16269332).
CDK による Hcm1 の活性化部位のリン酸化は生体内で Cks1 に依存する: CDK-mediated phosphorylation of the Hcm1 activation sites depends on Cks1 in vivo (36658165).
CDK による Hct1（Cdh1）のリン酸化は APC との結合を妨げる（98: CDK-mediated phosphorylation of Hct1 (Cdh1) prevents its binding to the APC (9831566). Phosphorylation by Cdc28 renders Hct1 unable to activate the APC, which is restored by Cdc14-mediated dephosphorylation (10074450). Cdk1 phosphorylates first to recruit the polo kinase Cdc5, which inactivates Cdh1 (18500339).
CDK による Orc2・Orc6 のリン酸化はヘリカーゼ装填の同じ段階を阻む（: CDK-mediated phosphorylation of Orc2 and Orc6 blocks the same step of helicase loading (in vitro reconstitution, 21289063). In vivo, B-type CDKs prevent re-initiation by overlapping mechanisms: ORC phosphorylation, Cdc6 inhibition, and nuclear export of Mcm2-7 (11429609). A phosphomimetic Orc2 S188 delays G1/S and makes MCM loading inefficient (19068484). Evidence specifically implicating Clb5 is only in vitro, so confidence is medium.
CDK による Sld3 のリン酸化は必須で、Dpb11 の結合部位をつくる（1: CDK-mediated phosphorylation of Sld3 is essential and creates a binding site for Dpb11 (17167415). The two S-CDK sites of Sld3 are both essential for DNA replication, and when phosphorylated they bind the N-terminal BRCT of Dpb11. Sld2 and Sld3 are the minimal targets of S-CDK (17167417). BioGRID's 20865002 is a paper on Rad53-mediated phosphorylation of Sld3, not a CDK result.
CDK によるリン酸化は Sgs1 の速度と連続性を高め、試験管内の DNA 巻: CDK-mediated phosphorylation increases the rate and processivity of Sgs1, promoting DNA unwinding in vitro and processing of joint molecules in vivo. Subsequent hyperphosphorylation by Cdc5 appears to reduce Sgs1 activity (32504558). BioGRID's 16319894 is a protein-chip-based large-scale analysis.
CDK の PHO85 とサイクリンの PHO80 の複合体が PHO4 をリン: The complex of the CDK PHO85 and the cyclin PHO80 phosphorylates PHO4. PHO80 and PHO85 interact genetically.
CDK 阻害因子 PHO81 は低リン酸で PHO80-PHO85 のキナーゼ活: The CDK inhibitor PHO81 inhibits PHO80-PHO85 kinase activity under low phosphate.
