CDK1 による Sae2 のリン酸化が Mre11 のエンドヌクレアーゼを活性: CDK1-mediated phosphorylation of Sae2 activates the Mre11 endonuclease (31552432).
CDK1 リン酸化部位と重なる NLS をもつ Msa1 などが CDK1 と細: Msa1 and other proteins with NLSs overlapping CDK1 phosphorylation sites show CDK1- and cell cycle-dependent nuclear transport (19520826).
CDP-DAG 合成酵素（CDS1）の活性を下げると PS 合成酵素活性が 7: Reducing CDP-DAG synthase (CDS1) activity raises PS synthase activity 7-fold, and CHO1 mRNA changes similarly (9111022).
CHS7 を欠くと Chs3 だけが ER に留まり CSIII 活性が大きく下: Without CHS7, only Chs3 is retained in the ER and CSIII activity drops greatly. Simultaneous overexpression of CHS3 and CHS7 increases Chs3 export and CSIII activity, with Chs7 levels being rate-limiting (10366589). Chs7 travels with Chs3 beyond the ER, and in mutants that disrupt their binding, Chs3 reaches the surface but its catalytic activity is greatly reduced (29405545).
CIN1 の対立遺伝子が cin4-4 のベノミル感受性を特異的に抑える。GTP: A CIN1 allele specifically suppresses the benomyl sensitivity of cin4-4. GTP-bound Cin4 is thought to interact with Cin1 to regulate tubulin-folding activity (9215891).
CIN1・CIN2・CIN4・PAC2 は生体内でチューブリンのヘテロ二量体の形: CIN1, CIN2, CIN4, and PAC2 are involved in tubulin heterodimer formation in vivo and protect cells from the toxicity of free β-tubulin (10978276).
CIT2 は機能不全のミトコンドリア（rho0）で大きく発現が上がり、Rtg1・: CIT2 expression is greatly increased in dysfunctional mitochondria (rho0), and Rtg1 and Rtg3 bind the upstream activation site of CIT2 as a heterodimer (10848632).
CK1 依存のリン酸化と Rsp5 依存のユビキチン化が Jen1 のエンドサイ: CK1-dependent phosphorylation and Rsp5-dependent ubiquitination are required for Jen1 endocytosis and occur within minutes of glucose addition (19433580).
CK2 による Hsf1 S608 のリン酸化はエタノールストレスに特有の抑制で: CK2-mediated phosphorylation of Hsf1 S608 is an inhibition specific to ethanol stress and is relieved by dephosphorylation by Ppt1, which binds Hsf1 directly via its TPR domain (24894977).
CK2 による Hsf1 S608 のリン酸化はエタノールストレスのときだけ H: CK2-mediated phosphorylation of Hsf1 S608 inhibits Hsf1 only under ethanol stress (basal and heat-induced activity are unaffected). It is relieved by Ppt1-mediated dephosphorylation, and the S608A mutation enhances activation (PMID 24894977). 28330760 is a paper on Msn2 and does not mention Hsf1.
CK2 による Maf1 のリン酸化は Pol III の転写に要る。増殖に適し: CK2-mediated phosphorylation of Maf1 is required for Pol III transcription. Upon shift to growth-favorable conditions, CK2 activity is required to release Maf1 from Pol III on tRNA genes. Without Maf1, inhibiting CK2 does not change tRNA synthesis (21383183). Because Maf1 is a Pol III repressor, CK2 inhibits Maf1.
CK2 に依存する Crf1 T348 のリン酸化は Fhl1 の FHA ドメ: CK2-dependent phosphorylation of Crf1 T348 creates a binding site for the FHA domain of Fhl1. Crf1(T348A) cells cannot repress ribosomal protein gene transcription when TORC1 is inhibited with rapamycin (27321754).
CK2 の Cka2 サブユニットが Psh1 をリン酸化して Cse4 への: The Cka2 subunit of CK2 phosphorylates Psh1 and enhances its E3 activity toward Cse4. Without CKA2, Cse4 is greatly stabilized, and Cse4 is also stabilized with Psh1 bearing Ala at the phosphorylation sites (25183013).
CK2 は Hot1 と結合してリン酸化し、Hot1 の標的遺伝子の発現と Ho: CK2 binds and phosphorylates Hot1 and negatively regulates expression of Hot1 target genes and accumulation of Hot1 at promoters (although phosphorylation alone is not sufficient to control the stochastic response).
CK2 は Sec63 の C 末端をリン酸化して Sec62 との結合を強める: CK2 phosphorylates the Sec63 C terminus and strengthens its binding to Sec62. Changing T652 and T654 to Ala weakens Sec62 binding and reduces the efficiency of translocation into the ER (15671059).
CK2 は Spt2 を試験管内と体内でリン酸化し、リン酸化をまねた変異は異常な: CK2 phosphorylates Spt2 in vitro and in vivo, and phosphomimetic mutations abolish Spt2's function in suppressing aberrant transcription and its association with genes. Reducing CK2 activity increases Spt2 binding to genes. Phosphorylation also prevents binding to Spt6 (23979598).
CK2 は TFIIIB の TBP と結合して通常は活性化し、CK2β が T: CK2 binds TBP of TFIIIB and normally activates it; CK2β is required for the activity of TBP-bound CK2 and for Pol III transcription. Upon DNA damage, TBP-bound CK2 decreases and Pol III transcription is repressed (11551505).
CK2 は Tom22 と Mim1 をリン酸化して TOM 複合体の形成を促し: CK2 phosphorylates Tom22 and Mim1 to promote TOM complex formation, and inhibiting CK2 reduces the TOM complex and mitochondrial import (21215441). CK2 phosphorylates S44 and S46 of the Tom22 precursor to promote its import (24093680).
CK2 は eIF2α（Sui2）の C 末端の S292・S294・S301: CK2 directly phosphorylates S292, S294, and S301 at the C terminus of eIF2α (Sui2). Site mutations have no effect alone but impair growth when combined with GCN2, GCN3, or GCD7 mutations, and are required for full eIF2 function.
CK2 は受容体 Tom22 と輸入タンパク質 Mim1 をリン酸化して TOM: CK2 phosphorylates the receptor Tom22 and the import protein Mim1 to promote TOM complex biogenesis (21215441).
CK2 依存の Crf1 T348 のリン酸化が Fhl1 の FHA ドメイン: CK2-dependent phosphorylation of Crf1 T348 creates a binding site for the FHA domain of Fhl1. Crf1(T348A) cells cannot repress RP gene transcription when TORC1 is inhibited with rapamycin (27321754).
CK2 依存の Ifh1 T681 のリン酸化が Fhl1 の FHA ドメイン: CK2-dependent phosphorylation of Ifh1 T681 creates a binding site for the FHA domain of Fhl1. In Ifh1(T681A), Ifh1 binding to RP gene promoters and RP gene transcription decrease, and growth slows (27321754).
CK2-dependent phosphorylation of Ifh1 T681 creates a binding site for the FHA domain of Fhl1 (Ifh1 is recruited by Fhl1 to activate RP genes).
CK2 依存のリン酸化が、さまざまなストレスでの Msn2/4 の活性化を正に制: CK2-dependent phosphorylation positively regulates activation of Msn2/4 under various stresses.
CKII による Spt6 のリン酸化は遺伝子の 5′ 端のヌクレオソームを保ち: CKII-mediated phosphorylation of Spt6 is required to maintain nucleosomes at the 5′ ends of genes and prevent antisense transcription, and promotes binding to Spn1 (30566871). CK2-mediated phosphorylation of Spt6 is required to maintain Spt6 levels, suppress H3 exchange, and suppress aberrant transcription (29905868).
CLB1 を欠くと Cdc20 のない細胞で Ama1 に依存するタンパク質分解: Without CLB1, Ama1-dependent proteolysis and nuclear division occur in cells lacking Cdc20, and Clb1, like Spo13, is required to suppress accumulation of Ama1 and Clb3 in metaphase I (37728253, full text). Cdc5-Spo13 converts Clb1 from a substrate into an inhibitor of Ama1 (abstract).
CLB2 mRNA の蓄積は Hmt1 の集合と活性化に依存し、これは Dbf2: Accumulation of CLB2 mRNA depends on assembly and activation of Hmt1, which is promoted by Dbf2 and counteracted by the PP2A subunit Pph22. Activated Hmt1 methylates hnRNPs and stabilizes CLB2 mRNA (23706744).
CLN3–SBDS の結合は酵母の Btn1p と Sdo1p でも保たれる（2: The CLN3–SBDS interaction is conserved between the yeast Btn1p and Sdo1p (20015955).
COG のローブ B のサブユニットは全部 K28 耐性に要り、cog 変異の過: All lobe B subunits of COG are required for K28 resistance, and the hypersensitivity of cog mutants is mainly explained by defective Ktd1 trafficking (40557545).
COQ11 の欠失が coq10Δ の呼吸欠損・脂質過酸化への感受性・Q6 合成: Deletion of COQ11 rescues the respiratory defect, sensitivity to lipid peroxidation, and reduced Q6 synthesis of coq10Δ (32205446).
COR2 の合成は HAP1・HAP2/HAP3・ヘムで制御される（216777: COR2 synthesis is regulated by HAP1, HAP2/HAP3, and heme (2167771).
COR2 の合成は HAP1・HAP2/HAP3・ヘムで制御される（向きは要旨に: COR2 synthesis is regulated by HAP1, HAP2/HAP3, and heme (the direction is not in the abstract) (2167771) (PMID: 2167771).
CORVET の Vps3・Vps8 は Rab5/Vps21 と結合し、局在と: The CORVET subunits Vps3 and Vps8 bind Rab5/Vps21, and their N-terminal regions are required for localization and function (23840658).
COS8 プロモーターの ATF/CREB 部位は UAS/URS として働き、: The ATF/CREB site in the COS8 promoter acts as a UAS/URS, mediated by Sko1p, Aca1p, and Aca2p (12051917).
COX1 の aI1・aI2 イントロンの ORF はマチュラーゼに翻訳され、遺: The ORFs of the COX1 aI1 and aI2 introns are translated into maturases and are genetically involved in pre-mRNA splicing. Antibodies detected the 57 kDa aI2 maturase in aI2 splicing-defective mutants (1701209).
COX1 の aI5β イントロンのスプライシングは Mne1 に依存。mne1: Splicing of the COX1 aI5β intron depends on Mne1. The main defect of mne1Δ is splicing of this intron (21257754).
COX6 プロモーターの欠失・リンカースキャン変異の解析から、Abf1 が in: Analysis of deletion and linker-scan mutations of the COX6 promoter indicates that Abf1 is involved in intergenomic signaling (18977319).
CPA1 mRNA の uORF がコードする AAP がアルギニンに応じて u: The AAP encoded by the uORF of CPA1 mRNA stalls ribosomes at the uORF stop codon in response to arginine, negatively regulating CPA1 translation (16285926).
CPAR は UPF1 と同じ遺伝子で、UPF1（UPF2・UPF3）の欠失で: CPAR is the same gene as UPF1, and deletion of UPF1 (UPF2, UPF3) increases CPSase A synthesis. NMD destabilizes the 5' end of CPA1 mRNA (12172963). This degradation is enhanced in the presence of arginine.
CPBP（Cam1）は msrA（MXR1）の promoter に結合する複合: CPBP (Cam1) is part of a complex that binds the msrA (MXR1) promoter, and deficient strains cannot increase msrA mRNA and protein (12824466).
CPF1 は QCR8 の誘導を調節する負の制御因子。抑えの解除には S 期の通: CPF1 is a negative regulator that modulates QCR8 induction. Relief of repression requires passage through S phase (1317009).
CPT による複製ストレスで、損傷部位のチェックポイント信号は Slx4 と F: Under CPT-induced replication stress, checkpoint signaling at damage sites is dampened by Slx4 and Fun30 evicting Rad9 (41978269). Fun30 dampens the Rad9-dependent checkpoint induced by CPT and MMS but does not affect the Rad9-independent S-phase checkpoint (28089177).
CRT10 の働きは CRT1 の転写産物の量の正の制御による（16600900: CRT10 acts by positively regulating CRT1 transcript levels (16600900).
CRT10 の発現は DNA 損傷剤で誘導され、その誘導には DUN1 が必要（: CRT10 expression is induced by DNA-damaging agents, and this induction requires DUN1 (16600900).
CSN の Csn9 と Csi1 がプロテアソームの蓋のサブユニット Rpn5: The CSN subunits Csn9 and Csi1 bind the proteasome lid subunit Rpn5 (12672462).
CT ボックスによる Rap1/Gcr1 の活性化の増強には Gcr2 が要り、: Enhancement of Rap1/Gcr1 activation by the CT box requires Gcr2, and the hyperphosphorylated form of Gcr1 disappears in gcr2Δ. Gcr2 appears to change the conformation of Gcr1 or promote its hyperphosphorylation (9335588).
CTDK-1 は CDK の Ctk1・サイクリンの Ctk2・活性に要る Ct: CTDK-1 consists of the CDK Ctk1, the cyclin Ctk2, and Ctk3, which is required for activity. Ctk3 contacts both Ctk1 and Ctk2 extensively to assemble the complex (33431688).
CTR1・CTR3・FRE1 は共通の CuRE を持ち、銅の欠乏で活性化・銅で: CTR1, CTR3, and FRE1 share a CuRE and are activated by copper deprivation and repressed by copper. Mac1p is essential for this up- and down-regulation, and MAC1 is also required for occupancy of the CuRE (9188496).
CTS1・ENG1（DSE4）・SCW11・DSE1・DSE2 は Ace2 に: CTS1, ENG1 (DSE4), SCW11, DSE1, and DSE2 are genes specifically regulated by Ace2 (14709718).
CUP1 の誘導には Ace1p が必要で、活性化時に CUP1 プロモーターに: CUP1 induction requires Ace1p, which binds the CUP1 promoter upon activation. Pol II recruitment also depends on Ace1p (22609398).
CUS2 はスプライシング抽出液で U2 RNA と結合し、SF3a の PRP: CUS2 binds U2 RNA in splicing extracts and interacts with PRP11 of SF3a (9710584).
CWH43 は GPI アンカーにセラミドを入れるのに必要で、すべての付け替え反: CWH43 is required for incorporation of ceramide into GPI anchors, and all remodeling reactions depend on Bst1-mediated removal of the fatty acid from inositol (17714445).
CWI 経路の Slt2 は鉄欠乏の信号で Aft1 をリン酸化し、その活性を負: The CWI pathway kinase Slt2 phosphorylates Aft1 in response to iron-deficiency signals and negatively regulates its activity. Slt2 physically binds Aft1 (33549702).
CYC1・CYC7 がコードする 2 つのシトクロム c は CYC3 がコード: The two cytochromes c encoded by CYC1 and CYC7 receive heme from the heme lyase encoded by CYC3. In cyc3 mutants, apo-iso-2 is detected (9395529).
CYC8 の Y353C 変異で 18 の HXT のうち 9 つが上がり、特に: The CYC8 Y353C mutation increases 9 of the 18 HXT genes, especially HXT10, HXT13, HXT15, and HXT16, which are normally low (28363963).
CYC8 変異株で 18 の HXT のうち 9 が上がり、特にふだん低い・発現: In CYC8 mutants, 9 of the 18 HXTs increase, especially HXT10, HXT13, HXT15, and HXT16, which are normally low or not expressed (28363963).
CYC8 変異株で 9 つの HXT 遺伝子の発現が上がり、とくに HXT10・: In CYC8 mutants, expression of nine HXT genes increases, especially HXT10, HXT13, HXT15, and HXT16 (28363963).
CYC8 変異（Y353C）で HXT10・HXT13・HXT15・HXT16: The CYC8 mutation (Y353C) increases expression of HXTs including HXT10, HXT13, HXT15, and HXT16 (28363963).
CYT1 プロモーターには HAP1 と HAP2/3/4 の結合部位があり、H: The CYT1 promoter has binding sites for HAP1 and HAP2/3/4, and HAP1 binds one high-affinity site in CYT1 (1656218).
CYT1 プロモーターの制御領域に HAP2/3/4 活性化因子の結合部位がある: The regulatory region of the CYT1 promoter has a binding site for the HAP2/3/4 activator (1656218).
Ca2+ で働く経路で、Mck1 は Mpk1 経路の下流で Hsl1 を抑える: In the Ca2+-activated pathway, Mck1 inhibits Hsl1 downstream of the Mpk1 pathway (genetics) (11230131).
Ca2+ で分裂期の開始が遅れるとき、カルシニューリンは転写で、Mpk1 は翻訳: When mitotic entry is delayed by Ca2+, calcineurin activates Swe1 transcriptionally and Mpk1 activates it post-translationally; both are essential for the delay (11230131).
Ca2+ 経路は Swe1 を活性化して分裂期の開始を遅らせる。遺伝学的解析で: The Ca2+ pathway activates Swe1 to delay mitotic entry. Genetic analysis shows that Mck1 inhibits Hsl1, the kinase that inhibits Swe1, downstream of the Mpk1 pathway. Under high Ca2+, Hsl1 leaves the bud neck and is destabilized in a calcineurin- and Mck1-dependent manner, requiring SCF(Cdc4) (11230131). The abstract does not state direct phosphorylation, so confidence is medium.
Ca2+・α 因子・Na+ によるカルシニューリン依存の FKS2 の転写誘導に: Calcineurin-dependent transcriptional induction of FKS2 by Ca2+, α-factor, and Na+ requires CRZ1. Crz1 binds the 24 bp CDRE in the FKS2 promoter (9407035).
Cab2・Cab3・Cab4・Cab5 は互いに結合し、Cab3 の N 末端が: Cab2, Cab3, Cab4, and Cab5 bind one another, and the N terminus of Cab3 is required for binding to Cab2 and Cab5 (23789928).
Cab2・Cab3・Cab4・Cab5 は互いに結合し、Cab3 はほかの Ca: Cab2, Cab3, Cab4, and Cab5 bind one another, and Cab3 binds the other Cab proteins (23789928).
Cab3 と Cab5 は共分画し、Cab2〜Cab5 は互いに結合する（237: Cab3 and Cab5 co-fractionate, and Cab2–Cab5 bind one another (23789928).
Cac1 の CDC7 の標的と考えられる部位を変えると Cac1 の安定性が下: Altering the putative CDC7 target sites of Cac1 reduces Cac1 stability (25602519).
Cac3 は Npr1 と会合し、余分な Cac3 は Npr1 を隔離して R: Cac3 associates with Npr1, and excess Cac3 sequesters Npr1 and inhibits the RAS/cAMP pathway. NPR1 overexpression prevents this inhibition (11238915).
Caf4 と Mdv1 は Fis1 に直接結合し、Dnm1 をミトコンドリアに: Caf4 and Mdv1 bind Fis1 directly and recruit Dnm1 to mitochondria. Caf4 is a bona fide fission adaptor that concentrates at fission sites (23300936).
Caj1 の適度な過剰発現が Tat1・Tat2 を J ドメイン依存で安定化し: Moderate overexpression of Caj1 stabilizes Tat1 and Tat2 in a J domain-dependent manner and alleviates the cold sensitivity of tryptophan auxotrophs (32777224).
Caj1 の適度な過剰発現が Tat1・Tat2 を J ドメイン依存で安定化す: Moderate overexpression of Caj1 stabilizes Tat1 and Tat2 in a J domain-dependent manner (32777224).
Cak1 は Kin28 の T162 をリン酸化し、Kin28 の CTD キ: Cak1 phosphorylates T162 of Kin28 and increases Kin28 CTD kinase activity. The T162A mutation reduces activity by 75–80%, and without Cak1, T162 is not phosphorylated in vivo (10373527). cak1 mutations reduce Kin28 phosphorylation and activity (9774652).
Cat2（YCAT）の内部配列を介したペルオキシソームへの取り込みは PAS10: Import of Cat2 (YCAT) into peroxisomes via an internal sequence depends on PAS10 (Pex5), and two-hybrid showed their binding (7628448).
Cat8 と Sip4 の DNA 結合ドメインは MDH2 の CSRE に試: The DNA-binding domains of Cat8 and Sip4 bind the CSRE of MDH2 in vitro, and Sip4 fused to an activation domain largely relieves glucose repression of MDH2 (11169757).
Cat8 は SIP4 の発現を制御し、Sip4 の過剰発現は Cat8 の欠損: Cat8 controls SIP4 expression, and Sip4 overexpression compensates for loss of Cat8 (9843506).
Cat8 は Snf1 に直接制御される。Cat8 の Ser562（出芽酵母）: Cat8 is directly regulated by Snf1. Ser562 of Cat8 (S. cerevisiae) is the Snf1 recognition site, and phosphomimetic mutation produces the active form.
Cat8p は非発酵性炭素源での ACS1・FBP1・ICL1・IDP2・JEN: Cat8p is required for derepression of ACS1, FBP1, ICL1, IDP2, JEN1, MLS1, PCK1, SFC1, and SIP4 on nonfermentable carbon sources. Expression changes at the diauxic shift were examined in cat8Δ (11024040).
Cbf1 も ENO1-lacZ の発現を制御し、E-box E1〜E3 を要す: Cbf1 also regulates ENO1-lacZ expression, requiring E-boxes E1–E3 (ChIP) (17351075).
Cbf1-Met4-Met28 複合体が MET16 の調節領域に組み上がる（9: The Cbf1-Met4-Met28 complex assembles on the MET16 regulatory region (9799240). Induction of sulfate assimilation requires MET4 (1549123).
Cbf2 は生体内でユビキチン化され、精製 Cdc34 が試験管内で Cbf2-: Cbf2 is ubiquitinated in vivo, and purified Cdc34 produces Cbf2-monoubiquitin in vitro (7651401).
Cbk1 が止まると Ace2 は核から出て、G1 CDK（Pho85・Cdc2: When Cbk1 is inactivated, Ace2 exits the nucleus and is retained in the cytoplasm by two mechanisms: phosphorylation of CDK sites by G1 CDKs (Pho85, Cdc28) and a mechanism independent of Pho85 kinase activity. Phosphorylation alone is not essential, and the two act redundantly (20573982).
Cbk1 が止まると Ace2 は核外に出て、その後は G1 期の CDK（Ph: When Cbk1 is inactivated, Ace2 exits the nucleus and is then retained in the cytoplasm by phosphorylation of CDK sites by G1 CDKs (Pho85, Cdc28) and by a mechanism independent of Pho85 kinase activity. The two mechanisms are redundant (20573982).
Cbk1 は Ace2 の部位をリン酸化し、これは Ace2 の娘細胞核への偏在: Cbk1 phosphorylates sites in Ace2, which is essential for Ace2's asymmetric localization to the daughter nucleus and its function. Two of the phosphorylations prevent binding to the nuclear export machinery, and a third is thought to increase transcriptional activity (18715118).
Cbk1 は体内で RNA 結合タンパク質 Ssd1 を抑え、この調節がないと芽: Cbk1 inhibits the RNA-binding protein Ssd1 in vivo; without this regulation, bud growth is delayed and the cell wall is disrupted. Inactivating Cbk1 represses, in an Ssd1-dependent manner, translation of cell wall-related mRNAs bound by Ssd1 (19962308). Cbk1-mediated phosphorylation of Ssd1 directs Ssd1-mRNA complexes to the cell cortex, and dephosphorylation promotes their movement to P-bodies and stress granules and translational repression (21339329). Because phosphorylated Ssd1 mediates polarized localization of mRNAs, what is inhibited is the translational repression function, and confidence is medium. BioGRID's 25966461 is a structural paper on Cbk1-Mob2 whose abstract does not describe an effect on Ssd1.
Cbk1 は体内で Ssd1 を抑える。Ssd1 は細胞壁の改変のタンパク質の: Cbk1 inhibits Ssd1 in vivo. Ssd1 binds mRNAs of cell wall remodeling proteins; inhibiting Cbk1 rapidly represses their translation, and this repression requires Ssd1. In cbk1-as2 SSD1 cells, Cbk1 inhibition greatly depletes UTH1, SUN4, CTS1, SIM1, and TOS1 mRNAs from polysomes (19962308).

Cbk1 inhibits Ssd1 in vivo. Ssd1 binds mRNAs of cell wall remodeling proteins; inhibiting Cbk1 rapidly represses their translation, and this repression requires Ssd1. In cbk1-as2 SSD1 cells, Cbk1 inhibition greatly depletes UTH1, SUN4, CTS1, SIM1, and TOS1 mRNAs from polysomes (19962308). The CTS1 3′UTR is sufficient for Ssd1-mediated translational control and binding (24465507).

Cbk1 inhibits Ssd1 in vivo. Ssd1 binds mRNAs of cell wall remodeling proteins; inhibiting Cbk1 rapidly represses their translation, and this repression requires Ssd1. In cbk1-as2 SSD1 cells, Cbk1 inhibition greatly depletes UTH1, SUN4, CTS1, SIM1, and TOS1 mRNAs from polysomes (19962308). Ssd1 controls translation through the 5′ and 3′UTRs of UTH1 mRNA (24465507).

Cbk1 inhibits Ssd1 in vivo. Ssd1 binds mRNAs of cell wall remodeling proteins; inhibiting Cbk1 rapidly represses their translation, and this repression requires Ssd1. In cbk1-as2 SSD1 cells, Cbk1 inhibition greatly depletes UTH1, SUN4, CTS1, SIM1, and TOS1 mRNAs from polysomes (19962308). Hyperactivating Ssd1 represses Sim1 translation (24465507).
Cbp1 は 5'UTR を介してシトクロム b（COB）mRNA の安定化と翻: Cbp1 promotes stabilization and translation of cytochrome b (COB) mRNA via its 5'UTR (15047869).
Cbp1 はミトコンドリアの 900 kDa の複合体の一部で、精製した複合体に: Cbp1 is part of a 900 kDa mitochondrial complex, and the purified complex contains Pet309 (15047869).
Cbp3 と Cbp4 が結びつき、高分子量の複合体に含まれる（15759116: Cbp3 and Cbp4 associate and are part of a high-molecular-weight complex (15759116). Cbp4 is part of the assembly intermediate of Cbp3-Cbp6 and cytochrome b (21670217).
Cbp3 と Cbp6 は複合体を作り、ミトリボソームのトンネル出口に付く（21: Cbp3 and Cbp6 form a complex that attaches to the tunnel exit of the mitoribosome (21670217).
Cch1-Mid1 のチャネルからの Ca2+ の流入がカルシニューリンを活性化: Ca2+ influx through the Cch1-Mid1 channel activates calcineurin (14517337). In mid1 and cch1 cells, the alkaline-induced Ca2+ rise and the response of calcineurin-dependent promoters are lost (15299026).
Ccl1-Kin28 複合体が Atg29 と Atg31 の発現を制御する（2: The Ccl1-Kin28 complex regulates expression of Atg29 and Atg31 (26567215).
Ccr4-Not は TORC1 の信号を活性化する。Ccr4-Not を壊すと: Ccr4-Not activates TORC1 signaling. Disrupting Ccr4-Not reduces TORC1 signaling globally, which is fully restored by a constitutively active Gtr1 mutant. Ccr4-Not activates TORC1 by enhancing vacuolar V-ATPase function (33064727).
Cct7 の G412E 変異株で CWI 経路の SED1・GFA1・PIR1: In the Cct7 G412E mutant, expression of the CWI pathway genes SED1, GFA1, PIR1, and RIM21 decreases (37964139).
Cdc1 はゴルジに局在する GPI アンカーのリモデラーゼ。cdc1 温度感受: Cdc1 is a Golgi-localized GPI anchor remodelase. Temperature-sensitive cdc1 mutants are defective in transport of the GPI protein Gas1 to the cell surface (33112703).
Cdc13 の核への局在に Msn5（Kap142）が重要。核の Cdc13 の: Msn5 (Kap142) is important for nuclear localization of Cdc13. The amount of nuclear Cdc13 strongly influences capping function (29432594).
Cdc14 が Sli15 を脱リン酸化すると Sli15-Ipl1 が紡錘体に: Dephosphorylation of Sli15 by Cdc14 moves Sli15-Ipl1 to the spindle (14605209). In anaphase, Cdc14 removes CDK-mediated phosphorylation of Sli15 to move the CPC to the spindle (37405742). CDK phosphorylation inhibits movement of Sli15 to the spindle. BioGRID's 22078879 is a paper on a model of dephosphorylation order, and its abstract does not specify the cyclin.
Cdc14 が核小体に保持されないと、Sld2・Dpb2 などの Cdk1 の基: When Cdc14 is not retained in the nucleolus, it dephosphorylates Cdk1 substrates such as Sld2 and Dpb2, and without Clb5, DNA replication becomes abnormal (17116692) (PMID: 17116692).
Cdc14 の脱リン酸化部位を網羅的に調べ、Bud3 の脱リン酸化が正常な細胞質: A comprehensive survey of Cdc14 dephosphorylation sites showed that dephosphorylation of Bud3 is required for normal cytokinesis (24319056).
Cdc14 は Cdk の活性を抑える 3 つの並行した仕組みで分裂期を終わらせ: Cdc14 ends mitosis by three parallel mechanisms that suppress Cdk activity, one of which is dephosphorylation of Swi5, the transcription factor for SIC1 (9885559). Dephosphorylation of Swi5 is said to act toward inhibiting Cdk through SIC1 expression, but what changes in Swi5 (such as nuclear entry) is not in the abstract, so confidence is medium.

Cdc14 ends mitosis by three parallel mechanisms that suppress Cdk activity. One of them is dephosphorylation of the Cdk inhibitor Sic1 (9885559). Dephosphorylation of Sic1 is said to act toward inhibiting Cdk, that is, to enhance Sic1 function.
Cdc14 は Crm1 と物理的に結合するロイシンに富む NES をもつ。NE: Cdc14 has a leucine-rich NES that physically binds Crm1. In NES mutants, Clb2 degradation and mitotic exit occur, but morphological abnormalities and cytokinesis defects appear. Localization of Cdc14 to the bud neck is lost with NES mutation and with inhibition of Crm1 by leptomycin B (15917648).
Cdc14 は Sli15 を脱リン酸化して Sli15-Ipl1 複合体を紡錘: Cdc14 dephosphorylates Sli15 to direct the Sli15-Ipl1 complex to the spindle. Separase-mediated activation of Cdc14 alone causes Sli15 dephosphorylation and relocation (14605209).
Cdc14 は分裂後期の初めに MEN とは独立に核小体から一部放出され、Bfa: At anaphase onset, Cdc14 is partially released from the nucleolus independently of the MEN and binds the SPB via Bfa1-Bub2. Later, at mitotic exit, it dephosphorylates Bfa1 to reactivate Bfa1-Bub2, turning off the MEN and removing Mob1 from the SPB (11970961).
Cdc14 は分裂期の終わりに Orc2・Orc6・Cdc6・Mcm3 を脱リン: At the end of mitosis, Cdc14 dephosphorylates Orc2, Orc6, Cdc6, and Mcm3, restoring their ability to assemble the pre-RC (20980394). Cdc14 removes a phosphodegron at the Cdc6 C terminus to stabilize Cdc6 in mitosis (35142288).
Cdc14 は分裂期の終了時に Orc2・Orc6・Cdc6・Mcm3 の CD: At mitotic exit, Cdc14 removes the inhibitory CDK phosphorylation of Orc2, Orc6, Cdc6, and Mcm3, restoring the ability to assemble the pre-RC. Without Cdc14 function, neither dephosphorylation nor pre-RC formation occurs even when CDK is inhibited, and combining non-phosphorylatable mutants makes Cdc14 dispensable (20980394).
Cdc14 は後期に rDNA の転写を抑える。Cdc14 の脱リン酸化酵素の活: Cdc14 represses rDNA transcription in anaphase. The phosphatase activity of Cdc14 is required for Pol I repression in vitro and in vivo, and repression is accompanied by exclusion of Pol I subunits from the nucleolus (19158678).
Cdc14 は後期に活性化されると Yen1 の核への蓄積と酵素の活性化を起こす: When activated in anaphase, Cdc14 causes nuclear accumulation and enzymatic activation of Yen1. Phosphomimetic Yen1 increases sister chromatid nondisjunction, and Yen1 lacking Cdk phosphorylation is constitutively active (24631283).
Cdc14 を止めると間期の rDNA 間隔領域と分裂期のサブテロメア Y' 領: Inactivating Cdc14 disrupts silencing at rDNA spacer regions in interphase and at subtelomeric Y' regions in mitosis. This function is independent of Sir2, and Cdc14 directly removes Ser2 and Ser5 phosphorylation of the Pol II CTD to repress transcription. The telomere segregation defect of cdc14 mutants is rescued by blocking Pol II transcription (22020438).
Cdc15 は細胞周期の大半で CDK 部位がリン酸化されて働きが抑えられ、分裂: Cdc15 is inhibited by phosphorylation of CDK sites during most of the cell cycle and is transiently dephosphorylated at the end of mitosis. Cdc14 removes the inhibitory phosphorylation in vitro and in vivo (10837230). Dephosphorylation by Cdc14 lets Cdc15 bind the daughter spindle pole and triggers cytokinesis (11267871).
Cdc20 は APC の基質 Pds1 の分解に必要で、Clb2・Ase1 に: Cdc20 is required for degradation of the APC substrate Pds1 but not of Clb2 or Ase1 (9334304). APC-Cdc20 targets Pds1 and Clb5 for degradation, enabling Cdc14 release and mitotic exit (10647015). BioGRID's 18498748, 22079111, and others are papers on the degradation of Acm1 and of Cdc20 itself.
Cdc24 が芽の出る場所へ運ばれるには Rsr1/Bud1 との結合が必要（1: Delivery of Cdc24 to the bud site requires binding to Rsr1/Bud1 (14988726). GTP-bound Bud1 binds Cdc24, and GDP-bound Bud1 binds Bem1 (9114012).
Cdc24 は Ste5 と結合し、Cdc24 がないと Ste5 の核への取り: Cdc24 binds Ste5; without Cdc24, nuclear import of Ste5 and its basal and pheromone-induced membrane recruitment stop, and Ste5-Ste4 complexes decrease. Ste5 does not accumulate even with a Cdc24 mutant (G168D) that retains GEF activity (15657049).
Cdc25 と Sdc25 は生体内で Ras1・Ras2 に直接結合し、GDP: Cdc25 and Sdc25 bind Ras1 and Ras2 directly in vivo, binding the GDP-bound form of Ras (1569942). Cdc25 removes GDP from Ras and allows GTP binding in vitro, acting as an activator of the RAS/cAMP pathway (2017169). In vivo measurement of activation specifically for Ras1 is not in the abstract.
Cdc28 による Bub1 T566 のリン酸化は後期の Bub1 の分解に重: Cdc28-mediated phosphorylation of Bub1 T566 is important for Bub1 degradation in anaphase and is required for spindle checkpoint adaptation to prolonged mitotic arrest (21298086).
Cdc28 による Pds1 のリン酸化は Esp1 との結合と Esp1 の核: Cdc28-mediated phosphorylation of Pds1 promotes its binding to Esp1 and nuclear localization of Esp1 (12050115). Cdk1-dependent phosphorylation near the D-box prevents APC-mediated ubiquitination of Pds1, which Cdc14 reverses (18552837).
Cdc28 によるリン酸化は Hct1（Cdh1）が APC を活性化する能力を: Phosphorylation by Cdc28 abolishes the ability of Hct1 (Cdh1) to activate the APC. Cdc14 dephosphorylates and activates Hct1, counteracting Cdc28 (10074450).
Cdc28 は Mer2/Rec107 を直接リン酸化して DSB 形成に要るタ: Cdc28 directly phosphorylates Mer2/Rec107, changing its binding to proteins required for DSB formation, and thereby directly regulates DSB formation for initiation of recombination (16814718). S-phase CDK (Cdc28-Clb5) is essential for initiation of meiotic recombination because it phosphorylates Mer2 S30 (18245450).
Cdc28 は Spc42 を直接リン酸化して SPB への組み込みを促し、Mp: Cdc28 directly phosphorylates Spc42 to promote its incorporation into the SPB, and this overlaps with a pathway via Mps1 phosphorylation to regulate SPB duplication (15296722). Mutating all eight Cdk sites in Spc42 is lethal and reduces centrosome assembly (21700874).
Cdc28 を活性化した Cln2 はリン酸化されてマルチユビキチン化され、これ: Cln2 that has activated Cdc28 is phosphorylated and multiubiquitinated, which requires Cdc34 and phosphorylation. Cdc34-mediated ubiquitination destabilizes Cln2 in vivo, and degradation is delayed in cdc34ts (7835341).
Cdc3 の C 末端の 2 つのセリンは Cdc28 依存でリン酸化され、リン: Two C-terminal serines of Cdc3 are phosphorylated in a Cdc28-dependent manner, and non-phosphorylatable mutants are impaired in disassembling the septin ring from the previous cycle. Phosphorylation by Cdc28 at the end of G1 promotes disassembly of the old ring (12429908).
Cdc31 のプルダウンで Sfi1 が取れ、Cdc31 は Sfi1 の個々の: Cdc31 pulldown recovers Sfi1, and Cdc31 binds individual Sfi1 repeats directly at 1:1 (14504268).
Cdc31 は試験管内で Mps3 に結合し、Cdc31 の SPB への局在は: Cdc31 binds Mps3 in vitro, and localization of Cdc31 to the SPB partly depends on Mps3. MPS3 is required for the first step of SPB duplication in G1 (12486115).
Cdc31p は Kar1p の必須領域に試験管内で結合し、生体内でも結びつく。: Cdc31p binds the essential region of Kar1p in vitro and also associates with it in vivo. kar1 mutations abolish SPB localization of Cdc31p (8188750).
Cdc34 と F-box タンパク質 Met30 は Cdk を抑えるキナーゼ: Cdc34 and the F-box protein Met30 are required for degradation of Swe1, the kinase that inhibits Cdk. Swe1 is stabilized in met30 mutants, and extracts from cdc34 and met30 mutants cannot polyubiquitinate Swe1 (9716410).
Cdc34 の生体内のリン酸化部位（S207・S216）を CK2 が試験管内で: CK2 phosphorylates the in vivo phosphorylation sites of Cdc34 (S207, S216) in vitro and enhances the activity of Cdc34-SCF(Cdc4) in ubiquitinating Sic1. Cells with highly active site mutants show faster Sic1 degradation and cell cycle progression (17461777). CK2 phosphorylates two sites in Cdc34, and S282 strongly affects MET gene expression in vivo (16952051). C-terminal phosphorylation by Cka2 appears (in a loopless Cdc34 mutant) to prevent formation of free ubiquitin chains and promote attachment to substrates (21453497). The phosphorylation itself is mainly shown in vitro, so confidence is medium.

CK2 phosphorylates the in vivo phosphorylation sites of Cdc34 (S207, S216) in vitro and enhances the activity of Cdc34-SCF(Cdc4) in ubiquitinating Sic1. Cells with highly active site mutants show faster Sic1 degradation and cell cycle progression (17461777). CK2 phosphorylates two sites in Cdc34, and S282 strongly affects MET gene expression in vivo (16952051). The phosphorylation itself is mainly shown in vitro, so confidence is medium.
Cdc34/SCF(Met30) は Met4 をユビキチン化するが分解はさせず: Cdc34/SCF(Met30) ubiquitinates Met4 without causing its degradation, and ubiquitinated Met4 cannot form functional transcription complexes even when bound to target promoters (10975521). A single K48-linked chain is attached to Met4 K163, and K163R makes Met4 constitutively active (15208638). BioGRID's PMID 21453497 is a paper on Cdc34 mutants, and Met4 does not appear in its abstract.
Cdc37 の S14 の CK2 によるリン酸化が HOG 経路と CWI 経: CK2-mediated phosphorylation of Cdc37 S14 controls the function of the HOG and CWI pathways. In cdc37-S14A, Hog1 and Slt2 levels decrease and downstream responses are impaired. Hog1 forms a complex with Cdc37 in vivo, and osmosensitivity results from loss of Cdc37–Hog1–Hsp90 interactions (17220467).
Cdc37 は CKII の生理的な基質で、体内の部位は S14・S17。リン酸: Cdc37 is a physiological substrate of CKII, with in vivo sites S14 and S17. Non-phosphorylatable cdc37-S14,17A has severe growth and morphology defects, partially restored by S14,17E (12435747). CK2-mediated phosphorylation is essential for Cdc37 to bind and stabilize kinases (review, 15659792).
Cdc37 は Ste11 のキナーゼ活性に要り、cdc37 変異では Ste1: Cdc37 is required for Ste11 kinase activity; in cdc37 mutants, Ste11-mediated pheromone signaling and accumulation and maturation of Ste11ΔN are impaired (10664467).
Cdc37 は cka2-13 の多コピー抑圧遺伝子で、CKII の生理的な基質: Cdc37 is a multicopy suppressor of cka2-13 and a physiological substrate of CKII (S14, S17). Non-phosphorylatable cdc37-S14,17A has severe growth and morphology defects, partially restored by S14,17E. CKII and Cdc37 form a positive feedback loop (12435747).
Cdc37 は新生キナーゼを分解から守り成熟を進める（17242065）。本文:: Cdc37 protects nascent kinases from degradation and promotes their maturation (17242065). Full text: Rim11 from cdc37S14A has reduced activity even when amounts are equalized.
Cdc37 は新生キナーゼを分解から守る（17242065）。本文: cdc37: Cdc37 protects nascent kinases from degradation (17242065). Full text: nascent Pho85 chains decrease in cdc37S14A and are restored by proteasome inhibition.
Cdc4/34/53 経路の変異で Cdc6 の分解が止まり、Cdc6 の N: Mutations in the Cdc4/34/53 pathway block Cdc6 degradation, and the Cdc6 N terminus interacts with this pathway, probably via Cdc4 (9312054).
Cdc42 と Bni1 の直接の結合は Bni1 の調節に要らず、Cdc42: Direct binding between Cdc42 and Bni1 is not required for Bni1 regulation; a new input via the Cdc42 effector Gic2 localizes Bni1 to the site and produces polarized actin (22918946, co-immunoprecipitation in the full text). The Gic2 W23A mutation prevents assembly of Bni1 and Bud6 at the presumptive bud site (10938101).
Cdc42 の拮抗因子 Nba1 が 2 段階で細胞質分裂の跡に積まれ、そこを: The Cdc42 antagonist Nba1 is deposited at cytokinesis remnants in two steps, making those sites refractory to a second round of Cdc42 activation. Mutants that lose this memory reuse the same site for many generations and show nuclear segregation defects and a short lifespan.
Cdc42 の活性は G1/S 期の移行と後期に高く、分裂期の終わりと細胞質分裂: Cdc42 activity is high at the G1/S transition and in anaphase and falls at mitotic exit and cytokinesis. Cdc5 is an upstream regulator that suppresses Cdc42 activity. In the full text, among cells arrested at mitotic exit, cdc15-2 (in which Cdc5 is active) has less GTP-bound Cdc42 than cdc5-2. Failure to lower Cdc42 disrupts localization of Iqg1 and Inn1 to the division site and causes abnormal septa.
Cdc45 の非構造ループは Rad53 自身にリン酸化され、そこに Rad53: The unstructured loop of Cdc45 is phosphorylated by Rad53 itself, and Rad53 binds there via its FHA domain. This binding is required for Sld3-mediated inhibition of origin firing, and Cdc45 also recruits Rad53 to stalled forks (30595439).
Cdc48 に結合できない Shp1 変異体を使い、Cdc48(Shp1) 複合: Using Shp1 mutants unable to bind Cdc48, the Cdc48(Shp1) complex was shown to be an important regulator of mitotic Glc7 activity (23418575).
Cdc48 の補因子 Ubx2 は Fzo1 の分解（ターンオーバー）を促す（3: The Cdc48 cofactor Ubx2 promotes degradation (turnover) of Fzo1 (31804690).
Cdc48 は G1-CDK 阻害因子 Far1 の分解を通して Start の: Cdc48 is required for execution of Start through degradation of the G1-CDK inhibitor Far1 (14557244).
Cdc48 は Hsh155 と物理的に結合し、相手のタンパク質との組み立てを制: Cdc48 physically binds Hsh155 and controls its assembly with partner proteins (33172985).
Cdc48 は Ubp12 の分解を促し、Fzo1 の融合を促すユビキチン化を安: Cdc48 promotes Ubp12 degradation, stabilizing the ubiquitination of Fzo1 that promotes fusion. Loss of Ubp12 stabilizes Ubp2 (29309037).
Cdc48 は補因子 Ubx3 と結合し、ともに H2B のモノユビキチン化を制: Cdc48 binds the cofactor Ubx3, and together they regulate H2B monoubiquitination (25183520).
Cdc48 アダプター Ubx5 の Cdc48 結合をなくすか Ubx5 を失: Abolishing Cdc48 binding by the Cdc48 adaptor Ubx5, or loss of Ubx5, suppresses the sensitivity of wss1Δ to DPC-inducing agents (37144685).
Cdc48-Shp1 は PP1 様ホスファターゼ Ppz2・Ppq1 に結合し: Cdc48-Shp1 binds the PP1-like phosphatases Ppz2 and Ppq1 and prevents their misfolding (25616896).
Cdc48-Shp1 は Ppz2・Ppq1 に結合し誤った折りたたみを防ぐ（2: Cdc48-Shp1 binds Ppz2 and Ppq1 and prevents their misfolding (25616896).
Cdc48-Ufd1 は SUMO 化した Rad52 に結合し、Rad52-R: Cdc48-Ufd1 binds SUMOylated Rad52, weakens Rad52-Rad51 binding, and removes them from DNA. Inhibiting it increases spontaneous recombination and causes abnormal Rad51 foci (23624404).
Cdc5 がまず Hof1 をリン酸化して Dbf2-Mob1 によるリン酸化を: Cdc5 first phosphorylates Hof1, enabling phosphorylation by Dbf2-Mob1, whereupon Hof1 leaves the septin ring, binds the central actomyosin ring, and promotes its contraction and membrane ingression (21498574). The direct action of Cdc5 is priming for Dbf2-Mob1 phosphorylation, so confidence is medium.
Cdc5 にリン酸化された Bfa1 は Bub2 と組んだ GAP 活性を失う: Bfa1 phosphorylated by Cdc5 loses GAP activity with Bub2 (while retaining Tem1 binding), so Tem1-GTP increases and cells exit mitosis (12637549, in vitro). Cdc5 phosphorylates Bfa1 to antagonize its function and promote mitotic exit. The spindle checkpoint inhibits this phosphorylation (11733064).
Cdc5 の前もってのリン酸化を足場に Dbf2-Mob1 が核小体に入り、Ne: Using prior phosphorylation by Cdc5 as a scaffold, Dbf2-Mob1 enters the nucleolus and phosphorylates Net1 (Cfi1) and Cdc14, activating Cdc14 (33481703; cited from the PMC full text). BioGRID's 16319894 and 16242037 are protein-chip (in vitro) data only.
Cdc5 の活性の維持に体内で Cdc28 からの信号が要り、Clb2-Cdc2: Maintaining Cdc5 activity requires signals from Cdc28 in vivo, and Clb2-Cdc28 is sufficient to activate Cdc5 in vitro. T242 in the activation loop is required for Cdc5 function in vivo and kinase activity in vitro and is phosphorylated in vivo. Polo kinase is activated upon mitotic entry (16303563).
Cdc5 は CLB2 群のプロモーターに呼ばれ、Mcm1-Fkh2-Ndd1: Cdc5 is recruited to CLB2-cluster promoters and directly phosphorylates Ndd1, the coactivator of the Mcm1-Fkh2-Ndd1 complex. This phosphorylation is required for normal G2/M expression of CLB2, SWI5, and others; without it, cell division is severely abnormal (17122856).
Cdc5 は Rho1 の GEF を介して、分裂部位への Rho1 の移動と活: Cdc5 controls relocation of Rho1 to the division site and its activation via the Rho1 GEF (16763112).
Cdc5 は Scc1（Mcd1）の切断部位の近くのセリンをリン酸化し、セパラー: Cdc5 phosphorylates serines near the cleavage sites of Scc1 (Mcd1) and strongly promotes cleavage by separase (11371343). Polo kinase-mediated phosphorylation of Scc1 promotes cleavage, and PP2A-Cdc55 antagonizes it to inhibit cleavage (22814605; the abstract calls Cdc5 Polo kinase).
Cdc5 は分裂期の細胞で Cse4 と結合し、体内の Cse4 のリン酸化に寄: Cdc5 binds Cse4 in mitotic cells, contributes to Cse4 phosphorylation in vivo, and phosphorylates nine N-terminal serines in vitro. Combined with mcm21Δ, cse4-9SA increases chromosome missegregation and reduces centromeric Mif2 and Mcd1 (30726152). The phenotype is seen only in combination with mcm21Δ, so confidence is medium.
Cdc5 は分裂期の終わりに Cdc14 を核小体から放出させるのに必要で、Cd: Cdc5 is required to release Cdc14 from the nucleolus at the end of mitosis, and raising Cdc5 activity releases Cdc14 even before anaphase (11960554). Cdc14 release caused by CDC5 overexpression coincides with the appearance of phosphorylated forms of Cdc14 and Net1, and Cdc5 promotes Cdc14 phosphorylation. It was proposed that release requires phosphorylation of both (14551257). The effect of Cdc14 phosphorylation itself is still at the proposal stage, and whether it is direct is not stated in the abstract. 19570916 proposes that Cdc5 acts mainly through Swe1 degradation, so confidence is medium.
Cdc5 は後期の Net1 のリン酸化状態を調節し、試験管内では Net1 を: Cdc5 regulates the phosphorylation state of Net1 in anaphase, and in vitro it phosphorylates Net1, lowering its affinity for Cdc14 and dissociating RENT. However, Cdc5-site mutants have only a small Cdc14-release defect, and it was proposed that Cdc5 acts mainly through other targets (11960554). 12056824 also proposes that Cdc5 affects the phosphorylation state of Net1 and lowers the Cdc14–Net1 affinity. 19570916 and 14551257 treat Net1 phosphorylation as an indirect effect via Swe1 degradation or the MEN. The direction is consistent, but directness is debated, so confidence is medium.
Cdc5 を欠く細胞は乗換えの解消に失敗し、モノポリンの Lrs4 と Mam1: Cells lacking Cdc5 fail to resolve crossovers, cannot properly localize the monopolin subunits Lrs4 and Mam1, and sister kinetochores bi-orient (12717442).
Cdc5-Spo13 は B 型サイクリン Clb1 を Ama1 の基質から阻: Cdc5-Spo13 inhibits Ama1 activity by converting the B-type cyclin Clb1 from an Ama1 substrate into an inhibitor (37728253).
Cdc50 は Drs2 と共沈し、cdc50 欠失では Drs2 が小胞体にと: Cdc50 co-precipitates with Drs2, and in cdc50 deletion Drs2 is retained in the ER (15090616).
Cdc55 がないとアクトミオシン環の収縮と一次隔壁の形成が片寄る。PP2A-C: Without Cdc55, actomyosin ring contraction and primary septum formation become asymmetric. PP2A-Cdc55 dephosphorylates Chs2 in vivo and in vitro, and non-phosphorylatable Chs2 rescues the contraction and septum defects of cdc55∆. Timely dephosphorylation of Chs2 is essential for contraction (35230542). Full text: S133 is hyperphosphorylated in cdc55∆, and chs2-S133A rescues the defects.
Cdc55 の表層・細胞質への局在に Zds1/Zds2 が必要で、無いと Cd: Localization of Cdc55 to the cortex and cytoplasm requires Zds1/Zds2; without them, Cdc55 accumulates in the nucleus. Zds1/2 promote Cdc55-PP2A for mitotic entry and inhibit it for mitotic exit (21536748).
Cdc55・Tpd3 は Tap42 の脱リン酸化を促し、直接の競合と脱リン酸化: Cdc55 and Tpd3 promote dephosphorylation of Tap42 and prevent binding of Tap42 to Pph21/22 and Sit4 by both direct competition and dephosphorylation (10329624).
Cdc6 の Cdc28 部位のリン酸化は SCF-Cdc4 による分解に要り、: Phosphorylation of Cdc28 sites in Cdc6 is required for its degradation by SCF-Cdc4 and is mainly carried out by Clb-Cdc28 (10512865). With CDK activity, Cdc6 does not bind origins, and Cdc6 lacking CDK sites reloads onto chromatin in G2/M (17267692). There is also a report that Cdc6 inhibits Cdc28 (8930895).
Cdc6 の分解は G1 後期から S 期の初めに最も速く、Cdc4/34/53: Cdc6 degradation is fastest from late G1 to early S phase and is blocked by mutations in the Cdc4/34/53 pathway. The N-terminal 47 residues are required for interaction with this pathway (9312054). BioGRID's 10512865 is a paper on in vitro ubiquitination by SCF-Cdc4, and Cdc34 does not appear in its abstract.
Cdc6 は Sic1 と同じく CDK 複合体に結合し、分裂期の終わりに CD: Like Sic1, Cdc6 binds CDK complexes and contributes to CDK inactivation at the end of mitosis. Cdc6 lacking the CDK-binding region delays mitotic exit, and the delay is worsened without Sic1 or cyclin degradation (11460169). Cdc6 binds mitotic cyclins via its LxF motif and inhibits M-CDK via Cks1 (31101497).
Cdc6 は分裂期に N 末端のリン酸化を介して Clb2 に強く結合され、ライ: In mitosis, Cdc6 is tightly bound by Clb2 through N-terminal phosphorylation, which inhibits licensing. PP2A-Cdc55 dephosphorylates N-terminal sites of Cdc6 to release Clb2 and, together with Cdc14-mediated dephosphorylation and Sic1, promotes licensing (35142288).
Cdc60 はロイシンに依存して EGOC の Gtr1 と結合し、この結合はロ: Cdc60 binds Gtr1 of the EGOC in a leucine-dependent manner, and this binding is necessary and sufficient to transmit the leucine signal to TORC1 (22424774).
Cdc7 のキナーゼ活性は G1 期に低く S 期に上がり分裂期の終わりまで高い: Cdc7 kinase activity is low in G1, rises in S phase, and stays high until the end of mitosis. Cdc7 levels are constant, and the activity changes follow Dbf4 levels. Overexpression of Dbf4 in G1 increases Cdc7 activity (10373538).
Cdc7 の免疫沈降物が試験管内で GST-Rev7 をリン酸化し、Rev7 は: Cdc7 immunoprecipitates phosphorylate GST-Rev7 in vitro, and Rev7 binds mainly Cdc7. DDK is required for generating complex mutations characteristic of Polζ (24875188).
Cdc7 は Start で止めた細胞では低リン酸化で不活性、Start を過ぎ: Cdc7 is hypophosphorylated and inactive in cells arrested at Start, and after Start it is activated and maximally phosphorylated. Proteins in yeast extracts phosphorylate and activate Cdc7, and this phosphorylation is heat-sensitive in extracts from cdc28 mutants. S→A mutations in the Cdc28 recognition sites change the phosphorylation pattern (8382976).
Cdc7 は減数分裂の DSB と第一分裂の進行に必須で、Mer2 の N 末端: Cdc7 is essential for meiotic DSBs and progression of meiosis I, and among the Cdc7-dependent phosphorylation sites at the Mer2 N terminus, S29 is essential for DSB formation. In cdc7Δ, chromatin binding of Spo11, Rec114, and Mei4 drops (18245451). CDK-S phosphorylation of Mer2 S30 primes DDK phosphorylation of S29, and the negatively charged "patch" is required for DSB formation (18245450).
Cdc7 は試験管内で Cse4 をリン酸化し、体内で細胞周期に依存して結合する: Cdc7 phosphorylates Cse4 in vitro and binds it in a cell cycle-dependent manner in vivo. In cdc7-7, CEN Cse4 decreases, its exchange at metaphase kinetochores accelerates, and segregation becomes defective. Non-phosphorylatable Cse4 mutants show chromosome instability (34432494). In vivo phosphorylation was not shown directly, so confidence is medium.
Cdc7-Dbf4 は Mcm2 と結合しリン酸化する。G1/S の移行で Cd: Cdc7-Dbf4 binds and phosphorylates Mcm2. Inactivating Cdc7 at the G1/S transition also blocks Mcm2 phosphorylation (9407029). DDK phosphorylates Mcm2 S164 and S170, and S170 phosphorylation is required for growth (19692334).
Cdc7-Dbf4 を欠くと複製ストレスで Rad53 が低リン酸化のままで、チ: Without Cdc7-Dbf4, Rad53 remains hypophosphorylated under replication stress and checkpoint transcription does not occur. Recombinant Cdc7-Dbf4 phosphorylates Rad53 in vitro (18372119).
Cdc9 を分解すると Elg1 がないときと同じく PCNA がクロマチンにた: Degrading Cdc9 causes PCNA to accumulate on chromatin, as in the absence of Elg1. Okazaki fragment ligation is a prerequisite for PCNA unloading by Elg1-RLC (26212319).
Cdh1 は G1 期に核にあり、S 期から分裂期の終わりまで細胞質に移る。運び: Cdh1 is nuclear in G1 and moves to the cytoplasm from S phase until the end of mitosis. Export depends on phosphorylation and Cdc28 activity; Cdh1 binds Msn5, and Msn5 is necessary and sufficient for export in vivo. A constitutively nuclear Cdh1 mutant prevents Clb2 accumulation and arrests the cell cycle. It was concluded that phosphorylation-dependent export by Msn5 contributes to inactivation of APC/C-Cdh1 (12456658).
Cdk と Cla4 は Fus2 S67 をリン酸化して核に留める（22588: Cdk and Cla4 phosphorylate Fus2 S67 and retain it in the nucleus (22588722).
Cdk にリン酸化された Nur1 は Net1 と結合して Cdc14 の放出: Nur1 phosphorylated by Cdk binds Net1 and inhibits Cdc14 release (25569132).
Cdk1 が Xbp1 の S146・S271・S551 をリン酸化し、アラニン: Cdk1 phosphorylates Xbp1 at S146, S271, and S551, and alanine substitution increases binding to Rpd3 and DSB repair (21467995). Xbp1 is a G1-CDK substrate with a K/R motif specific to Cln1 and Cln2 (34502421).
Cdk1 と Ime2 は Sum1 の抑制複合体を抑えて減数分裂の前期から脱出: Cdk1 and Ime2 inhibit the Sum1 repressor complex to allow exit from meiotic prophase, and sum1-ci, which is resistant to both, arrests in prophase (20385771). Cdk1 with Clb5 phosphorylates CDK sites in Sum1, which are required for removal of Sum1 from the NDT80 promoter (24710277).
Cdk1 と MEN は互いに調節し合い、Cdk1 は Mob1 をリン酸化して: Cdk1 and the MEN regulate each other, and Cdk1 phosphorylates Mob1 to inhibit Dbf2-Mob1 kinase activity. Only the triple mutant lacking BUB2 and all Cdk1 sites in Mob1 and Cdc15 shows abnormal mitotic exit (20123997). BioGRID's 14574415 is a large-scale screen.
Cdk1 と Nup1 の二つの Cdk 部位（本文: S161・T344）が: Cdk1 and two Cdk sites in Nup1 (full text: S161, T344) are required for perinuclear localization of INO1 and GAL1, and D substitution eliminates the need for Cdk1 (20702586).
Cdk1 による Ase1 のリン酸化は Cin8 の極間微小管への結合を妨げ、: Cdk1-mediated phosphorylation of Ase1 prevents Cin8 binding to interpolar microtubules, preventing spindle bending and collapse in metaphase. In anaphase, dephosphorylation of Ase1 by Cdc14 is necessary and sufficient for Cin8 accumulation at the midzone (19686685).
Cdk1 による Swe1 のリン酸化は Swe1 を活性化し、Cdk1 を抑え: Cdk1-mediated phosphorylation of Swe1 activates Swe1 and is required for the stable complex that keeps Cdk1 inhibited. Upon Cdk1 dephosphorylation, further phosphorylation occurs and Cdk1 dissociates (16096060). The activating phosphorylation of Swe1 depends on N260 and K270 of Clb2 and is specific to Clb2 (18558651). Direct phosphorylation by Clb2-Cdc28 primes hyperphosphorylation by Cdc5 and degradation (15920482).
Cdk1 によるセキュリン（Pds1）のリン酸化は APC によるユビキチン化を: Cdk1-mediated phosphorylation of securin (Pds1) prevents APC-mediated ubiquitination, and Cdc14 removes this phosphorylation to accelerate ubiquitination. Because separase activates Cdc14, this forms a positive feedback loop (18552837).
Cdk1 によるリン酸化は S 期の転写因子 4 つの分解に必要で、リン酸化でき: Cdk1-mediated phosphorylation is required for degradation of four S-phase transcription factors; non-phosphorylatable repressors Yox1 and Yhp1 bind promoters more, and target gene expression decreases. Cdk1 inactivates the repressors to promote late gene expression (24714560).

Cdk1-mediated phosphorylation is required for degradation of four S-phase transcription factors; non-phosphorylatable repressors Yox1 and Yhp1 bind promoters more, and target gene expression decreases (24714560).
Cdk1 に依存した Dna2 の T4・S17・S237 のリン酸化が、Dna: Cdk1-dependent phosphorylation of Dna2 at T4, S17, and S237 promotes Dna2 recruitment to DSBs, end resection, and phosphorylation by Mec1. Site mutants are poorly recruited and can resect only when Exo1 is present (21841787). BioGRID's 35977012 is a synthetic biology sensor paper using NLS/NES of Dna2 and others, and 14574415 is a large-scale screen.
Cdk1 に依存する Rad9 の S11 のリン酸化が Dpb11 との特異的: Cdk1-dependent phosphorylation of Rad9 S11 confers specific binding to Dpb11, enabling Rad53 activation. Full text: Rad9-Dpb11 binding in mitosis requires Cdk1 phosphorylation. Results under UV irradiation (20700441).
Cdk1 のリン酸化で Ame1 のリン酸化デグロンができ SCF-Cdc4 に: Cdk1 phosphorylation creates a phosphodegron in Ame1 that is recognized by SCF-Cdc4. Phosphorylation peaks in M phase and leads to degradation. Binding to the Mtw1 complex protects it (34308839).
Cdk1 のリン酸化は Ame1 のリン酸化デグロンを活性化し、SCF-Cdc4: Cdk1 phosphorylation activates a phosphodegron in Ame1, causing it to be recognized by SCF-Cdc4 and degraded toward M phase. Binding of the Mtw1 complex masks the proximal degron and protects Ame1 on kinetochores (34308839).
Cdk1 の活性を抑えると出芽首へのアクチンの集まりが早まり、Cdk1 に依存す: Inhibiting Cdk1 activity accelerates actin accumulation at the bud neck, and the Cdk1-dependent phosphorylation state of Iqg1 sets the timing of Iqg1 and actin localization to the bud neck. In non-phosphorylatable Iqg1 mutants, both accumulate early (24413167). iqg1-4A, with four Cdk sites changed to alanine, forms the actin ring before anaphase and shows defects in myosin contraction and cytokinesis (26085509).
Cdk1 は Fun30 の S28 をリン酸化し、DSB 末端の削り込みなど: Cdk1 phosphorylates Fun30 S28 and enhances its functions in the DNA damage response such as DSB end resection. This phosphorylation increases upon DNA damage, and recruitment of Cdk1 with Clb2 and Clb5 to DSBs is required for the phosphorylation and checkpoint activation (26801641).
Cdk1 は Ipl1 の N 末端の 2 つのセリンをリン酸化し、後期が始まる: Cdk1 phosphorylates two N-terminal serines of Ipl1 and inhibits its binding to Bim1 until anaphase onset. Without phosphorylation, Ipl1 localizes prematurely to the metaphase spindle and Bim1 is constitutively phosphorylated (22521784). BioGRID's 14574415 is a large-scale screen.
Cdk1 は Mob1 をリン酸化して Dbf2-Mob1 キナーゼの活性を抑え: Cdk1 phosphorylates Mob1 to inhibit Dbf2-Mob1 kinase activity, suppressing the MEN at the mother-side SPB (abstract of 20123997). The full text shows that Cdc14 dephosphorylates Mob1 in vitro, that Cdc14 overexpression dephosphorylates Mob1 in metaphase, and that Mob1 dephosphorylation depends on Cdc14 activity. It discusses that Cdc14-mediated dephosphorylation relieves Cdk1 inhibition and fully activates the MEN. Because this is at the discussion stage, confidence is medium.
Cdk1 は Myo2 と液胞をつなぐアダプター Vac17 をリン酸化し、リン: Cdk1 phosphorylates Vac17, the adaptor linking Myo2 to the vacuole, and phosphorylation parallels cell cycle-dependent vacuole movement. Substituting the Cdk1 sites reduces binding to Myo2 and partially impairs vacuole inheritance (18804442).
Cdk1 は Srs2 を DSB の修復、特に SDSA の完了に向かわせ、リ: Cdk1 directs Srs2 toward DSB repair, especially completion of SDSA, and Srs2 lacking phosphorylation shows recombination defects and accumulation of SUMOylation (20195513). Srs2 is phosphorylated in a Cdk1-dependent manner upon DNA damage, and srs2-7AV is hypersensitive to DNA damage in S phase (15964827).
Cdk1 は Stn1 の T223・S250 を試験管内と生体内でリン酸化し、: Cdk1 phosphorylates Stn1 T223 and S250 in vitro and in vivo, and this phosphorylation is essential for stability of the telomeric CST complex (24164896). S-phase cyclins mediate phosphorylation of Cdc13 and mitotic cyclins that of Stn1, with opposite outcomes at telomeres (28650257).
Cdk1 は Wee1（Swe1）をリン酸化して活性化するが、PP2A(Cdc5: Cdk1 phosphorylates and activates Wee1 (Swe1), but PP2A(Cdc55) counteracts this initial phosphorylation, creating a threshold that suppresses Wee1 activation (PMID 21849476). 35142288 is a paper on Cdc6 and does not mention Swe1.
Cdk1 はセパレース Esp1 をリン酸化して活性化し後期を始めさせる。PP2: Cdk1 phosphorylates and activates the separase Esp1 to initiate anaphase. PP2A-Cdc55 and Slk19 oppose this and, redundantly with Pds1, inhibit Esp1 around kinetochores (29561844). Full text: PP2A-Cdc55 dephosphorylates Esp1 in vitro, and Esp1 phosphorylation in vivo increases in cdc55Δ, but esp1-3A does not suppress cdc55Δ, so binding rather than dephosphorylation may mediate the inhibition. Pph22 as the catalytic subunit was not examined directly, so confidence is medium.
Cdk1 はリン酸化で Esp1 を活性化して後期を始め、PP2A-Cdc55: Cdk1 activates Esp1 by phosphorylation to initiate anaphase, and PP2A-Cdc55 and Slk19 oppose this. Both, redundantly with Pds1, inhibit Esp1 around kinetochores (29561844).
Cdk1 はリン酸化で Esp1（セパレース）を活性化して後期を始め、PP2A-: Cdk1 activates Esp1 (separase) by phosphorylation to initiate anaphase, and PP2A-Cdc55 and Slk19 counteract this. With phosphomimetic ESP1, premature spindle elongation occurs when Pds1 is degraded (29561844).
Cdk1 は母細胞側の SPB への Cdc15 の結合を負に調節する。Mob1: Cdk1 negatively regulates Cdc15 binding to the mother-side SPB. Simultaneous loss of the Cdk1 sites in Mob1 and Cdc15 and of BUB2 causes abnormal mitotic exit (20123997).
Cdk1 を活性化できない細胞では APC-Cdh1 が働き続け、Cin8・Ki: In cells unable to activate Cdk1, APC-Cdh1 remains active and degrades Cin8, Kip1, and Ase1, so no spindle forms (16688214).
Cdk1 依存の Cdc13 のリン酸化は、Stn1-Ten1 より Est1: Cdk1-dependent phosphorylation of Cdc13 favors binding to Est1 over Stn1-Ten1 and is required to recruit telomerase to telomeres (19135888). Cdk1 phosphorylates Cdc13 T308 and S336, and site mutations cause cell cycle delay and telomere shortening. Phosphorylation is also required for normal Cdc13 degradation (19359360).
Cdk1（Cdc28）は Ipl1 の N 末端の 2 つのセリンを直接リン酸化: Cdk1 (Cdc28) directly phosphorylates two N-terminal serines of Ipl1 and inhibits its binding to Bim1 until anaphase. Non-phosphorylatable Ipl1 moves prematurely to the metaphase spindle and constitutively phosphorylates Bim1, and when both Ipl1 and Sli15 are non-phosphorylatable, growth is severely impaired (22521784). The abstract does not specify the cyclin, so confidence is medium.
Cdk8 にリン酸化された Med3 は Grr1 ユビキチンリガーゼに結合して: Med3 phosphorylated by Cdk8 binds the Grr1 ubiquitin ligase and is degraded, ending transcriptional activation (24550274).
Cet1 の C 末端ドメインは Tup1 と試験管内で結合し、Tup1-Ssn: The C-terminal domain of Cet1 binds Tup1 in vitro, and Tup1-Ssn6 co-purifies with Cet1 (12637515).
Cet1-Ceg1 の結晶構造で Cet1 二量体が WAQKW モチーフで C: In the crystal structure of Cet1-Ceg1, the Cet1 dimer binds two Ceg1 molecules via the WAQKW motif (20159466).
Cex1 は COPI 被覆の Sec27・Sec28・Sec33（Ret1/C: Cex1 interacts with the COPI coat subunits Sec27, Sec28, and Sec33 (Ret1/Cop1) (33753324).
Cex1 は COPI 被覆の Sec33（Ret1/Cop1）と相互作用し、S: Cex1 interacts with the COPI coat subunit Sec33 (Ret1/Cop1) and localizes to Sec33-positive structures (33753324).
Cfd1 が欠けると Nbp35 への鉄の結合と放出が遅くなる。Cfd1-Nbp: Without Cfd1, iron binding to and release from Nbp35 are slowed. The model is that Cfd1-Nbp35 binding facilitates transfer of FeS on the scaffold (23798678).
Cfd1 と Nbp35 はヘテロ四量体を作り、細胞質の FeS タンパク質の成: Cfd1 and Nbp35 form a heterotetramer essential for maturation of cytosolic FeS proteins. In yeast, about half of each is detected as the complex (23798678).
Cgi121 は Bud32・Kae1・Gon7 とともに KEOPS 複合体を: Cgi121 forms the KEOPS complex with Bud32, Kae1, and Gon7 (16564010). The crystal structure of the Bud32/Cgi121 complex was determined (25735745).
Cgr1 の機能を失うと 5'-ITS1 RNA と Nop1 が一部核質へ散ら: Loss of Cgr1 function partially disperses 5'-ITS1 RNA and Nop1 into the nucleoplasm. Cgr1 contributes to nucleolar compartmentalization (11932453).
ChIP で Adr1 は ADH2・ACS1・GUT1・CTA1・POT1 の: ChIP shows Adr1 acting directly at the ADH2, ACS1, GUT1, CTA1, and POT1 promoters. Without glucose, Snf1 promotes Adr1 binding to chromatin; with glucose, Glc7 and Reg1 prevent it (12167649).
ChIP で Bas1 が ADE1・ADE2・ADE4・ADE5,7 のプロモ: ChIP shows Bas1 binding the ADE1, ADE2, ADE4, and ADE5,7 promoters and recruiting Pho2 under purine limitation to activate ADE genes (16215179). Maximal ADE2 expression requires Bas1, Bas2, and Gcn4 (8299166).
ChIP で Ctf3・Mcm22・Mcm16 が Ctf19 依存的にセントロ: ChIP showed that Ctf3, Mcm22, and Mcm16 bind centromeric DNA in a Ctf19-dependent manner (11782448).
ChIP で Ctf3・Mcm22・Mcm16 の CEN DNA への結合が: ChIP shows that binding of Ctf3, Mcm22, and Mcm16 to CEN DNA depends on Ctf19 (11782448).
ChIP で Gat1 は Gln3 がなくても DAL5 プロモーターに結合す: ChIP shows Gat1 binding the DAL5 promoter even without Gln3 (18245087). Rapamycin-induced DAL5 expression and Gat1 binding depend on PP2A (20974806).
ChIP で Ino2 は誘導前の INM1 プロモーターにあり、誘導で外れる（: ChIP shows Ino2 at the INM1 promoter before induction, and it leaves upon induction (25211324).
ChIP-seq で Yrr1 は既知の標的 SNG1 に加えて RPL35B: ChIP-seq shows Yrr1 binding upstream of RPL35B in addition to its known target SNG1 (29208650).
Chk1 と Rad53 の経路はどちらも APC/C-Cdc20 による Pd: Both the Chk1 and Rad53 pathways inhibit APC/C-Cdc20-mediated ubiquitination of Pds1, but the Rad53 pathway prevents Pds1-Cdc20 binding, whereas Chk1-mediated phosphorylation of Pds1 inhibits the ubiquitination reaction itself (12947083).
Chk1 の C デグロンは Ubr1 と Ufd4 の両方に認識され、活性化で: The C-degron of Chk1 is recognized by both Ubr1 and Ufd4, and it is exposed upon activation, making Chk1 short-lived (41945440).
Chk1 は野生型ではゆっくり分解されるが、NatA を欠く細胞では Arg/N: Chk1 is degraded slowly in wild type, but in cells lacking NatA, the Arg/N-end rule pathway (Ubr1) recognizes a degron near the C terminus and degrades it rapidly (28515311). The C-terminal degron of Chk1 is recognized by Ubr1 and Ufd4; removing the last four residues blocks polyubiquitination and degradation, and growth stops due to its kinase activity. It is proposed that the degron is exposed upon activation, making Chk1 short-lived (41945440). The abstract of 28515311 refers to Ubr1 as the Arg/N-end rule pathway.
Chl4 と Iml3 は安定な複合体を作り、Mif2 と Sgo1 に結合する: Chl4 and Iml3 form a stable complex that binds Mif2 and Sgo1. The structure of the Iml3-Chl4 heterodimer was determined (24075991).
Chm7 の核膜孔の組み立て部位への動員は ESCRT-II ドメインと LEM: Recruitment of Chm7 to sites of nuclear pore assembly is mediated by its ESCRT-II domain and the LEM proteins Heh1 and Heh2. Direct binding of Heh2 to the open form of Chm7 was shown (27733427).
Chm7 は Xpo1/Crm1 で核外に出され、Heh1 と空間的に隔てられて: Chm7 is exported from the nucleus by Xpo1/Crm1 and is spatially separated from Heh1. When the inner nuclear membrane is exposed, Heh1 locally activates Chm7 (30942170).
Chm7 は Xpo1/Crm1 で能動的に核外に出され、内核膜の Heh1 か: Chm7 is actively exported from the nucleus by Xpo1/Crm1 and kept separate from Heh1 in the inner nuclear membrane (30942170).
Chp1 が無いと eEF1A の生合成が乱れ、分解・凝集・Hsf1 によるスト: Without Chp1, eEF1A biogenesis is disrupted, causing degradation, aggregation, and Hsf1-mediated activation of stress transcription (38360885).
Chs2 の小胞体からの搬出には、Cdc14 による Cdk1 の抑制的なリン酸: Export of Chs2 from the ER requires direct dephosphorylation of the inhibitory Cdk1 phosphorylation sites by Cdc14. Only Cdc14 released by the MEN, not by FEAR, triggers export (22072794). Dephosphorylation by Cdc14 lets Chs2 be packaged into COPII vesicles (23525003).
Chs3 はパルミトイル化され、その修飾は Pfa4 に依存する。パルミトイル化: Chs3 is palmitoylated, and this modification depends on Pfa4. Palmitoylation is required for ER export of Chs3; without it, Chs3 forms high-molecular-weight aggregates in the ER (16818716).
Chs4 の結合相手の探索で Gin4 が見つかり、結合が確かめられた。Chs4: A search for Chs4 binding partners found Gin4, and the binding was confirmed. Chs4 phosphorylation partly depends on Gin4, and Gin4 is required for proper localization of Chs4 to the bud neck.
Chs5 は Chs6 とその 3 つのパラログ Bch1・Bud7・Bch2: Chs5 forms a ~1 MDa complex with Chs6 and its three paralogs Bch1, Bud7, and Bch2 (16855022).
Chs5 はエクソマー（Chs5/6 複合体）の足場で、chs5Δ では複合体に: Chs5 is the scaffold of the exomer (Chs5/6 complex), and in chs5Δ, Chs3 bound to the complex is greatly reduced (16855022). Transport of Chs3 from the TGN/early endosome to the cell surface requires CHS5 and CHS6, and in mutants Chs3 is trapped in the TGN/early endosome (11879634).
Chz1 は H2AZ-H2B と三量体を作り二量体を安定にし、SWR1 による: Chz1 forms a trimer with H2AZ-H2B, stabilizes the dimer, and delivers H2AZ for SWR1-mediated replacement (17289584).
Cia1・Cia2・Met18 が標的化複合体を作り、Cia2 が組織の中心。M: Cia1, Cia2, and Met18 form the targeting complex, with Cia2 as the organizing center. The Met18-Cia2 subcomplex can recognize Rad3 (28539047).
Cik1 と Vik1 は Kar3 とヘテロ二量体をつくり、細胞周期に応じて: Cik1 and Vik1 form heterodimers with Kar3 and regulate Kar3 localization and function according to the cell cycle (37305999).
Cim1 欠失は Abf2 欠失の mtDNA 維持の欠陥を和らげ、Cim1 過: Deletion of Cim1 alleviates the mtDNA maintenance defect of Abf2 deletion, and the defect of excess Cim1 is alleviated by excess Abf2 (37850632).
Cin8 がないと Ipl1 と Ase1 が両極性の紡錘体形成に必要になり、A: Without Cin8, Ipl1 and Ase1 become required for bipolar spindle formation, and ASE1 overexpression fully restores spindle formation in cin8 ipl1. ase1 lacking the Ipl1 consensus sites cannot form spindles without Cin8, and in ipl1 mutants Ase1 phosphorylation and localization change (17765685). Direct phosphorylation is not shown in the abstract, so confidence is medium.
Cin8 と Kip1 の蓄積（SPB の分離に要る）には Cdk1 と Pol: Accumulation of Cin8 and Kip1 (required for SPB separation) requires inactivation of Cdh1 by sequential phosphorylation by Cdk1 and Polo kinase (Cdc5). Cdk1 phosphorylation creates a Cdc5-binding site, and Cdc5 further phosphorylates Cdh1 (18500339).
Cin8 は分裂期の終わりから G1 に速く分解され、その分解には APC と: Cin8 is rapidly degraded from the end of mitosis into G1, which requires the APC and Cdh1 (not Cdc20). A degradation sequence including a C-terminal KEN box and an NLS are required (11694576). In cells unable to activate Cdk1, APC-Cdh1 remains active and degrades Cin8, Kip1, and Ase1, so no spindle forms (16688214). BioGRID's 23707760 is a structural paper on Acm1-Cdh1, and Cin8 does not appear in its abstract.
Cin8 は後期に運動ドメインの Cdk1 部位でリン酸化され、紡錘体から外れて: In anaphase, Cin8 is phosphorylated at Cdk1 sites in its motor domain, detaches from the spindle, and spindle elongation slows. Non-phosphorylatable Cin8-3A stays on the spindle longer and elongation is faster (21378308). The same phosphorylation weakens microtubule binding (27216310). In 20463882, Cin8 is shown only as an in vitro substrate.
Cip1 の発現はストレスの因子 Msn2/4 に制御される。題名: 環境ストレ: Cip1 expression is regulated by the stress factors Msn2/4. Title: environmental stress activates Cip1, which inhibits Cdk1–G1 cyclin via Mcm1 and Msn2/4 (28676626).
Cip1 の発現は細胞周期の因子 Mcm1 とストレスの因子 Msn2/4 に制: Cip1 expression is regulated by the cell cycle factor Mcm1 and the stress factors Msn2/4 (28676626).
Cip1 の蓄積は主に Cdk1-Cln3 を標的とし、Whi5 のリン酸化と: Accumulated Cip1 mainly targets Cdk1-Cln3 and suppresses Whi5 phosphorylation and early G1 progression (28676626).
Civ1（Cak1）は Cdc28 に結合してリン酸化し、サイクリンの結合による: Civ1 (Cak1) binds and phosphorylates Cdc28, enabling its activation by cyclin binding. In civ1-4, Cdc28 phosphorylation and activity drop (8752211). Most Cdc28 is phosphorylated on T169 throughout the cell cycle and is best activated when phosphorylated before cyclin binding. T169A binds cyclins weakly (10793138).
Cka1 は Ycf1 の N 末端の S251 をリン酸化して Ycf1 の働: Cka1 phosphorylates S251 at the N terminus of Ycf1 and negatively regulates Ycf1 function. Without CKA1, S251 phosphorylation in vivo nearly disappears, and purified Cka1 phosphorylates an S251-containing peptide. Under high-salt stress, Ycf1 function is induced, correlating well with reduced S251 phosphorylation, and Cka1 activity in vivo also decreases (20812950).
Ckb1・Ckb2 は生体内での Ptc2-Rad53 FHA1 結合に必要。c: Ckb1 and Ckb2 are required for Ptc2–Rad53 FHA1 binding in vivo. ckb2Δ is defective in adaptation and recovery after a DSB. It is suggested that CK2 phosphorylates Ptc2 T376 (17325030).
Cla4 で極性キャップに局在した Lte1 は Clb-Cdk に依存してリン: Lte1, localized to the polarity cap by Cla4, is phosphorylated in a Clb-Cdk-dependent manner and moves throughout the bud cortex, where it prevents activation of Ras and Bud1, suppressing polarized growth during mitotic arrest (21149565). Localization of Lte1 to the bud cortex requires Cdc28-Cln activity at START, and Cdc14-mediated dephosphorylation releases it from the cortex (12432084).
Cla4 のキナーゼ活性は体内で GTP 型の Cdc42 により活性化され、分: Cla4 kinase activity is activated in vivo by GTP-bound Cdc42 and is highest around mitosis (9271384).
Cla4 の活性がまず Lte1 を極性キャップ、つまり芽に局在させ、その後の: Cla4 activity first localizes Lte1 to the polarity cap, that is, the bud, which is a prerequisite for subsequent phosphorylation by Clb-Cdk (21149565).
Cla4 はセプチンに直接結合しリン酸化し、セプチンの環の形成には GTP 結合: Cla4 binds and phosphorylates septins directly, and septin ring formation requires GTP binding and Cla4 phosphorylation (14993234). Full text: more than half of the in vivo phosphorylation of Cdc10 depends on Cla4, at sites S256 and S312.
Clb-CDK1 は中期に Rad53 の S774 をリン酸化するが、DNA: Clb-CDK1 phosphorylates Rad53 S774 in metaphase, but this does not affect DNA damage or replication checkpoint function (19801655). Cdc28 and Cdc5 phosphorylate Rad53, and loss of the sites accelerates adaptation (20046099).
Clb2 の PP の変異は、試験管内で APC/C の Cdc16・Cdc27: Mutation of the Clb2 PP reduces multisite phosphorylation of the APC/C subunits Cdc16 and Cdc27 and of the polarity complex proteins Bud6 and Spa2 in vitro. Full text: tested with a Spa2 fragment (residues 524–670) (40341598).
Clb2-Cdk1 は Exo84 を直接リン酸化し、エキソシストの組み立てと分: Clb2-Cdk1 directly phosphorylates Exo84, preventing exocyst assembly and secretion and halting growth of mitotic cells (23836930). At the end of G1, Cdk1 also phosphorylates Exo84 and inhibits secretion and growth (31171719).
Clb3-Cdk1 に特異的な γ-チューブリンのリン酸化を示した（240194: γ-tubulin phosphorylation specific to Clb3-Cdk1 was shown (24019491). D substitution of the conserved Cdk site S360 of Tub4 causes mitotic delay and anaphase spindle defects (21700874).
Clb3-Cdk1 は PxxPxF モチーフを介して Ypr174c（Csa1: Clb3-Cdk1 phosphorylates Ypr174c (Csa1) via the PxxPxF motif and regulates localization of the Polo kinase Cdc5 (abstract of 32553169). The full text states that Csa1 phosphorylation aids localization of Cdc5 to the SPB before anaphase (cited from the PMC full text).
Clb3・Clb4 は S 期初めから分裂期まで発現し、Cdc28 と結合してキ: Clb3 and Clb4 are expressed from early S phase to mitosis and bind Cdc28 to generate kinase activity (8455600). Multiple clb deletions fail to form spindles (1387566).
Clb5-CDK は Orc6 の RXL モチーフに結合し、Orc6 のリン酸: Clb5-CDK binds the RXL motif of Orc6, and Orc6 phosphorylation accounts for most of the phosphorylation-dependent inhibition of helicase loading, blocking one of the Cdt1-binding sites on Orc6 (21289063, in vitro). In vivo, ORC phosphorylation is one of the mechanisms preventing re-initiation (11429609). Abolishing Clb5–Orc6 binding increases vulnerability to over-replication (15105375, though this is an effect of binding, not phosphorylation).
Clb5-Cdc28 は Cdc14 の天然変性の尾部の S429 を特異的にリ: Clb5-Cdc28 specifically phosphorylates S429 in the intrinsically disordered tail of Cdc14, and this phosphorylation greatly reduces Cdc14 activity (25049391). This is a finding within a methods paper, and the abstract does not state whether activity was measured in vivo or in vitro. Without validation of in vivo function, confidence is medium.
Clb5-Cdk1 は S 期から中期まで Fin1 をリン酸化して紡錘体への結: Clb5-Cdk1 phosphorylates Fin1 from S phase to metaphase, preventing its binding to the spindle. When Cdc14 dephosphorylates it in anaphase, Fin1 loads onto the spindle and acts to stabilize it. Non-phosphorylatable mutants load onto the spindle before anaphase and impair chromosome segregation (17173039).
Clc1 が Sla2 に結合すると Sla2 と F-アクチンの結合が抑えられ: Binding of Clc1 to Sla2 inhibits Sla2–F-actin binding (sedimentation assays). clc1-Δ19-76 suppresses the internalization defects of rvs161, rvs167, and vrp1 (21849475).
Cld1（Ygr110w）は Taz1 の上流で働き、Taz1 による再アシル化: Cld1 (Ygr110w) acts upstream of Taz1 and produces monolysocardiolipin for reacylation by Taz1 (19244244).
Clf1p は Orc2p と 2 ハイブリッドと共沈で結合し、複製起点に結合す: Clf1p binds Orc2p by two-hybrid and co-precipitation and binds replication origins. That binding depends on Orc2p (11973290).
Cln3 は Cdc34 によるユビキチン依存の分解を受ける。cdc28ts で: Cln3 undergoes Cdc34-mediated ubiquitin-dependent degradation. In cdc28ts, both Cln3 phosphorylation and degradation decrease, and mutation of the Cdc28 site S468 makes a Cln3 C-terminal fusion protein about 5-fold more stable (7823941).
Cln3-Cdk1 は Whi5 ではなく Rpb1 の CTD の Ser5: Cln3-Cdk1 phosphorylates Ser5 of the Rpb1 CTD rather than Whi5, promoting transcription at SBF target promoters and cell cycle entry (34648313). Both Cdc28 and Kin28 activities are required for full CTD-Ser5 phosphorylation, efficient transcription, and capping at PMA1 and other genes (22689984). Both include steps that are only "proposed", so confidence is medium.
Clu1 は核コードのミトコンドリアタンパク質の一部の翻訳をポリソームとの結合で: Clu1 regulates translation of a subset of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial proteins through association with polysomes. Full text: in clu1Δ, translation of Aco1, Pda1, and others decreases without change in mRNA levels (40623095).
Cmc1 の生理的で効率のよい酸化に Erv1 と Mia40 が要る。Cmc1: Physiological, efficient oxidation of Cmc1 requires Erv1 and Mia40. Cmc1 forms an intermediate with Mia40 and is released by Erv1 (22767599).
Cmc2 は Cmc1 と物理的に結合し、cmc2 欠失で Cmc1 が増える（: Cmc2 physically binds Cmc1, and Cmc1 increases in cmc2 deletion (20220131).
Cmr1 のコード領域への動員は Kin28 と脱アセチル化酵素 Rpd3・Ho: Recruitment of Cmr1 to coding regions is promoted by Kin28 and the deacetylases Rpd3 and Hos2 (26848854).
Cms1 は 90S 因子と共沈するが、成熟 90S で 3' major ドメ: Cms1 co-precipitates with 90S factors, but in mature 90S, Rrp12-Enp1 surrounding the 3' major domain is reduced. Cms1 is thought to prevent premature binding of Rrp12-Enp1 (36417864).
Cne1p が Mpd1p の還元活性を高める（16002399）: Cne1p enhances the reductase activity of Mpd1p (16002399).
Cnm1 はミトコンドリアの Tom70 と結合して核とミトコンドリアの接触をつ: Cnm1 binds mitochondrial Tom70 to create nucleus–mitochondria contacts (34694322).
Cnn1 の Ndc80 受容体モチーフは Spc24 と Spc25 の境目の: The Ndc80 receptor motif of Cnn1 binds the hydrophobic groove at the Spc24–Spc25 interface and recruits the Ndc80 complex to the kinetochore (23334295).
The Ndc80 receptor motif of Cnn1 binds the hydrophobic groove at the Spc24–Spc25 interface. Mutations disrupting this binding are lethal in yeast (23334295).
Cnn1 は Ndc80 複合体の基部にあって KMN 複合体どうしの相互作用を: Cnn1 sits at the base of the Ndc80 complex, suppressing interactions between KMN complexes and keeping KMN in a functional form. Cnn1 activity peaks in anaphase and is driven by the kinases Cdc28, Mps1, and Ipl1 (22561345). The abstract does not describe phosphorylation sites or mechanisms, so confidence is medium.
Cnn1 は Ndc80 複合体の根元にあり、KMN 複合体どうしの相互作用を抑: Cnn1 sits at the base of the Ndc80 complex, suppressing interactions between KMN complexes and maintaining the functional form. Cnn1 activity peaks in anaphase and is driven by Cdc28, Mps1, and Ipl1 (22561345). BioGRID's 23334295 states that phosphorylation of the Cnn1 N terminus tunes Ndc80 binding partners but does not name a CDK.
Cnn1-Wip1 ヘテロ二量体に結合した Ctf3 複合体の高分解能構造を決め: A high-resolution structure of the Ctf3 complex bound to the Cnn1-Wip1 heterodimer was determined (32679099).
Cns1 は Hgh1 と相互作用し、eEF2・Hsp90 と四者複合体をつくる: Cns1 interacts with Hgh1 and forms a quaternary complex with eEF2 and Hsp90 (30876805).
Coa1 は Mss51・Shy1・Cox14 と物理的・遺伝的に相互作用（17: Coa1 interacts physically and genetically with Mss51, Shy1, and Cox14 (17882260).
Coa2 は Cox1 の成熟で Mss51-Coa1 の下流に働き、Shy1: Coa2 acts downstream of Mss51-Coa1 in Cox1 maturation and interacts with Shy1 (18541668).
Coa3 と Cox14 が Mss51 の latent 状態の形成を促して: Coa3 and Cox14 promote formation of the latent state of Mss51 and lower COX1 expression; without them, Mss51 remains in the committed state and Cox1 synthesis increases (20876281).
Coa3 と Cox14 が新しく合成された Cox1 と組み立ての中間体をつく: Coa3 and Cox14 form an assembly intermediate with newly synthesized Cox1 (20876281).
Coa3 と Cox14 は新しく合成された Cox1 と組み立て中間体をつくる: Coa3 and Cox14 form an assembly intermediate with newly synthesized Cox1 (20876281).
Coa3・Cox14 は Mss51 を翻訳しない状態へ移し COX1 の発現を: Coa3 and Cox14 shift Mss51 to a non-translating state and lower COX1 expression. Without them, Mss51 stays in the translating state and Cox1 synthesis increases (20876281).
Coa6 は Cox2・Cox12・Sco と物理的に相互作用し、coa6 と: Coa6 physically interacts with Cox2, Cox12, and Sco, and double deletion of coa6 and cox12 abolishes Cox2 biogenesis (26669719).
Com2 は SO2 で活性化される遺伝子の 8 割以上の発現を直接・間接に制御: Com2 directly or indirectly controls expression of more than 80% of SO2-activated genes, and LYS4 is among the Com2 targets contributing to SO2 resistance (31799324).
Com2 directly or indirectly controls expression of more than 80% of SO2-activated genes, and LYS9 is among the Com2 targets contributing to SO2 resistance (31799324).
Com2 directly or indirectly controls expression of more than 80% of SO2-activated genes, and MET5 is among the Com2 targets contributing to SO2 resistance (31799324).
Com2 は SO2 で活性化される遺伝子の 80% 超を直接・間接に制御し、M: Com2 directly or indirectly controls more than 80% of SO2-activated genes, and sulfate reduction pathway genes such as MET3 are Com2 targets contributing to SO2 resistance (31799324).
Coq8 の欠損で 1.3 MDa の Q 合成複合体から Coq3 が不安定に: Loss of Coq8 destabilizes Coq3 in the 1.3 MDa Q-synthesis complex (Coq9 is unchanged) (18801050).
Coq9 は Coq6・Coq7 ヒドロキシラーゼの働きに必要（26008578: Coq9 is required for the function of the Coq6 and Coq7 hydroxylases (26008578). HA-Coq9 co-precipitates with Coq6p (17391640).
Coq9 is required for the function of the Coq6 and Coq7 hydroxylases (26008578). HA-Coq9 co-precipitates with Coq7p (17391640).
Cos3 は Nha1 の C1+C2 ペプチドと試験管内で結合し、細胞抽出液で: Cos3 binds the Nha1 C1+C2 peptide in vitro and co-precipitates with Nha1 in cell extracts. It may increase the antiporter activity of Nha1 (14718542).
Cox15 は Shy1 と複合体をつくり、Shy1 とは独立に Cox1 を含: Cox15 forms a complex with Shy1 and also associates, independently of Shy1, with Cox1-containing assembly intermediates (23979592).
Cox19 は Cox11 と動的に結合し、この結合がミトコンドリアでの Cox: Cox19 binds Cox11 dynamically, and this binding is required for stable accumulation of Cox19 in mitochondria (25926683).
Cox2 の N 末端は Oxa1 によって翻訳と共役して輸送される（27550: The N terminus of Cox2 is exported co-translationally by Oxa1 (27550809).
Cox20 は Cox2 依存的に Cox18 と共沈する（22095077）: Cox20 co-precipitates with Cox18 in a Cox2-dependent manner (22095077).
Cox20 は Mba1 と翻訳中のミトリボソームと Cox2 依存に複合体を作: Cox20 forms a complex with Mba1 and translating mitoribosomes in a Cox2-dependent manner (27550809).
Cox20 は新しく合成された Cox2 前駆体に特異的に結合し、Imp1 によ: Cox20 specifically binds the newly synthesized Cox2 precursor and is required for its cleavage by Imp1 (10671482). It also associates with and stabilizes mature Cox2 (22095077).
Cox26 の大部分は III-IV 超複合体の複合体 IV 側に結合し、一部は: Most Cox26 binds the complex IV side of the III-IV supercomplex, and part of it is disulfide-linked to Cox2 (27091403).
Coy1 の保存領域は SNARE の Sed5 と COG 複合体への結合に必: The conserved region of Coy1 is necessary and sufficient for binding to the SNARE Sed5 and the COG complex. Coy1 forms large oligomers, which are required for binding and function (31073031).
Cpd1 は Appr>p を Appr1p に変える。Poa1（YBR022w: Cpd1 converts Appr>p to Appr1p. Poa1 (YBR022w) is a specific phosphatase that converts Appr1p to ADP-ribose (15684411).
Cpr6 と Hsp90 は Ura2 と結合する。Cpr6 は Hsp90 な: Cpr6 and Hsp90 bind Ura2. Cpr6 binds Ura2 even without Hsp90 (23926110).
Cpr7 は ATP 結合型の Hsp82 の C 末端に安定に結合し、Hsp8: Cpr7 binds stably to the C terminus of ATP-bound Hsp82, forming the Hsp82-Cpr6-Cpr7 ternary complex (22505624).
Crm1 による Hst2 の核外輸出が、転写を抑える Hst2 の働きを抑える: Crm1-mediated nuclear export of Hst2 inhibits Hst2's function in repressing transcription (17110954).
Crn1 が Gmf1（AIM7）による枝の解離を 8〜10 倍高め、両者は直接: Crn1 enhances Gmf1 (AIM7)-mediated branch dissociation 8- to 10-fold, and the two bind directly to form a ternary complex with Arp2/3 (39826693).
Crn1 は Arp2/3 複合体と結合し、WA・Abp1 で活性化されたアクチ: Crn1 binds the Arp2/3 complex and inhibits WA- and Abp1-activated actin nucleation in vitro. Overexpression changes Arp2 distribution and is suppressed by arc35-26 (12499356).
Crp1 は Mus81-Mms4 のエンドヌクレアーゼを刺激し、それは両者の特: Crp1 stimulates the Mus81-Mms4 endonuclease through specific binding between them (32936932).
Crt1 の結合モチーフを持つ遺伝子のうち NTH2 などが RT-PCR で: Among genes carrying the Crt1-binding motif, NTH2 and others were confirmed by RT-PCR to be under Crt1 control (15494396).
Crt1 の結合モチーフを持つ遺伝子を探し、RT-PCR で FSH3・YLR3: Genes carrying the Crt1-binding motif were searched, and RT-PCR confirmed that FSH3, YLR345W, and NTH2 are under Crt1 control (15494396).
Crt1（Rfx1）は RNR3 のプロモーターに結合して Ssn6-Tup1: Crt1 (Rfx1) binds the RNR3 promoter and recruits Ssn6-Tup1 to repress transcription. Treatment with DNA-damaging agents or disruption of CRT1, SSN6, or TUP1 relieves RNR3 repression (11448965).
Crz1 の核への取り込みにカリオフェリン Nmd5 が要り、Nmd5 との結合: Nuclear import of Crz1 requires the karyopherin Nmd5, and binding to Nmd5 depends on the phosphorylation state of Crz1 (11535618). Light-induced nuclear translocation of Crz1 also depends on calcineurin and Nmd5 (23335962).
Csf1 は ER の Mcd4（新生 GPI アンカーに P-Etn を付ける: Csf1 interacts with ER Mcd4 (the enzyme that adds P-Etn to nascent GPI anchors) (35015055).
Csg2 は Csg1（SUR1）・Csh1 と結合し、CSG2 欠失で Csg: Csg2 binds Csg1 (SUR1) and Csh1, and CSG2 deletion reduces Csg1 activity (12954640).
Csi1 などを欠くと GFP-Csn5（Rri1）が核に集まらず細胞全体に広が: Without Csi1 and others, GFP-Csn5 (Rri1) does not concentrate in the nucleus and spreads throughout the cell (12672462).
Csm1 の新しい結合相手として Dse3 を同定。Mam1・Ulp2 と構造上: Dse3 was identified as a new binding partner of Csm1. It binds Csm1 in the same structural manner as Mam1 and Ulp2 (30252178).
Csm1 は C 末端ドメインの隣り合う界面で Ulp2 と Tof2 に結合す: Csm1 binds Ulp2 and Tof2 at adjacent interfaces of its C-terminal domain (crystal structure). Disrupting binding reduces Tof2 levels (28487408).
Csm3 は進行中の複製フォークの構成要素で、Mrc1 のフォークへの結合に T: Csm3 is a component of the progressing replication fork, and binding of Mrc1 to the fork requires Tof1 and Csm3. The three bind directly (19819872).
Csn10（RRI2）を欠くと GFP-Csn5（RRI1）が核に集まらず細胞全: Without Csn10 (RRI2), GFP-Csn5 (RRI1) does not concentrate in the nucleus and is dispersed throughout the cell (12672462).
Csn12 が無いと Csn5（Rri1）は単量体になり、核に集まらない（126: Without Csn12, Csn5 (Rri1) becomes monomeric and does not concentrate in the nucleus (12672462).
Csn5（Rri1）は核に多いが、Csn12・Csn10・Pci8・Csi1 が: Csn5 (Rri1) is abundant in the nucleus, but without Csn12, Csn10, Pci8, or Csi1, it is dispersed throughout the cell (12672462).
Ctf18 の C 末端が Ctf8・Dcc1 と結合して Pol ε 結合部分: The C terminus of Ctf18 binds Ctf8 and Dcc1 to form the Pol ε-binding module (26250113).
Ctf18 の C 末端に結合した Dcc1-Ctf8 ヘテロ二量体の結晶構造（: Crystal structure of the Dcc1-Ctf8 heterodimer bound to the Ctf18 C terminus (28188145).
Ctf19・Mcm21・Okp1 はセントロメアの構成要素で、おそらく複合体を作: Ctf19, Mcm21, and Okp1 are centromere components that probably form a complex linking CBF3 to other components (10323865).
Ctf3 は Mcm22・Mcm16・Ctf19 と相互作用する（1178244: Ctf3 interacts with Mcm22, Mcm16, and Ctf19 (11782448).
Ctf4 は Chl1 が GINS・Pol α と共有する結合モチーフを介して: Ctf4 recruits the Chl1 helicase to the replisome via a binding motif that Chl1 shares with GINS and Pol α (27397686).
