Ctf7/Eco1 は Ctf18 と Rfc2〜Rfc5 と結合する。rfc5: Ctf7/Eco1 binds Ctf18 and Rfc2–Rfc5. rfc5-1 cells show premature sister chromatid separation (12665596).
Cth1 と Cth2 は自身の mRNA の 3′UTR の ARE に生体内: Cth1 and Cth2 bind AREs in the 3′UTRs of their own mRNAs in vivo and repress their own and each other's expression. Negative feedback by Cth2 is required for the decrease in Cth2 when iron is restored (23530061).
Cth1 and Cth2 bind AREs in the 3′UTRs of their own mRNAs in vivo and repress their own and each other's expression (23530061).
Cth1/Cth2 は RNR2・RNR4 mRNA の 3′UTR と TZF: Cth1/Cth2 bind the 3′UTRs of RNR2 and RNR4 mRNAs in a TZF-dependent manner and lower both mRNAs. They relocate existing Rnr2 and Rnr4 to the cytoplasm (22152479).
Cth1/Cth2 は RNR2・RNR4 mRNA の 3′UTR に結合し、: Cth1/Cth2 bind the 3′UTRs of RNR2 and RNR4 mRNAs and lower both mRNAs (22152479).
Cth2 の N 末端のセリンのリン酸化が SCF-Grr1 による認識を促し、: Phosphorylation of N-terminal serines of Cth2 promotes its recognition by SCF-Grr1 and accelerates proteasomal degradation. Without GRR1, Cth2 increases and cells fail to grow under iron deficiency (30228242).
Cth2 の翻訳抑制は SDH4・CTH2 のほか WTM1・CCP1・HEM1: Translational repression by Cth2 extends to WTM1, CCP1, and HEM15 mRNAs in addition to SDH4 and CTH2 (29912874).
Cti6 の CSID が Sin3 の PAH2 に結合し、Sin3 は Ct: The CSID of Cti6 binds PAH2 of Sin3, and Sin3 is recruited to the RNR3 and SMF3 promoters only when Cti6 is present (32980916).
Cti6 の CSID は Cyc8 の TPR にも結合する（32980916: The CSID of Cti6 also binds the TPRs of Cyc8 (32980916).
Ctk1 は T ループの T338 でリン酸化され、これは Cak1 に依存し: Ctk1 is phosphorylated at T338 in its T-loop in a Cak1-dependent manner, and Cak1 also phosphorylates it directly in vitro. T338 mutation abolishes kinase activity, and Ctk1 from cak1Δ has low activity. In T338A, Ser2 phosphorylation and gene activation upon entry into stationary phase are impaired (15870265).
Ctk1 は翻訳中のリボソームに結合し、Rps2 の S238 をリン酸化する。: Ctk1 binds translating ribosomes and phosphorylates Rps2 S238. Cells lacking Ctk1 and rps2-S238A show increased misreading and defects in translation elongation (17545469).
Ctk3 は Ctk1 と Ctk2 の両方と広く相互作用して CTDK-1 の: Ctk3 interacts extensively with both Ctk1 and Ctk2 and contributes to CTDK-1 assembly (33431688).
Ctm1 による Cyc1 の K78 トリメチル化で、Cyc1 と Erv1・: Ctm1-mediated trimethylation of Cyc1 K78 greatly increases Cyc1 binding to Erv1 and Cyc3 (conditional two-hybrid) (25755154).
Ctr9/Paf1 ヘテロ二量体の形成が酵母 Paf1C の組み立てに必要で生存: Formation of the Ctr9/Paf1 heterodimer is required for assembly of yeast Paf1C and is essential for viability (30228257).
Ctr9・Rtf1・Leo1 は Paf1・Cdc73・Pol II と結合する: Ctr9, Rtf1, and Leo1 bind Paf1, Cdc73, and Pol II (but not the Srb mediator) (11884586).
Cue3/Rqt3 と yKR023W/Rqt4 は Slh1 とともに RQT: Cue3/Rqt3 and yKR023W/Rqt4 form the RQT complex with Slh1 (28757607).
Cup9 による PTR2 の抑制は Tup1・Ssn6 を要する。アミノ酸は: Repression of PTR2 by Cup9 requires Tup1 and Ssn6. Amino acids accelerate Ubr1-mediated degradation of Cup9 in an SSY1- and PTR3-dependent manner, inducing PTR2 (18708352).
Cup9 は OPT2 の発現を抑制する（OPT1 は制御しない）（170059: Cup9 represses OPT2 expression (it does not regulate OPT1) (17005992).
Cur1 は Sis1 を細胞質から核へ移す働きでプリオンに作用する（28431: Cur1 acts on prions by relocating Sis1 from the cytoplasm to the nucleus (28431189). Cur1 reduces cytoplasmic Sis1 (22718905).
Cus2 の UHM が Hsh155 の ULM に結合。どちらかの変異で結合: The UHM of Cus2 binds the ULM of Hsh155. Mutation of either abolishes binding, and the prespliceosome forms without ATP (31110137).
Cuz1 は Cdc48 と直接結合し（UBL が Cdc48 の N 末端ドメ: Cuz1 binds Cdc48 directly (its UBL binds the Cdc48 N-terminal domain) and regulates Cdc48 function in the ubiquitin-proteasome system (24121501).
Cuz1 は転写因子 Rpn4 の制御を受け、ヒ素・アンチモンへの耐性に必要（2: Cuz1 is regulated by the transcription factor Rpn4 and is required for resistance to arsenic and antimony (24297164).
Cvm1 による液胞-ミトコンドリアの接触にはポリン Por1 と Por2 が: Vacuole–mitochondria contacts formed by Cvm1 require the porins Por1 and Por2 (40601406).
Cvm1 は Yml020w（Cvm2）と複合体をつくり、PI3P への結合で複: Cvm1 forms a complex with Yml020w (Cvm2) and directs the complex to the vacuole by binding PI3P (40601406).
Cvm1 はパラログ Cvm2（Yml020w）と複合体をつくり、複合体の形成が: Cvm1 forms a complex with its paralog Cvm2 (Yml020w), and complex formation is required for function (40601406).
Cwc15 は転写伸長因子 Dst1 と遺伝的に相互作用し、転写伸長で働く（38: Cwc15 interacts genetically with the transcription elongation factor Dst1 and acts in transcription elongation (38627018).
Cwc2 2 分子が Prp19 四量体に結合する（試験管内・生体内）（2046: Two Cwc2 molecules bind the Prp19 tetramer (in vitro and in vivo) (20462492).
Cwc21 は Prp8 と Snu114 に直接結合する（19854871）: Cwc21 binds Prp8 and Snu114 directly (19854871).
Cwc22 は Prp2 のスプライソソームへの呼び込みには不要だが、Prp2: Cwc22 is not required for recruitment of Prp2 to the spliceosome but is essential for Prp2's function in removing SF3a and SF3b (20956557).
Cwc23 の枯渇で Ntr1 と Ntr2 が減り、Cwc23 がこの 2 つ: Depletion of Cwc23 reduces Ntr1 and Ntr2, suggesting a role for Cwc23 in stabilizing them (29390077).
Cwc23 は NTR 複合体の構成要素で Ntr1 の C 末端と結びつく（2: Cwc23 is a component of the NTR complex and associates with the C terminus of Ntr1 (29390077). Ntr1, Ntr2, and Cwc23 form a stable trimer.
Cyc2p は CCHL（Cyc3）のアポシトクロム c・c1 への活性に必要（: Cyc2p is required for the activity of CCHL (Cyc3) toward apocytochromes c and c1 (16207709). Cyc2p binds CCHL by two-hybrid (22257001).
Cyk3 は Dbf2 に依存して局在し、Chs2 によるキチン合成を促す（22: Cyk3 localizes in a Dbf2-dependent manner and promotes Chs2-mediated chitin synthesis (22573892).
DAL4 などの発現は窒素カタボライト抑制を受け、UGA1・PUT2 以外は機能: Expression of DAL4 and others is subject to nitrogen catabolite repression, and all except UGA1 and PUT2 require functional GLN3 (8416910).
DAL7 の誘導性の発現に UAS(NTR) 2 つなど 8 つのシス配列が関わ: Inducible expression of DAL7 involves eight cis elements, including two UAS(NTR) (10488154).
DAL80 の発現は Gln3 と Gat1 に依存し Dal80 自身に調節さ: DAL80 expression depends on Gln3 and Gat1 and is regulated by Dal80 itself. Gln3 and Dal80 bind fragments of the DAL80 promoter (9171383).
DAL80 の発現は Gln3 と Gat1 に依存する（9171383）: DAL80 expression depends on Gln3 and Gat1 (9171383).
DAL80 を破壊すると UGA1・CAN1・GAP1・DAL4 の発現が大きく: Disruption of DAL80 greatly increases expression of UGA1, CAN1, GAP1, and DAL4 (8416910).
DAN/TIR 遺伝子（DAN2 を含む）は Mox4（Upc2）が活性化し、ヘ: DAN/TIR genes (including DAN2) are activated by Mox4 (Upc2) and repressed by the heme-induced Mot3 (11292809).
DAN/TIR 遺伝子（DAN2 を含む）は嫌気で発現し、ヘムで抑えられる活性化: DAN/TIR genes (including DAN2) are expressed under anaerobiosis and activated by the heme-repressed activator Mox4 (Upc2) (11292809).
DAN/TIR 遺伝子（DAN4 を含む）は嫌気で発現し、Mot3 はヘムで誘導: DAN/TIR genes (including DAN4) are expressed under anaerobiosis, and Mot3 is a heme-induced repressor (11292809).
DAN/TIR 遺伝子（DAN4 を含む）は嫌気で発現し、Mox4 はヘムで抑え: DAN/TIR genes (including DAN4) are expressed under anaerobiosis; Mox4 is a heme-repressed activator and Mot3 a heme-induced repressor (11292809).
DAN/TIR 遺伝子（TIR4 を含む）について、Mox4 はヘムで抑えられる: For DAN/TIR genes (including TIR4), Mox4 is a heme-repressed activator (11292809).
DASH 複合体の Ask1 は細胞周期でリン酸化され、生体内では Cdk に依: Ask1 of the DASH complex is phosphorylated during the cell cycle in a Cdk-dependent manner in vivo, and Cdc28 phosphorylates it in vitro. Phosphorylation of two Cdk sites is important for full Ask1 activity in vivo (12695666). In a reconstituted system, Cdk1-mediated phosphorylation of Ask1 prolongs the residence time of the Dam1 complex on microtubules and strengthens binding (32946748).
DBP7 と YRF1-6 が PGM2 mRNA の翻訳量を 5′UTR を介: DBP7 and YRF1-6 regulate the translation level of PGM2 mRNA via its 5′UTR (36675300). Full text: under LiCl, deletion reduces Pgm2 protein.
DCG1 の発現は NCR を受け、DAL80 の産物により制御される（1916: DCG1 expression is subject to NCR and is regulated by the DAL80 product (1916277).
DDC1-MEC3-RAD17（9-1-1）複合体は S 期の DNA 損傷・複: The DDC1-MEC3-RAD17 (9-1-1) complex is a sliding clamp acting in the S-phase DNA damage and replication checkpoints (24573675).
DDK による Mms4 のリン酸化は分裂期の Mus81 の活性化に厳密に必要: DDK-mediated phosphorylation of Mms4 is strictly required for activation of Mus81 in mitosis (28096179).
DDK による動原体タンパク質 Ctf19 のリン酸化は Scc2/4 の結合部: DDK-mediated phosphorylation of the kinetochore protein Ctf19 creates a binding site for Scc2/4, directing cohesin loading to centromeres (28938124). DDK recruited to kinetochores via the Ctf3 complex in G1 phosphorylates Ctf19, and in ctf19-9A, which lacks the phosphorylation sites, centromeric localization of Scc2 is impaired.
DDK に依存するリン酸化の標的として INO80 の Arp8 を見つけた。A: Arp8 of INO80 was found as a target of DDK-dependent phosphorylation. Arp8 phosphorylation stabilizes INO80 complex integrity, sets nucleosome spacing at replication origins, promotes replication, and enhances the replication stress response (41904138). S65 and S233 are direct DDK sites, and AA mutants have reduced replication efficiency in vivo.
DDK の唯一の必須の働きは Mcm4 の N 末端の S/T に富む領域（NS: The sole essential function of DDK is to relieve the inhibitory activity of the N-terminal S/T-rich region (NSD) of Mcm4 (20054399). DDK phosphorylation depends on prior priming phosphorylation, and mutations mimicking phosphorylation of DDK sites bypass the need for DDK (21070963). Phosphomimetic Mcm4 and Mcm6 bind Sld3 without DDK and promote replication (26912723).
DDK は削り込みのヌクレアーゼ Sae2 と Dna2 をリン酸化し、Dna2: DDK phosphorylates the resection nucleases Sae2 and Dna2, and Dna2 promotes extension of resection. Full text: depleting Dbf4 causes defects in long-range resection by STR-Dna2 (38570537).
DEAD box ヘリカーゼ Spb4 はその結合相手 Rrp17 とともに p: The DEAD-box helicase Spb4, together with its partner Rrp17, participates in a step of pre-60S maturation (36929751).
DEAD-box ヘリカーゼ Dbp4（HCA4）は Bfr2・Enp2 と 5: The DEAD-box helicase Dbp4 (HCA4) forms the 50S complex with Bfr2 and Enp2, and they are also together in the 80S SSU processome (24357410).
DIT1 の NRE に Nrg1 と Rim101 が同時に結合し、生体内で共: Nrg1 and Rim101 bind simultaneously to the NRE of DIT1 and act as corepressors in vivo (16024810).
DNA に結合しない Met4 は Met31・Met32 との相互作用で標的を: Met4, which does not bind DNA, activates targets through interaction with Met31 and Met32. In the absence of Met30, Met32 binds all Met4 binding sites and is the main scaffold recruiting Met4 (22438580).
DNA に結合する補因子 Cbf1・Met31/Met32 が Met4 をプロ: The DNA-binding cofactors Cbf1 and Met31/Met32 recruit Met4 to promoters. Double deletion of Met31 and Met32 abolishes activation of Met4's core targets (19940020).
DNA リガーゼ IV 複合体の Lif1 は S 期から G2 期に CDK: Lif1 of the DNA ligase IV complex is phosphorylated at S261 by CDK from S to G2 phase, and this phosphorylation is required for efficient NHEJ in G2/M and promotes stable binding of Lif1 to break sites (22563681). Lif1 phosphorylation is governed by the docking sequence NLxxxL specific to S-phase CDK (Clb5/6-Cdc28) (33210757).
DNA 修復タンパク質 Mgt1（O6-アルキルグアニン転移酵素）は N 末端近: The DNA repair protein Mgt1 (O6-alkylguanine transferase) is targeted for degradation via a degron near its N terminus by both the Ubr1/Rad6 N-end rule pathway and the Ufd4/Ubc4 UFD pathway, which synergistically promote polyubiquitination. Cells lacking both E3s are hyper-resistant to MNNG and hypersensitive to Mgt1 overexpression (19164530). Ubr1 and Ufd4 form a complex and together target the internal degron of Mgt1 (21076411).
DNA 損傷で CLB2 群の転写が下がるのは Rad53 と Ndd1 による: The decrease in CLB2-cluster transcription upon DNA damage is due to Rad53 and Ndd1. Ndd1 is phosphorylated upon DNA damage, preventing its binding to promoters (24324011). Multiple Rad53-dependent inhibitory phosphorylations prevent Ndd1 from binding chromatin via Fkh2 (24324010).
DNA 損傷で Cdc20 は PKA の配列でリン酸化され、これには Mec1: Upon DNA damage, Cdc20 is phosphorylated at PKA consensus sites, which requires Mec1 and Tpk1/Tpk2. PKA inactivation or non-phosphorylatable Cdc20 accelerates degradation of securin and Clb2 in chk1 mutants and nearly abolishes damage-induced arrest. Site mutations allow Cdc20 to bind Clb2 (14743219).
DNA 損傷で Cla4 が H4 の T80 をリン酸化し、Rtt107 を損: Upon DNA damage, Cla4 phosphorylates H4 T80, recruiting Rtt107 to damage sites to displace Rad9 and terminate the checkpoint. Without H4T80ph, recovery is impaired and cell cycle arrest persists (30454561). 32064518 is a genetic large-scale analysis identifying Cla4 as a regulator of H4-S47. HHF2 is not in the working table but encodes the same H4.
DNA 損傷で Hst3 は Mec1 に依存してすばやくリン酸化され、ユビキチ: Upon DNA damage, Hst3 is rapidly phosphorylated in a Mec1-dependent manner, then ubiquitinated and degraded. This allows H3K56 acetylation to accumulate at damage sites (17977840). Whether the phosphorylation is direct is not stated.
DNA 損傷で MEC1・RAD53 に依存して Los1 が細胞質へ移り、イン: Upon DNA damage, Los1 relocates to the cytoplasm in a MEC1- and RAD53-dependent manner, and export of intron-containing tRNAs stops (18045534).
DNA 損傷で Mec1/Tel1 が INO80 の Ies4 をリン酸化する: Upon DNA damage, Mec1/Tel1 phosphorylate Ies4 of INO80. Mutation of the phosphorylation sites has little effect on repair but alters the checkpoint response (17693258). Phosphorylated Ies4 binds the FHA domain of Rad53; in vitro, INO80 activates Rad53 in an Ies4 phosphorylation-dependent manner, and in vivo Ies4 and Rad9 cooperate to activate Rad53 (25959398). Because it enhances Ies4's function as a checkpoint scaffold, confidence is medium. Ies4 phosphorylation does not appear in the abstract of BioGRID's 26798134.
DNA 損傷で Mec1/Tel1 にリン酸化された Ies4 が Rad53: Upon DNA damage, Ies4 phosphorylated by Mec1/Tel1 binds the FHA domain of Rad53, and INO80 activates Rad53 in an Ies4 phosphorylation-dependent manner. In vivo this is synergistic with Rad9 (25959398).
DNA 損傷で Rad26 は Mec1 に依存して（Rad53・Chk1・Te: Upon DNA damage, Rad26 is phosphorylated in a Mec1-dependent manner (independently of Rad53, Chk1, Tel1, and Dun1), and mutating the phosphorylation site reduces the rate of TC-NER. The authors conclude that Mec1 directly activates Rad26 (19901073).
DNA 損傷で Rsp5 がモノユビキチンをつけた RNAPII に、Elc1/: Upon DNA damage, the Elc1/Cul3 complex builds K48 chains on RNAPII monoubiquitinated by Rsp5, causing its degradation (19920177). PAF1C promotes Elongin-Cullin-mediated polyubiquitination and degradation of Rpb1 after damage (36161924). The abstracts refer to Rpo21 as RNAPII/Rpb1. 19920177 includes results in human cells, but the K48 chain step is yeast Elc1/Cul3.
DNA 損傷で Swi6 は Rad53 依存にリン酸化され、CLN1・CLN2: Upon DNA damage, Swi6 is phosphorylated in a Rad53-dependent manner and is thought to repress CLN1 and CLN2 transcription, delaying entry into S phase (PMID 9367985). Swi6 with altered Rad53 sites shortens the G1/S delay after damage (PMID 12724400).
DNA 損傷での Mdt1（PIN4）の高リン酸化は Mec1・Tel1 に依存: Hyperphosphorylation of Mdt1 (PIN4) upon DNA damage depends on Mec1 and Tel1, and Mec1 directly phosphorylates SQ/TQ fragments (15024067).
DNA 損傷に応じて Dun1 が Dif1 を直接リン酸化し、Dif1 を不活: In response to DNA damage, Dun1 directly phosphorylates Dif1, causing its inactivation and degradation and allowing Rnr2-Rnr4 to exit to the cytoplasm. Dif1 phosphorylation is not seen in dun1Δ, and purified Dun1 phosphorylates Dif1 in vitro (18851834).
DNA 損傷のあと Cdc20 は PKA の配列でリン酸化され、それには Me: After DNA damage, Cdc20 is phosphorylated at PKA consensus sites, which requires Mec1 and Tpk1/Tpk2. This phosphorylation delays mitotic progression (degradation of Clb2 and securin) (14743219).
DNA 損傷のあと、リン酸化された Sml1 の分解が Mub1 に依存する（2: After DNA damage, degradation of phosphorylated Sml1 depends on Mub1 (20566477).
DNA 損傷のあと、リン酸化された Sml1 の分解が Rad6 に依存する（2: After DNA damage, degradation of phosphorylated Sml1 depends on Rad6 (20566477).
DNA 損傷のあと、リン酸化された Sml1 の分解は E2 の Rad6、E3: After DNA damage, degradation of phosphorylated Sml1 depends on the E2 Rad6, the E3 Ubr2, and Mub1, which binds the E2/E3 (20566477).
DNA 損傷のあとの Cdc20 の PKA 配列のリン酸化には Tpk1 と: Phosphorylation of Cdc20 at PKA consensus sites after DNA damage requires Tpk1 and Tpk2. Inactivating PKA nearly abolishes the DNA damage-induced mitotic delay (14743219).
DNA 損傷のあと・S 期に Mec1 と Rad53 が Sml1 のリン酸化: After DNA damage and in S phase, Mec1 and Rad53 control Sml1 phosphorylation and degradation. The direct kinase is the downstream Dun1 (11904430).
DNA 損傷のとき Def1 が Pol3 のユビキチン化とプロテアソームでの分: Upon DNA damage, Def1 promotes ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of Pol3. Pol31 and Pol32 are not affected (24465179).
DNA 損傷剤で INO80 の Ies4 は Mec1/Tel1 にリン酸化さ: DNA-damaging agents cause phosphorylation of Ies4 of INO80 by Mec1/Tel1, and site mutations affect the checkpoint response rather than repair (17693258).
DNA 損傷剤で Rpb1 が K48 型にポリユビキチン化され分解される。El: DNA-damaging agents cause K48-linked polyubiquitination and degradation of Rpb1. Ela1 and Cul3 are required for this polyubiquitination and degradation, and an E3 composed of Elc1, Ela1, Cul3, and Roc1 is proposed to mediate it (17296727). PAF1C promotes Elongin-Cullin E3-mediated polyubiquitination and degradation of Rpb1 after DNA damage (36161924).
DNA 損傷時に Chk1 は Pds1 を複数部位でリン酸化する。その部位の変: Upon DNA damage, Chk1 phosphorylates Pds1 at multiple sites. Mutating these sites abolishes damage checkpoint function, and Pds1 is degraded in an APC-dependent manner. Phosphorylation stabilizes Pds1 and blocks progression to anaphase (11390356).
DNA 損傷時に Rad53 が Sld3 と Dbf4 をリン酸化して後期の複: Upon DNA damage, Rad53 phosphorylates Sld3 and Dbf4 to block late origin firing. Non-phosphorylatable SLD3-m25 dbf4-m25 fires late origins even under damage (20865002). Rad53-mediated phosphorylation of Sld3 blocks the CDK pathway (20835227).
DRS1 の変異と組み合わせて致死になる変異の選抜で NOP7 を同定。Nop7: NOP7 was identified in a screen for mutations lethal in combination with DRS1 mutations. Like Drs1p, Nop7p is required for an essential step in 60S subunit synthesis (11911362).
DSB があると活性化した Mek1 が Ndt80 に結合してリン酸化し、DN: In the presence of DSBs, activated Mek1 binds and phosphorylates Ndt80, preventing DNA binding and inhibiting its function as a transcriptional activator. When DSBs are repaired and Mek1 activity falls, the inhibitory phosphates are removed (30496175).
DSB で Rad51 が ssDNA に結合するには Rad52 が要る（12: Rad51 binding to ssDNA at DSBs requires Rad52 (12887906, ChIP). Rad52 is essential to protect Rad51 filaments from disassembly by Srs2 (29985128).
DSB の削り込みの細胞周期制御は CDK による Sae2 S267 のリン酸: Cell cycle control of DSB resection is due to CDK-mediated phosphorylation of Sae2 S267. S267A shows defects similar to sae2Δ, and phosphomimetic mutations allow resection even without CDK (18716619). BioGRID's 24344201 and 30275497 show that cell cycle-dependent phosphorylation regulates the oligomeric state of Sae2 and activation of MRX.
DSL1 係留複合体の Sec39p/Dsl3p を Lds2p の結合相手とし: Sec39p/Dsl3p of the DSL1 tethering complex was identified as a binding partner of Lds2p (27216456).
DSS4 は Ypt1 から GDP を外せるが非常に遅い（最大速度定数 約 0: DSS4 can release GDP from Ypt1 but very slowly (maximal rate constant about 0.01/s) (11419942).
DUBm の 4 つのサブユニットはすべて活性に必要。Sgf73 の点変異は U: All four subunits of DUBm are required for activity. A point mutation in Sgf73 damages the ubiquitin-binding site of Ubp8 and abolishes activity (25526805).
DUR3 は T250・S251・T684 を Ptk2 にリン酸化されて活性化: DUR3 is activated by Ptk2-mediated phosphorylation at T250, S251, and T684 (SAM3 is not activated) (17218313).
Dad1 は Dam1 と共免疫沈降し、紡錘体への局在が互いに依存する（1155: Dad1 co-immunoprecipitates with Dam1, and their localization to the spindle is interdependent (11553702).
Dad1 は two-hybrid で Duo1 と結合し、Duo1・Dam1: Dad1 binds Duo1 by two-hybrid, co-immunoprecipitates with Duo1 and Dam1, and their localization to the spindle is interdependent (11553702).
Dal80 は GAT1 の発現を抑え、Gat1 と結合を競い、NCR 遺伝子の: Dal80 represses GAT1 expression, competes with Gat1 for binding, and directly represses transcription of NCR genes (19380492). GAT1 expression decreases in inverse proportion to DAL80 expression levels (11073899).
Dal81 は全長と切断後の Stp1・Stp2 の両方の転写活性化の力を、プロ: Dal81 enhances the transcriptional activation capacity of both full-length and processed Stp1 and Stp2 by aiding their promoter binding. Processed Stp1/2, which accumulates in the nucleus in induced cells, can activate transcription without Dal81 (17603098).
Dal82 のコイルドコイル領域による誘導物質依存の転写には Dal81 が必要: Inducer-dependent transcription via the coiled-coil region of Dal82 requires Dal81, and the Dal81-Dal82 complex is detected by two-hybrid (10906145).
Dap1 は Erg11 を活性化し、Dap1 を欠くと Erg11 の基質がた: Dap1 activates Erg11; without Dap1, Erg11 substrates accumulate and cells become sensitive to Erg11 inhibitors. Heme binding is essential for function, and dap1Δ is suppressed by increasing Erg11 (17954932).
Dat1 は ILV1 の poly(dA:dT) 配列に特異的に結合し、ILV: Dat1 binds specifically to the poly(dA:dT) sequence of ILV1 and acts as a transcriptional activator at ILV1. DAT1 is required for synergistic activation with the Reb1 site (9613577).
Dbf2 のキナーゼ活性は体内で Tem1・Cdc15・Mob1 に依存し、Cd: Dbf2 kinase activity depends on Tem1, Cdc15, and Mob1 in vivo, and Cdc15 activates only Mob1-bound Dbf2 (11404483). Dbf2 activity peaks from metaphase through anaphase B and telophase (10228157).
Dbf2 のキナーゼ活性は体内で Tem1・Cdc15・Mob1 に依存する。試: Dbf2 kinase activity depends on Tem1, Cdc15, and Mob1 in vivo. In vitro, Cdc15 activates Mob1-bound Dbf2, and the conserved S374 and T544 are required for DBF2 function in vivo and for activation by Cdc15 (11404483).
Dbf2-Mob1 は Cdc14 の NLS の近くを直接リン酸化して NLS: Dbf2-Mob1 directly phosphorylates Cdc14 near its NLS, abolishing NLS function and relocating Cdc14 to the cytoplasm to promote mitotic exit (19221193). Dbf2-Mob1 that has entered the nucleolus phosphorylates Net1 and Cdc14, activating Cdc14 (33481703).
Dbf4 は Cdc5 の PBD に結合し、分裂期に Cdc5 の働きを直接の: Dbf4 binds the PBD of Cdc5 and inhibits Cdc5 function in mitosis through direct binding (21036905).
Dbf4 は Fkh1・Fkh2 との結合（Dbf4 の C 末端）を介して早期: Dbf4 is recruited to early origins via binding to Fkh1 and Fkh2 (via the Dbf4 C terminus). The binding can be reconstituted in vitro (29330352).
Dbf4 は Mcm2 と最も強く、Cdc7 は Mcm4 と Mcm5 の両方: Dbf4 binds Mcm2 most strongly, and Cdc7 binds both Mcm4 and Mcm5 (23549044).
Dbp4（HCA4）は Bfr2・Enp2 と 50S 複合体を作り、80S の: Dbp4 (HCA4) forms the 50S complex with Bfr2 and Enp2, and they are also together in the 80S SSU processome (24357410).
Dbp7 がないと Npa1 足場複合体の解離・snR190 の放出・uL3 の: Without Dbp7, dissociation of the Npa1 scaffold complex, release of snR190, and binding of uL3 are impaired (34686661).
Dbp9 の増量は dbp6 変異を抑え、二重変異は合成致死、2 ハイブリッドで: Increased Dbp9 suppresses dbp6 mutations, the double mutant is synthetically lethal, and they interact weakly by two-hybrid (11565753).
Dcc1-Ctf8 の二量体が Ctf18 の C 末端に結合した結晶構造（28: Crystal structure of the Dcc1-Ctf8 dimer bound to the Ctf18 C terminus (28188145).
Dci1 は Eci1-GFP のペルオキシソームへの局在に必要で、Pex5 依: Dci1 is required for peroxisomal localization of Eci1-GFP, and Pex5-dependent import occurs through binding and co-import with Dci1 (11302517).
Dck1 と Lmo1 は Rho5 を制御する上流の因子として同定された（25: Dck1 and Lmo1 were identified as upstream factors regulating Rho5 (25598154).
Dcn1 は Nedd8 とカリンに結合し、過剰発現で Nedd8 化 Cdc5: Dcn1 binds Nedd8 and cullins, and its overexpression causes accumulation of neddylated Cdc53. It accelerates the neddylation reaction rather than blocking deneddylation (15988528).
Dcp2 C 末端の正の制御配列は Edc3・Pat1・Upf1 を呼び寄せて別: The positive regulatory sequences at the Dcp2 C terminus recruit Edc3, Pat1, and Upf1 to form distinct decapping complexes that determine substrate selection and final activation (26184073, genetics). Upf1, Edc3, Scd6, and Pat1 act as regulatory subunits of the decapping enzyme, determining substrate specificity and enzyme activation (35604319). Pat1 has a region responsible for P-body formation and translational repression and a region that promotes decapping after entry into P-bodies (18086885).
Dcp2 C 末端の正の制御配列は脱キャップ活性化因子 Edc3・Pat1・Up: The positive regulatory sequences at the Dcp2 C terminus recruit the decapping activators Edc3, Pat1, and Upf1 to form distinct decapping complexes that determine substrate selection and final activation (26184073, genetics). Two Upf1-binding motifs direct the decapping enzyme to NMD substrates, and Upf1 and others act as regulatory subunits of the decapping enzyme, determining substrate specificity and enzyme activation (35604319).
Dcr2 はリン酸化型を模した Ire1 と生体内で結合し、試験管内で Ire1: Dcr2 binds phosphomimetic Ire1 in vivo and dephosphorylates Ire1 in vitro. Its overexpression delays HAC1 splicing (16990850).
Dcs1 を欠くとトレハラーゼ Nth1 が常に活性化・リン酸化される。Dcs1: Without Dcs1, the trehalase Nth1 is constitutively activated and phosphorylated. Dcs1 appears to inhibit it by preventing binding to 14-3-3 (23155055).
Dcw1 と Dfg5 の両方を欠く細胞は主要な細胞壁タンパク質 Cwp1 を培: Cells lacking both Dcw1 and Dfg5 secrete the major cell wall protein Cwp1 into the medium. The double deletion is synthetically lethal, and their functions are redundant (12421307).
Ddi1 は分岐した単細胞真核生物に共通のメタカスパーゼの基質で、切断で UBA: Ddi1 is a substrate of a metacaspase common to diverse unicellular eukaryotes, and cleavage removes its UBA domain. In yeast, cleavage is tightly regulated in vivo and occurs only when calcium rises and under specific metabolic conditions. Metacaspase-mediated cleavage reduces Ddi1 stability (29363267).
Ded1 の N 末と eIF4A・eIF4E の結合が、生体内の Ded1 の: Binding of the Ded1 N terminus to eIF4A and eIF4E enhances Ded1 function in vivo (translation of structured 5'UTRs) (32469309).
Ded1 は SRP の構成要素と生体内・試験管内で結合し、SCR1 RNA 存: Ded1 binds SRP components in vivo and in vitro, and in the presence of SCR1 RNA, SRP21 inhibits Ded1 enzymatic activity (38931009).
Def1 はクロマチンで Rad26 と複合体を作る。def1 細胞は DNA: Def1 forms a complex with Rad26 on chromatin. def1 cells cannot degrade RNAPII upon DNA damage (11859374).
Dep1 と Sds3 は Rpd3L だけの構成要素で、Rpd3L の形と H: Dep1 and Sds3 are components only of Rpd3L and are required for Rpd3L structure and HDAC activity (16314178).
Dfm1 の複合体には Cdc48 の補因子 Ubx1・Ubx7 が含まれ、De: The Dfm1 complex contains the Cdc48 cofactors Ubx1 and Ubx7, and the Der1 complex is rich in Ufd1 (18407841).
Dga1 は Ole1 と結合し、C 末端 20 残基を欠くと Ole1 と結合: Dga1 binds Ole1 and cannot bind Ole1 when lacking its C-terminal 20 residues (37269945).
Dhh1 は POR1 mRNA と結合し、Rbp1 との相互作用を通して PO: Dhh1 binds POR1 mRNA and specifically promotes POR1 mRNA degradation through interaction with Rbp1. The non-conserved C terminus of Dhh1 is required for this interaction (21998293).
Dhh1 は脱キャップを促し、dhh1Δ では脱アデニル化されキャップの残った: Dhh1 promotes decapping, and in dhh1Δ, deadenylated capped mRNAs accumulate. Dhh1 binds the decapping enzyme Dcp1 (11780629). In dhh1 mutants, non-decapped intermediates accumulate, and Dhh1 is required for efficient decapping in vivo. Recombinant Dhh1 enhances the activity of purified decapping enzyme in vitro (12032091).
Dia2 は MMS による S 期チェックポイントからの回復で Mrc1 の分: Dia2 aids Mrc1 degradation during recovery from the MMS-induced S-phase checkpoint, and the recovery defect of dia2Δ is rescued by a checkpoint-defective mrc1 (23172854). SCF-Dia2-mediated degradation of Mrc1 is required for restart of stalled forks during recovery (27956499). In 19910927, SCF-Dia2 ubiquitinates Mrc1 in vivo and in vitro.
Dia2 は Mrc1・Ctf4・Mcm2 に結合し、SCF(Dia2) が M: Dia2 binds Mrc1, Ctf4, and Mcm2, and SCF(Dia2) ubiquitinates Mrc1 and Ctf4 in vivo and in vitro (19910927).
Dib1 の C 末端はスプライソソームで Prp8・Prp31 と接する。U6: The Dib1 C terminus contacts Prp8 and Prp31 in the spliceosome. Dib1 and Prp8 stabilize the ACAGAGA hairpin of U6 (42556727, 26829225).
Dif1 は Rnr2-Rnr4 の核への取り込みを促して RNR を抑える（2: Dif1 inhibits RNR by promoting nuclear import of Rnr2-Rnr4 (26970775). Dif1 binds Rnr2-Rnr4 directly via its conserved Hug domain and promotes their nuclear import (18851834).
Dls1p は Isw2 複合体の新しいサブユニットで、生体内の Isw2 依存: Dls1p is a new subunit of the Isw2 complex and is required for Isw2-dependent chromatin remodeling in vivo (to different degrees at different targets) (15024052).
Dmo2 は Sco1・Sco2 と共沈（39932033）: Dmo2 co-precipitates with Sco1 and Sco2 (39932033).
Dnf3p のリン脂質フリップ活性は Fpk1p と Fpk2p で正に制御され: The phospholipid flippase activity of Dnf3p is positively regulated by Fpk1p and Fpk2p (32661085).
Dnm1 はアダプター Caf4・Mdv1 との結合でミトコンドリアに呼ばれる（: Dnm1 is recruited to mitochondria by binding the adaptors Caf4 and Mdv1 (23300936).
Doa1 の PFU と Hse1 の SH3 が 5 μM の親和性で結合。D: The PFU of Doa1 and the SH3 of Hse1 bind with 5 μM affinity. Doa1 N438 and Hse1 W254 are important (24607902).
Doa1 は Cse4 のユビキチン化に働き、Cse4 の分解を調節する（235: Doa1 acts in Cse4 ubiquitination and regulates Cse4 degradation (23525333).
Doa10 の RING は試験管内でユビキチンリガーゼ活性をもち、生体内で α: The RING domain of Doa10 has ubiquitin ligase activity in vitro and is essential for Deg1-mediated degradation of α2 in vivo (11641273).
Doa10 は Ubc7 と C 末端で膜に留まる Ubc6 を E2 として: Doa10 acts in ERAD with the E2s Ubc7 and Ubc6, which is C-terminally anchored in the membrane, and Ubc6 itself is a Doa10 substrate. In doa10-E633D, with the TM5 glutamate changed to aspartate, Ubc6 is fully stabilized, and in doa10-E633Q, with glutamine, Ubc6 degradation is accelerated about 5-fold (21467040). In vitro, Doa10 catalyzes monoubiquitination of Ubc6 (27570077, BioGRID record).
Doa10 またはその複合体の成分を欠くと Erg1 の分解が強く損なわれ、分解: Loss of Doa10 or components of its complex strongly impairs Erg1 degradation; degradation is regulated by lanosterol levels and requires K311 (23898401). Lipid saturation triggers ERAD of Erg1 via Doa10-Ubc7 (36368908).
Doc1 は Cdc27・Cdc16・Apc1 と結合し、APC/C の内腔で: Doc1 binds Cdc27, Cdc16, and Apc1 and lies near Apc2-Apc11 in the APC/C cavity (21186364).
Dom34 は Hbs1 と結合し、Hbs1 の GTP（GDP ではなく）への: Dom34 binds Hbs1 and increases the affinity of Hbs1 for GTP (not GDP) (18180287).
Dop1p はエンドソームで Neo1p・Ysl2p と複合体をつくる（2047: Dop1p forms a complex with Neo1p and Ysl2p at endosomes (20477991).
Dot1 は H3 の K79 をメチル化し、K79 の変異と Dot1 の触媒: Dot1 methylates H3 K79; both K79 mutations and mutations abolishing Dot1 catalytic activity impair telomeric silencing and weaken binding of Sir2 and Sir3 to telomeres (12080090). Dot1 is the only enzyme that methylates about 90% of H3 in vivo, and in dot1Δ silencing is impaired and Sir proteins are dispersed (12086673).
Dpb11 は Mec1 に結合して活性化する仲介因子（21946560）。生体: Dpb11 is a mediator that binds and activates Mec1 (21946560). In vivo, Dpb11 contributes to full activation of Mec1 (18541674). Dpb11 and 9-1-1 activate Mec1 independently, and together they act synergistically (18922789).
Dpb11・Mec1・Rad9 の三者複合体が、試験管内で Mec1 による R: The Dpb11-Mec1-Rad9 ternary complex is required for efficient Mec1-mediated phosphorylation of Rad9 in vitro and for checkpoint activation in vivo (21946560). In vivo, Dpb11 cooperates with Dot1 to promote Rad9 phosphorylation (18541674).
Dpb2 は G1 期後期に Cdc28 に依存してリン酸化され、Cdc28 は: Dpb2 is phosphorylated in late G1 in a Cdc28-dependent manner, and Cdc28 directly phosphorylates S144 in vitro. Either Cln or Clb suffices. Mutation of three CDK sites synthetically reduces spore viability and growth with pol2-11 (14747467).
Dpb4 は Dls1 と組んで Isw2 の DSB への結合を助け、ヒストン: Dpb4 partners with Dls1 to aid Isw2 binding to DSBs, promoting histone eviction and DSB resection (34362907).
Dpb4 は Dpb3 と組んで Rad9 の DSB への結合を助け、チェック: Dpb4 partners with Dpb3 to aid Rad9 binding to DSBs and activates the checkpoint (34362907).
Dpb4 は Pol ε で Dpb3 と、ISW2 で Dls1 とヒストン様: Dpb4 forms histone-like dimers with Dpb3 in Pol ε and with Dls1 in ISW2. The pair with Dpb3 aids Rad9 binding to DSBs (34362907).
Dph3（Kti11）は還元状態で Dph1-Dph2 の Fe-S クラスター: Dph3 (Kti11) acts in the reduced state as an electron donor that reduces the Fe-S cluster of Dph1-Dph2 (24422557).
Dre2 はストレスのないときの Tah18 の結合相手として同定された（191: Dre2 was identified as the binding partner of Tah18 in the absence of stress (19194512).
Drg1 の働きを止めると Rlp24・Arx1・Tif6 に加え Nog1 も: Inactivating Drg1 relocates Nog1 to the cytoplasm in addition to Rlp24, Arx1, and Tif6. The Drg1 ATPase is required to release shuttling factors from newly exported pre-60S (17646390).
Dsc 複合体の E3 Tul1 は Cot1 のユビキチン化に重要で、亜鉛が少: The Dsc complex E3 Tul1 is important for Cot1 ubiquitination, and Cot1 is degraded when zinc is low (26527740).
Dse1 は Gβγ と MEKK の Ste11 に結合し、フェロモン経路と糸: Dse1 binds Gβγ and the MEKK Ste11 and appears to control crosstalk between the pheromone and filamentous growth pathways (19820940).
Dsn1 は Mif2・Cse4 と、Mtw1・Nnf1・Nsl1 と共免疫沈降: Dsn1 co-immunoprecipitates with Mif2 and Cse4, and with Mtw1, Nnf1, and Nsl1 (14602074).
Dsn1 は mtw1-1 の多コピー抑圧遺伝子で、Mtw1・Nnf1・Nsl1: Dsn1 is a multicopy suppressor of mtw1-1 and co-precipitates with Mtw1, Nnf1, and Nsl1. mtw1 and dsn1 mutants have similar phenotypes (14602074).
Dsn1 は動原体の組み立てに重要で Aurora B（Ipl1）にリン酸化され: Dsn1 is important for kinetochore assembly and is phosphorylated by Aurora B (Ipl1), and this phosphorylation promotes binding between outer and inner kinetochore proteins (23636741). BioGRID's 20819936 is a structural paper on the MIND complex and does not address direction. The abstract is short and experimental details could not be checked, so confidence is medium.
Dss4 は Sec4 と複合体を作り、試験管内で Sec4 からの GDP・G: Dss4 forms a complex with Sec4 and accelerates release of GDP and GTP from Sec4 in vitro (9218467).
Dug1p・Dug2p・Dug3p は Dug1p-Dug2p と Dug2p-: Dug1p, Dug2p, and Dug3p form a GSH-degrading complex through Dug1p-Dug2p and Dug2p-Dug3p interactions (17179087).
Dug2 と Dug3 の結合は Dug2 の WD40 ドメインを介する。両方: Dug2–Dug3 binding is mediated by the WD40 domain of Dug2. Together they cleave glutathione (reconstitution). They form a (Dug2-Dug3)2 complex (22277648).
Dun1 による Cep3 のリン酸化が、CAG 反復の崩れたフォークの核周辺へ: Dun1-mediated phosphorylation of Cep3 is required for relocation of collapsed forks at CAG repeats to the nuclear periphery (40742805).
Dun1 の停止での働きは修復遺伝子の転写とは別で、DNA 損傷で Pds1 が: Dun1's role in arrest is separate from transcription of repair genes and is required to prevent destruction of Pds1 upon DNA damage. dun1Δ degrades Pds1 and escapes G2 arrest even when Chk1 and Rad53 are active. This degradation is due to Rsp5, not the APC (32402080).
Dun1 は DNA 損傷で体内でリン酸化され、試験管内で Tel1・Mec1: Dun1 is phosphorylated in vivo upon DNA damage and is a substrate of Tel1 and Mec1 in vitro. Dun1 lacking SQ motifs is barely phosphorylated by Mec1. SQ-site mutations do not affect sensitivity to DNA damage (12967660).
Dun1 is phosphorylated in vivo upon DNA damage and is a substrate of Tel1 and Mec1 in vitro. Dun1 lacking SQ motifs retains most of its phosphorylation by Tel1 (12967660).
Dun1 は生体内で Sml1 と結合し、dun1Δ では S 期と DNA 損: Dun1 binds Sml1 in vivo, and in dun1Δ Sml1 accumulates in S phase and after DNA damage and its phosphorylated form disappears. Dun1 phosphorylates Sml1 in vitro and removes Sml1 at the final step of the Mec1/Rad53 pathway (11904430). Dun1-mediated phosphorylation reduces Sml1 and increases active RNR. The sites are S56, S58, and S60 (14684746).
Dxo1 は 25S rRNA の 5' 端の最終加工に必要で、Rat1 の下流: Dxo1 is required for final processing of the 5' end of 25S rRNA and acts downstream of Rat1 (35140172).
Dyn2 は中間鎖 Pac11 と直接結合し、その結合はダイニンとダイナクチンの: Dyn2 binds the intermediate chain Pac11 directly, and this binding is required for the dynein–dynactin interaction and spindle positioning (21633107).
Dys1 と Lia1 が eIF5A のハイプシン化の 2 段階を触媒する（2: Dys1 and Lia1 catalyze the two steps of eIF5A hypusination (23573236). Lia1 binds the C-terminal domain of eIF5A (14675757).
E1 の Apg7 は Apg12 を E2 の Apg10（Atg10）に、A: The E1 Apg7 transfers Apg12 to the E2 Apg10 (Atg10) and Apg8 to the E2 Apg3 (11100732).
E1 の Apg7（Atg7）は 2 つのユビキチン様タンパク質 Apg12・A: The E1 Apg7 (Atg7) activates the two ubiquitin-like proteins Apg12 and Apg8 and transfers them to the E2s Apg10 and Apg3, respectively (11100732).
E2 の Atg3 は Atg8 を PE に結合させ、Atg8 はこの形で働く: The E2 Atg3 conjugates Atg8 to PE, and Atg8 functions in this form (Atg12-Atg5 assists Atg3 as an E3) (23503366). Because lipidation is the form in which Atg8 functions, it was classified as activation (the draft said "not a signaling flow").
E2 の Pex4 はペルオキシソーム膜の Pex22 と結合し、Pex22 の: The E2 Pex4 binds Pex22 in the peroxisomal membrane, and Pex22 binding enhances ubiquitin transfer by Pex4 to substrates in vitro. Pex4 unable to bind Pex22 cannot ubiquitinate Pex5 in vivo. The functional E2 is Pex4:Pex22, not Pex4 alone (22085930). Consistent with the GO direction (activation).
E2 の Ubc12 が 2 つの E3（Hrt1 と Dcn1）と働いて Ru: The E2 Ubc12 works with two E3s (Hrt1 and Dcn1) to attach Rub1 to the WHB region of Cdc53 (20832729).
E3 の Dma1 は G1 サイクリンの Pcl1 を試験管内と体内でユビキチ: The E3 Dma1 ubiquitinates the G1 cyclin Pcl1 in vitro and in vivo, and Pcl1 is stabilized in dma1 mutants. Pcl1 binds Dma1 and is degraded only after being phosphorylated by its own CDK (23264631).
E3 の Not4 は Rpt リングの組み立て中に Rpt5 を選んでユビキチ: The E3 Not4 selectively ubiquitinates Rpt5 during Rpt ring assembly. Nas2 and Hsm3 block this site. Rpt5 ubiquitination does not destabilize the ring but prevents addition of Rpn1 and Ubp6, halting proteasome assembly (30530678). No PMC full text.
ECM7 の欠失で Cch1/Mid1 の Ca2+ 取り込みが下がり、cnb1: ECM7 deletion reduces Ca2+ uptake through Cch1/Mid1, and it is greatly reduced in cnb1Δ (28742147).
EGOC の構造で Ego1 が Ego2・Ego3・Gtr1-Gtr2 を包み: In the EGOC structure, Ego1 wraps around Ego2, Ego3, and Gtr1-Gtr2, and Ego3 binds Gtr1-Gtr2 to stabilize the complex. EGO-TC is necessary and sufficient to recruit Gtr1-Gtr2 to the membrane and is required for proper TORC1 signaling (31579828).

In the EGOC structure, Ego1 wraps around Ego2, Ego3, and Gtr1-Gtr2, and Ego3 binds Gtr1-Gtr2 to stabilize the complex. EGO-TC is necessary and sufficient to recruit Gtr1-Gtr2 to the membrane and is required for proper TORC1 signaling (31579828). The dimeric form of Ego3 is essential for integrity and function of the EGO complex (23123112).
EH ドメインをもつ TAX4 と IRS4 は INP51 の NPF モチー: The EH domain-containing TAX4 and IRS4 bind INP51 via its NPF motifs and activate INP51 (15265867).
ENA1 は通常の増殖で抑えられ、浸透圧で解かれる。CRE に似た URS は抑: ENA1 is repressed under normal growth and derepressed by osmotic stress. A CRE-like URS requires Sko1 and Ssn6-Tup1 for repression, and Sko1 binds this sequence (9858577).
ENA1 プロモーターにストレスに応じる Crz1 の結合部位が 2 つあり、ア: The ENA1 promoter has two stress-responsive Crz1-binding sites, and Crz1 accounts for about 60% of the early response to alkalinization (27362362).
ENO1 は bHLH の Sgc1 で活性化される。Sgc1・Ino2・Ino: ENO1 is activated by the bHLH factor Sgc1. Regulation by Sgc1, Ino2, Ino4, and Cbf1 requires E-boxes E1–E3 (17351075).
ER をつなぐ Scs2/Scs22 を失うと Num1 の分布が乱れ、ダイニン: Loss of the ER tethers Scs2/Scs22 disrupts Num1 distribution and abolishes dynein-dependent microtubule sliding (30084355).
ER ストレス下で Imh1 が Tlg2 の後期 Golgi への逆行輸送を担: Under ER stress, Imh1 mediates retrograde transport of Tlg2 to the late Golgi, which is required for localization of Sft2 to the late Golgi (37610835).
Under ER stress, Imh1 mediates retrograde transport of Tlg2 to the late Golgi (37610835).
ESCRT-I は Vps23・Vps28・Vps37 からなる 350 kDa: ESCRT-I is a 350 kDa complex of Vps23, Vps28, and Vps37 (11511343). It is a 1:1:1:1 heterotetramer of Vps23, Vps28, Vps37, and Mvb12 (17442384).
ESCRT-I は Vps27 の C 末端の領域にエンドソーム膜上で結合し、そ: ESCRT-I binds the C-terminal region of Vps27 on endosomal membranes, and a PTVP within it is involved in efficient recruitment of ESCRT-I (12900393).
ESCRT-II の Vps25 が、不活性な単量体の Vps20 を Snf7: Vps25 of ESCRT-II converts inactive monomeric Vps20 into the active form that nucleates Snf7 polymerization (20134403).
ESCRT-III の Snf7・Vps20 と ESCRT-I・II の全サブ: Snf7 and Vps20 of ESCRT-III and all subunits of ESCRT-I and -II are required for activation of Rim101 by cleavage. The Rim20 N terminus binds Snf7. Non-ESCRT mutations affecting MVBs do not prevent cleavage (15371534).
ESCRT-III は 2 つの下位複合体からなり、Vps2–Vps24 の下位: ESCRT-III consists of two subcomplexes, and the Vps2–Vps24 subcomplex binds the Vps20–Snf7 complex and recruits cofactors (12194857).
ETP1 はエタノールで誘導される ENA1 プロモーターと HSP12・HSP: ETP1 is required for ethanol-induced transcriptional activation of the ENA1 promoter and of HSP12 and HSP26 (19416103).
ETR1-lacZ の発現は野生型で adr1Δ の 6.5 倍。ただし Etr: ETR1-lacZ expression in wild type is 6.5 times that in adr1Δ. However, Etr1p levels and activity do not change (19583790).
Eaf7 は Eaf5 と Eaf3 を橋渡しし、Eaf5/7/3 の三量体は: Eaf7 bridges Eaf5 and Eaf3, and the Eaf5/7/3 trimer is linked to NuA4 via Eaf5 (24843044).
Eaf7 は Eaf5 と Eaf3 を橋渡しする（24843044）。Eaf3: Eaf7 bridges Eaf5 and Eaf3 (24843044). Eaf3/5/7 promote NuA4 binding to H3K36me2/3 (27535225).
Ear1 と Ssh4 は重複して働く Rsp5 のアダプターで、ゴルジ体や細胞: Ear1 and Ssh4 are redundant Rsp5 adaptors required for sorting cargo from the Golgi and plasma membrane to the vacuole. They recruit Rsp5 and direct ubiquitination of specific cargo (18367543).
Ear1 はエンドソームのタンパク質で PPxY モチーフで Rsp5 と結合し: Ear1 is an endosomal protein that binds Rsp5 via its PPxY motif and is required for ubiquitination of selected cargo before sorting into MVBs. Ear1/Ssh4 recruit Rsp5 and direct ubiquitination of specific cargo (18367543).
Ebs1 は NMD のヘリカーゼ Upf1 と物理的に結合し、過剰発現で Up: Ebs1 physically binds the NMD helicase Upf1, and its overexpression recruits Upf1 to P-bodies (17984081).
Ecm10 は Ssc1 と同じく Mge1 と ATP 依存に結合する（111: Like Ssc1, Ecm10 binds Mge1 in an ATP-dependent manner (11150530).
Ecm11 か Gmc2 を欠くと Zip1 の染色体上の集合とポリコンプレック: Loss of Ecm11 or Gmc2 greatly impairs assembly of Zip1 on chromosomes and polycomplex formation (23326245).
Ecm11 の局在は ZMM の Zip4 に厳密に依存し、Zip4 は Ecm: Ecm11 localization depends strictly on the ZMM protein Zip4, which binds Ecm11 directly. Binding-defective mutations prevent Ecm11 from binding chromosomes and abolish SC formation (34969823).
Ecm11 は Gmc2 に依存して SUMO 化される。SUMO 化できない: Ecm11 is SUMOylated in a Gmc2-dependent manner. In non-SUMOylatable ecm11, assembly of Zip1 on chromosomes is impaired (23326245).
Ecm11 は減数分裂中に Lys5 で SUMO 化される。Ecm11 はツー: Ecm11 is SUMOylated at Lys5 during meiosis. Ecm11 binds Siz2 by two-hybrid, but Siz2 is not essential for its SUMOylation (17888002).
Ecm19 は CTA1・TSA2 の mRNA に直接結合し、その安定性を下げ: Ecm19 binds CTA1 and TSA2 mRNAs directly and reduces their stability (41269904).
Ecm22 と Upc2 が PRM1・PRM4 の基礎発現を正に制御し、フェロ: Ecm22 and Upc2 positively regulate basal expression of PRM1 and PRM4, and pheromone induction also largely depends on them (28986257).
Ecm22 と Upc2 は FHN1・NPR1・PRR2 とステロール合成遺伝: Ecm22 and Upc2 positively regulate expression of FHN1, NPR1, PRR2, and sterol synthesis genes (26448198).
Ecm22 と Upc2 は PRM1・PRM4 の基礎発現を正に制御し、フェロ: Ecm22 and Upc2 positively regulate basal expression of PRM1 and PRM4, and pheromone induction also depends mainly on both (28986257).
Ecm22 と Upc2 は PRM1・PRM4 の基礎発現を正に制御する（28: Ecm22 and Upc2 positively regulate basal expression of PRM1 and PRM4 (28986257).
Ecm25 は極性のあるエンドサイトーシス部位に集まり、Cdc42 と相互作用す: Ecm25 concentrates at polarized endocytic sites and interacts with Cdc42. Its deletion does not change Cdc42 activity (34010635).
Ecm29 がプロテアソームに結合するには α7（Pre10）の C 末端のリン: Binding of Ecm29 to the proteasome requires the phosphorylated C-terminal tail of α7 (Pre10) (27302526).
Ecm9 は Bet2 と複合体を作り、ファルネシル化された Ykt6 にゲラニ: Ecm9 forms a complex with Bet2 and adds a geranylgeranyl group to farnesylated Ykt6. In ecm9Δ, membrane localization of Ykt6 and autophagy decrease (40049413).
Ecm9 は Bet2 と複合体を作る（40049413）: Ecm9 forms a complex with Bet2 (40049413).
Eco1 の分解には Cdk1・Cdc7-Dbf4・Mck1 の順のプライミング: Eco1 degradation requires primed sequential phosphorylation by Cdk1, Cdc7-Dbf4, and Mck1, and only the latter two sites are spaced suitably for Cdc4 binding. When the DNA damage response inhibits Cdc7, Eco1 is not degraded and cohesion is established even after S phase (23314252).
Eco1 は Cdk1 に負に制御され、S 期のあとのリン酸化で SCF(Cdc: Eco1 is negatively regulated by Cdk1, and phosphorylation after S phase leads to its ubiquitination and degradation by SCF(Cdc4). Non-phosphorylated Eco1 establishes cohesion even after replication (21549314). The full text shows that Clb2-Cdk1 and Clb5-Cdk1 phosphorylate Eco1 to a similar extent in vitro, and because the rise in Clb2 coincides with the fall in Eco1, it proposes that the main regulator is Clb2-Cdk1 (at the proposal stage, so confidence is medium).
Eco1 は Cdk1 に負に制御され、S 期の後のリン酸化で SCF(Cdc4: Eco1 is negatively regulated by Cdk1, and phosphorylation after S phase leads to its ubiquitination and degradation by SCF(Cdc4). Non-phosphorylated Eco1 establishes cohesion even after replication (21549314). According to the BioGRID note, Clb5-Cdk1 phosphorylates it in vitro. The abstract does not specify the cyclin, so confidence is medium.
Eco1 は Smc3 の頭部の保存された 2 つのリシンをアセチル化し、クロマ: Eco1 acetylates two conserved lysines in the Smc3 head, promoting the tethering of sister chromatids by chromatin-bound cohesin. Acetylation occurs in S phase (18653894). Acetylation of K112/K113 relieves the block to establishment imposed by Scc3, Pds5, and Rad61, and Eco1 promotes entrapment of sister DNA (19328069).
Edc3 による RPS28B mRNA の分解には Rps28a か Rps2: Edc3-mediated degradation of RPS28B mRNA requires either Rps28a or Rps28b. Rps28b binds Edc3 and regulates its function (24492965).
Efg1-Bud22 二量体に Dbp4 が結合する。二量体は初期 90S 粒子: Dbp4 binds the Efg1-Bud22 dimer. The dimer is involved in U14 snoRNA function in early 90S particles (38000371).
Efm5 は EF1A の Lys-79 のトリメチル化に必要（25446118: Efm5 is required for trimethylation of EF1A Lys-79 (25446118). Efm5 methylates eEF1A in vitro (26545399).
Efm5（Ygr001c）は EF1A の Lys-79 のトリメチル化に必要。: Efm5 (Ygr001c) is required for trimethylation of EF1A Lys-79, which is lost in efm5Δ (25446118). Efm5 methylates eEF1A in vitro (26545399).
Efr3 は PIK 斑への Ypp1 と Stt4 の集合に必須（190751: Efr3 is essential for assembly of Ypp1 and Stt4 into PIK patches (19075114).
Egd1 は Gal4-DNA 複合体を安定化する活性の成分として同定され、欠失: Egd1 was identified as a component of an activity that stabilizes Gal4-DNA complexes, and its deletion reduces GAL gene induction (1448098).
Egd1 欠失で Atg32 のリン酸化とマイトファジーが減り、Atg32 の高: Egd1 deletion reduces Atg32 phosphorylation and mitophagy, which are restored by hyperphosphorylation of Atg32 (38177147).
Ego2（Ycr075w-a）は EGOC の新しい成分で、Gtr1-Gtr2: Ego2 (Ycr075w-a) is a new EGOC component required for integrity and localization of Gtr1-Gtr2 (26206314). ego2 deletion only partially impairs Gtr1-dependent TORC1 activation and vacuolar localization of Gtr1 (26609069).
Ehg1/May24 は Hip1・Bap2・Fur4 と結合し、高圧でパーミア: Ehg1/May24 binds Hip1, Bap2, and Fur4 and maintains permease levels at high pressure (31797992).
Ehg1/May24 は cER から細胞膜の Tat2 と trans で結合: Ehg1/May24 binds plasma membrane Tat2 in trans from the cER, promoting its partitioning into lipid rafts and maintaining its plasma membrane localization (40601413).
Elg1 が Mhf1/Mhf2 のヒストン様複合体と物理的に接触し、MPH1・: Elg1 physically contacts the histone-like Mhf1/Mhf2 complex and interacts genetically with MPH1 and CHL1 (23624835).
Elg1 がないと複製中に PCNA がクロマチンに溜まる。Elg1-RLC は: Without Elg1, PCNA accumulates on chromatin during replication. Elg1-RLC unloads unmodified and SUMOylated PCNA during replication (23499004).
Elg1 は Mhf1/Mhf2 複合体と物理的に接し、MPH1・CHL1 と遺: Elg1 physically contacts the Mhf1/Mhf2 complex and interacts genetically with MPH1 and CHL1 (23624835).
Elm1 が SNF1 複合体を活性化し、Thr210 のリン酸化と相関: Elm1 activates the SNF1 complex, correlating with Thr210 phosphorylation.
Elm1 は Gin4 を直接リン酸化して活性化し、Gin4 は Shs1 をリ: Elm1 directly phosphorylates and activates Gin4, and Gin4 phosphorylates Shs1. Acute inactivation of Elm1 abolishes mitotic Gin4 phosphorylation, and gin4 lacking the phosphorylation sites cannot localize to the bud neck (PMID 16861226). 40464802 also reports that Elm1 causes hyperphosphorylation of Gin4 in vitro.
Elm1 は SNF1 複合体の 3 つの上流キナーゼの 1 つで、Thr210: Elm1 is one of three upstream kinases of the SNF1 complex and activates it by Thr210 phosphorylation (Sak1 and Tos3 are also described as upstream kinases).
Elongator の最大サブユニット Elp1（Iki3）の生体内リン酸化部位: Of nine in vivo phosphorylation sites in Elp1 (Iki3), the largest Elongator subunit, four C-terminal sites are important for tRNA modification. Hrr25 directly phosphorylates S1198 and S1202, and analysis of non-phosphorylatable and phosphomimetic forms shows that phosphorylation acts positively on Elongator's tRNA modification function (25569479). 40930532 reports that Hrr25 autophosphorylation regulates its binding to Elp1.
Elp2 の結晶構造と変異解析で、WD40 の折りたたみが Elp1・Elp3: The crystal structure and mutational analysis of Elp2 show that its WD40 fold is required for binding Elp1 and Elp3. Elp2 is key to Elongator assembly (25960406).
Elp456 亜複合体の結晶構造。Elp4・Elp5・Elp6 のそれぞれが複合: Crystal structure of the Elp456 subcomplex. Each of Elp4, Elp5, and Elp6 is important for complex stability (22343726).
Elp4・Elp5・Elp6 の亜複合体は六量体の RecA 様 ATPase: The Elp4/Elp5/Elp6 subcomplex is a hexameric RecA-like ATPase ring, and all three are required to maintain the complex (22343726).
Emw1/TTC27 は eEF2 と物理的に結合し、Emw1 の働きが落ちると: Emw1/TTC27 physically binds eEF2, and impaired Emw1 function lowers eEF2 levels. Full text: Emw1–Eft2 binding was confirmed by PCA (41806041).
End3 の C 末端の End3 リピートが Pan1 の中央コイルドコイルの: The End3 repeats at the End3 C terminus bind the N-terminal side of the central coiled coil of Pan1 (24118836).
Ent1 に Prk1 のリン酸化部位を 2 つ見つけ、両方のトレオニンの Pr: Two Prk1 phosphorylation sites were found in Ent1, and Prk1-dependent phosphorylation of both threonines was shown. Genetics with phosphomimetic forms suggests that phosphorylation negatively regulates the Pan1-Ent1 complex (11694597).
Ent1/2・Yap1801/2 の 4 重欠失に Yap1802 の変異体を入: Introducing Yap1802 mutants into the Ent1/2 and Yap1801/2 quadruple deletion causes endocytosis defects. The dynamics of Ede1 and Pan1 depend on binding between adaptor NPF motifs and EH domains (18448668).
Env7 は Yck3 と結合し、Yck3 に直接リン酸化される。Env7 によ: Env7 binds Yck3 and is directly phosphorylated by Yck3. Env7's regulation of vacuole fusion/fission and its vacuolar localization depend on Yck3-dependent phosphorylation. The main site is S331. Non-phosphorylatable Env7 cannot negatively regulate fusion, and phosphomimetic S331 fragments vacuoles (32647006).
Epl1 の N 末端ドメインが Esa1 と Yng2 をつなぎ、Esa1 の: The N-terminal domain of Epl1 bridges Esa1 and Yng2 and enhances Esa1 catalytic activity (12782659).
Epl1 の構造上の役割が Esa1 の活性を高めるのに重要（28108589）: The structural role of Epl1 is important for enhancing Esa1 activity (28108589). The EPcA region of Epl1 and the Yng2 N terminus are sufficient, together with Esa1, to act on nucleosomes (15964809).
Eps1 は Pma1-D378N と共沈し、その ERAD による認識に必要。: Eps1 co-precipitates with Pma1-D378N and is required for its recognition by ERAD. It does not bind wild-type Pma1 (12881414).
Ere1 はレトロマー経路での Can1 の再利用に要り、取り込まれた Can1: Ere1 is required for recycling of Can1 via the retromer pathway and physically binds internalized Can1 (21880895).
Ere2 はエンドソームで Ere1 を含む複合体にあり、Ere1 の調節因子と: Ere2 is in an Ere1-containing complex at endosomes and acts as a regulator of Ere1 (21880895).
Erf2 欠失で Cpp1 が一部分解され、Akr1 欠失でこのファミリーは完全: Erf2 deletion causes partial degradation of Cpp1, and Akr1 deletion causes complete degradation of this family (38159851).
Erf4 はユビキチン依存の経路で Erf2 の安定性を調節し、パルミトイル-E: Erf4 regulates Erf2 stability through a ubiquitin-dependent pathway and is required for stable formation of the palmitoyl-Erf2 intermediate. Without Erf4, hydrolysis of the intermediate accelerates and palmitoyl transfer to Ras2 decreases (22904317).
Erg25p は Erg27p・Erg28p と共免疫沈降する。Erg28p は: Erg25p co-immunoprecipitates with Erg27p and Erg28p. Erg28p is proposed as the membrane scaffold of the demethylation complex (12119386).
Erg25・Erg26・Erg27・Erg28 を含む複合体が取れた。Erg28: A complex containing Erg25, Erg26, Erg27, and Erg28 was isolated. Erg28 is thought to be a transmembrane scaffold tethering Erg27 and others (12119386).
Erg27 は Erg7 と結合し、Erg7 が脂肪滴に付くのを助け、ER と脂: Erg27 binds Erg7, helps Erg7 associate with lipid droplets, and prevents its degradation in the ER and lipid droplets. Erg27 is required for Erg7 activity in lipid droplets, and in erg27, truncated Erg7 mislocalizes to microsomes (12842197).
Erg28 は Erg27 と相互に共免疫沈降し、Erg25-28 を含む複合体: Erg28 and Erg27 reciprocally co-immunoprecipitate, and a complex containing Erg25–28 is isolated. Erg28 is proposed as a transmembrane scaffold tethering Erg27 and others (12119386).
Erg29 はメチルステロール酸化（Erg25 の段階）に働く。ERG29 の低: Erg29 acts in methylsterol oxidation (the Erg25 step). Reduced ERG29 causes methylsterols to accumulate, as does Erg25 deletion (29773647).
Eri1 は GTP 型 Ras2 と結合する小胞体のタンパク質で、GPI アン: Eri1 is an ER protein that binds GTP-bound Ras2 and is a component of the GPI-GnT complex that carries out the first step of GPI anchor synthesis. GTP-bound Ras2 binds the GPI-GnT complex in vivo and inhibits its activity (15163411). Consistent with the UniProt direction (inhibition).
Ero1 は PDI を酸化し、酸化力は Ero1 → PDI → 基質の順に流: Ero1 oxidizes PDI, and oxidizing equivalents flow Ero1 → PDI → substrate. In ero1-1 mutants, PDI is reduced.
Erp1 と Erp2 は Emp24・Erv25 とヘテロ複合体を作って働く（: Erp1 and Erp2 function by forming heterocomplexes with Emp24 and Erv25 (genetics and biochemistry) (10359606).
Erp1・Erp2 は Emp24・Erv25 とヘテロ複合体を作って働く（10: Erp1 and Erp2 function by forming heterocomplexes with Emp24 and Erv25 (10359606).
Erv1 の 2 つのシャトルシステインは、MIA 経路の基質の取り込みと Mi: The two shuttle cysteines of Erv1 are required for import of MIA pathway substrates and oxidation of Mia40 (24625320). Mia40 is reduced after oxidizing substrates and must be reoxidized to regain function, which Erv1 does (19076451, review). A reduced Mia40 C-terminal fragment is oxidized by Erv1 in vitro (17959605).
Erv1 の結合タンパク質を質量分析で探し Aim32 を同定。共精製で確認（3: Aim32 was identified by mass spectrometry searching for Erv1-binding proteins and confirmed by co-purification (34461091).
Erv14 は Nha1 の ER から細胞膜への輸送に必要で、両者は結合。er: Erv14 is required for transport of Nha1 from the ER to the plasma membrane, and the two bind. In erv14, Nha1-GFP mislocalizes and cells are Na-sensitive (26440927).
Erv2 は FAD をもつスルフヒドリル酸化酵素で、ジチオール-ジスルフィド交: Erv2 is an FAD-containing sulfhydryl oxidase that transfers oxidizing equivalents to Pdi1 by dithiol–disulfide exchange (11584268).
Erv41 と Erv46 は COPII 小胞の主な構成要素で、小胞体とゴルジ: Erv41 and Erv46 are major components of COPII vesicles and form a complex that cycles between the ER and Golgi (17077122).
Erv41-Erv46 の働きがないと小胞体の酵素グルコシダーゼ I（Gls1）: Without Erv41-Erv46 function, the ER enzyme glucosidase I (Gls1) mislocalizes and is degraded in the vacuole. The luminal domain of Gls1 binds the complex in a pH-dependent manner (25583996).
Erv41・Erv46 が Ktr4 のゴルジへの正しい局在に要る。Erv41-: Erv41 and Erv46 are required for correct Golgi localization of Ktr4. The Erv41-Erv46 complex is the adaptor for ER export of Ktr4 (also with biochemical evidence) (24585773).
Esa1 は自食作用に要り、Atg3 の K19・K48 をアセチル化して At: Esa1 is required for autophagy and acetylates Atg3 at K19 and K48, regulating Atg3–Atg8 binding and Atg8 lipidation. Acetylation occurs transiently upon starvation; when it weakens, autophagy weakens, and removing Rpd3 increases acetylation and autophagy (22539722). 19303850 is a paper on Pck1 acetylation.
Esc2 は止まった複製フォークに結合し、クロマチンへの集まりと入れ替わりを通じ: Esc2 binds stalled replication forks and counteracts the anti-recombinase Srs2 through its chromatin recruitment and turnover. Mutations in the SUMO-like domain of Esc2 reduce Rad51 recruitment to damaged forks (26443850).
Esc8p はツーハイブリッドと試験管内で Sir2p と結合する（123993: Esc8p binds Sir2p by two-hybrid and in vitro (12399377).
Esc8p はメディエーターの Gal11 と結合する（12399377）: Esc8p binds the Mediator subunit Gal11 (12399377).
Esf2 は Dbp8 に結合し、ATP の Km を下げて Dbp8 の AT: Esf2 binds Dbp8, lowers the Km for ATP, and enhances Dbp8 ATPase activity (16772403).
Esp1 が切った SCC1 の断片は N 末端則（Ubr1）で分解され、ubr: The SCC1 fragment cleaved by Esp1 is degraded by the N-end rule (Ubr1), and in ubr1Δ, stabilization of this fragment increases chromosome loss (11309624).
Ess1 は Swi6・Whi5 の転写ではなく核局在に必要。生体内で結合し、リ: Ess1 is required for nuclear localization, not transcription, of Swi6 and Whi5. They bind in vivo, and Ess1 binds phosphorylated NLS peptides directly in vitro (24470217).
Est1 の核への取り込みは Srp1（importin α）が担い、srp1: Nuclear import of Est1 is mediated by Srp1 (importin α), and the telomere shortening of srp1 mutants is rescued by increasing Est1 (24906415).
Est3 と RPA の結合が生体内のテロメラーゼの働きに必要。RPA2（RFA: Est3–RPA binding is required for telomerase function in vivo. Mutations in RPA2 (RFA2) cause the Est phenotype (39913192).
Est3 は Est2 の TEN ドメインに直接結合し、その結合に依存してテロ: Est3 binds the TEN domain of Est2 directly and enhances telomerase activity in a binding-dependent manner. Mutations disrupting this binding cause telomere shortening (21659533).
Etf1（Atg27）は PI3P に結合し、その結合に KKPAKK 配列が要: Etf1 (Atg27) binds PI3P, which requires a KKPAKK sequence. ETF1 deletion or mutations that prevent PI3P binding impair the Cvt pathway (12186856). Full text: inactivating a temperature-sensitive Vps34 mutant changes Etf1 localization, and Etf1 localization requires PI3P synthesis by Vps34.
Etp1 は亜ヒ酸の存在下での増殖と ACR3 の十分な発現に必要。Yap8 と: Etp1 is required for growth in the presence of arsenite and for full ACR3 expression. It acts independently of Yap8 (35323907).
Euc1 が Slx5 の SIM と新しい基質認識ドメインに結合し、Slx5/: Euc1 binds the SIMs and a new substrate-recognition domain of Slx5, directing Slx5/Slx8 to hotspots (31015336).
Exo-9-Mpp6 複合体の結晶構造で、Mpp6 の中央ドメインの短い配列が: In the crystal structure of the Exo-9-Mpp6 complex, a short sequence in the central domain of Mpp6 binds Rrp40 (28877463).
Exo1 はポロキナーゼとの非典型の結合を通じて触媒によらない重要な役割を持つ。: Exo1 has an important non-catalytic role through atypical binding to polo kinase. Once crossover repair is designated, MutLγ-Exo1 binds recombination intermediates, and Cdc5 is then directly recruited to elicit the crossover activity of MutLγ (33199619).
Exo70 のドメイン C を除くとエキソシストへの Sec5 と Sec6 の: Removing domain C of Exo70 causes defects in incorporation of Sec5 and Sec6 into the exocyst (18946089).
Exo70 は Bem1 に直接・特異的に結合する。Bem1 との結合だけを壊す: Exo70 binds Bem1 directly and specifically. Exo70 mutations that disrupt only Bem1 binding abolish actin-independent localization of Exo70. This partly overlaps with Sec3 and Sec15.
Exo70 は Rho3 と Cdc42 の両方の直接の効果器。EXO70 の機: Exo70 is a direct effector of both Rho3 and Cdc42. Gain-of-function EXO70 mutations suppress exocytosis-defective cdc42 mutations, and the phenotypes of Exo70 loss-of-function mutations are consistent with its being a Cdc42 effector.
Exo70 は Rho3 と Cdc42 の両方の直接の効果器で、EXO70 の: Exo70 is a direct effector of both Rho3 and Cdc42, and gain-of-function EXO70 mutations strongly suppress exocytosis-defective rho3 and cdc42 mutations. Prenylation promotes binding (19955214). The vesicle docking and fusion functions of Rho3 are mediated by Exo70 (10588647).
F-BAR をもつ RhoGAP の Rgd3 は主に Rho3 に、ついで C: The F-BAR-containing RhoGAP Rgd3 is active mainly toward Rho3 and secondarily toward Cdc42 (32941095). Full text: in vitro, Rgd3 stimulates the GTPase activity of Rho3 and Cdc42 about 2-fold.
FACT の Spt16 は Psh1 に結合し、この結合は Cse4 のユビキ: Spt16 of FACT binds Psh1, and this binding is required for Cse4 ubiquitination and exclusion from euchromatin. Psh1 mutants unable to bind FACT show reduced binding to Cse4 in vivo (25128498).
FAP1 は生体内と試験管内で FKBP12 と結合し、ラパマイシンと競合する（: FAP1 binds FKBP12 in vivo and in vitro and competes with rapamycin (10998178).
FAS1・FAS2 は Reb1・Rap1・Abf1 と、リン脂質に特異的な活性: Transcription of FAS1 and FAS2 is regulated via upstream binding sites by Reb1, Rap1, and Abf1 and by the phospholipid-specific activator dimer Ino2/Ino4 (11713312). The ACS2 activation sequence (ICRE) is also present upstream of FAS1 and FAS2 (9326360).
FBPase のカタボライト分解に Cdc48-Ufd1-Npl4 複合体とユビ: Catabolite degradation of FBPase requires the Cdc48-Ufd1-Npl4 complex and the ubiquitin receptors Dsk2 and Rad23, which act between polyubiquitination and degradation (20206597).
FDO1 の欠失は Mcd1 の量を増やして eco1 rad61 の温度感受性: FDO1 deletion suppresses the temperature sensitivity of eco1 rad61 by increasing Mcd1 levels (39110836).
FEAR 経路は Clb1・Clb2 と組んだ Cdk による Net1 のリン: The FEAR pathway promotes phosphorylation of Net1 by Cdk with Clb1 and Clb2, and this phosphorylation is required for release of Cdc14 from the nucleolus (FEAR) (15273393). 30927017 also reports that Cdk-dependent Net1 phosphorylation releases Cdc14 (same as CDC28 ⊣ NET1).
FET4 は亜鉛の状態に応じて Zap1 で制御され、Fet4 は生理的な亜鉛輸: FET4 is regulated by Zap1 according to zinc status, and Fet4 is a physiological zinc transporter. Rox1 attenuates activation by Aft1 and Zap1 under aerobic conditions (12095998).
FET4 は酸素に応じて Rox1 リプレッサーで制御され、Rox1 は好気条件: FET4 is regulated by the Rox1 repressor in response to oxygen, and Rox1 attenuates activation by Aft1 and Zap1 under aerobic conditions (12095998).
FIT1・FIT2・FIT3 の mRNA は鉄の欠乏で Aft1p に依存して: FIT1, FIT2, and FIT3 mRNAs increase 60- to 230-fold under iron deprivation in an Aft1p-dependent manner (11673473).
FIT1・FIT2・FIT3 は Aft1 に直接制御され、鉄欠乏で Aft1: FIT1, FIT2, and FIT3 are directly regulated by Aft1, and their mRNAs increase 60- to 230-fold under iron deprivation in an Aft1-dependent manner (11673473).
FKBP（FPR1）とラパマイシンの複合体が毒性の本体で、TOR1・TOR2 が: The FKBP (FPR1)–rapamycin complex is the toxic agent, and TOR1 and TOR2 are its targets. Non-allelic non-complementation among FPR1, TOR1, and TOR2 suggests a complex (genetic).
FKS2 は細胞壁ストレスで Mpk1–Swi4 の非触媒的な仕組みで誘導され、: FKS2 is induced under cell wall stress by a non-catalytic Mpk1–Swi4 mechanism, and YLR042c (NFG1) is induced by the same mechanism (20641022).
FLO1 の脱抑制では Sas3 と Ada2(Gcn5) に依存する H3K1: Derepression of FLO1 involves H3K14 acetylation dependent on Sas3 and Ada2(Gcn5); without it, transcription elongation decreases (28115623). Loss of both Gcn5 and Sas3 causes a large global loss of H3 acetylation and arrest in G2/M (11731478).
FLO10 は FLO11 と同じ転写因子 Sfl1・Flo8 に制御されるが、: FLO10 is regulated by the same transcription factors as FLO11, Sfl1 and Flo8, but is silenced by Hst1 and Hst2 (15016375).
FLR1 プロモーターの 3 つの YRE を同時に変えると Yap1 による転: Simultaneously altering the three YREs in the FLR1 promoter abolishes transcriptional activation by Yap1. Yap1 binds the three YREs, and FLR1 induction by oxidants, benomyl, and MMS is due to Yap1 (11056165).
FMN が還元されると Yap4 が Lot6-プロテアソーム複合体に結合し、分: When FMN is reduced, Yap4 binds the Lot6-proteasome complex, which protects it from degradation and also controls its localization. In unstressed cells, Yap4 is not in the nucleus (19029946).
FOB1 を不活化すると中期で止めた細胞で Cdc14 が早すぎて核小体から放出: Inactivating FOB1 causes premature release of Cdc14 from the nucleolus in metaphase-arrested cells, and increasing FOB1 delays release. Fob1 binds Cfi1/Net1 and acts as a negative regulator of FEAR (15043811).
FOL3 の変異で H3T11 のリン酸化が大きく下がる。本文: TetO7-F: FOL3 mutations greatly reduce H3T11 phosphorylation. Full text: in TetO7-FOL3, doxycycline reduces H3pT11, and metabolic enzymes such as Fol3 regulate Pyk1-mediated H3T11 phosphorylation (28426732).
FRDS1（FRD1）の発現は嫌気で誘導され、その誘導は rox1 変異で失われ: FRDS1 (FRD1) expression is induced under anaerobiosis, and this induction is lost in rox1 mutants (17345583).
FRE2 は鉄に応じる DNA 結合の転写活性化因子 Aft1 で誘導される。A: FRE2 is induced by the iron-responsive DNA-binding transcriptional activator Aft1. Aft1 binds the FRE2 UAS (14739928).
FRE3〜FRE6 の発現は AFT1-1 細胞で上がり aft1 欠失で下がる: Expression of FRE3–FRE6 increases in AFT1-1 cells and decreases in aft1 deletion. Iron regulation acts through Aft1 (9726978).
FRE3〜FRE6 は鉄の制限で発現し、AFT1-1 で上がり aft1 欠損で: FRE3–FRE6 are expressed under iron limitation, increased in AFT1-1, and decreased in aft1 mutants (9726978).
FRET・FLIM で Ato1p と Ato2p が細胞膜で相互作用し複合体を: FRET/FLIM shows that Ato1p and Ato2p interact at the plasma membrane to form a complex. There is no Ato2p–Ato2p interaction (22579979).
FRM2 はカドミウムに応答する Yap2 の標的（17187783）。Yap2: FRM2 is a Yap2 target responsive to cadmium (17187783). FRM2 was reconfirmed as a Yap2 target (23334931).
FRS1 と FRS2 は細胞質のフェニルアラニル tRNA 合成酵素の 2 つ: FRS1 and FRS2 encode the two subunits of cytoplasmic phenylalanyl-tRNA synthetase. Synthesis of both mRNAs is not limiting, and the balance appears to be determined at the translational level (3049607).
FUS1 の転写は STE4・STE5・STE7・STE11・STE12 に完全: FUS1 transcription is fully dependent on STE4, STE5, STE7, STE11, and STE12, and the PRE acts as a UAS (1903837).
Fab1 が作る PI(3,5)P2 は TORC1 の活性を支える（33157: PI(3,5)P2 produced by Fab1 supports TORC1 activity (33157024).
Fab1 はシャペロニン様ドメインで Vac14・Fig4 と結合し、液胞の複合: Fab1 binds Vac14 and Fig4 via its chaperonin-like domain, forming the vacuolar complex (18653468).
Fal1 と Sgd1 は Sgd1 の MIF4G ドメインを介して直接結合し: Fal1 and Sgd1 bind directly via the MIF4G domain of Sgd1, and the MIF4G domain enhances Fal1 catalytic activity in vitro (31994962).
Fap7 が回転状態の形成を促し、Dim1 を前駆 40S サブユニットから放出: Fap7 promotes formation of the rotated state and releases Dim1 from pre-40S subunits (28890337).
Far-Western で Prp19 と Snt309 の直接の結合を示した（: Far-western blotting showed direct binding of Prp19 and Snt309 (9528791).
Far1 は Fus3 の基質で、このリン酸化が Far1 と Cdc28-Cl: Far1 is a Fus3 substrate, and this phosphorylation determines Far1 binding to Cdc28-Cln2 (8500168). Fus3-mediated phosphorylation is said to make Far1 bind G1 Cdk; without the activating modification at T306, Far1 cannot cause G1 arrest, and only phosphorylated Far1 binds Cdc28-Cln2 (9632750). In 11525741, Fus3 also selectively phosphorylates Far1.
Far1 は G1 だけで安定で、その分解には Cdc34・Cdc4・Cdc53: Far1 is stable only in G1, and its degradation requires Cdc34, Cdc4, Cdc53, and Skp1. Far1 is ubiquitinated in vitro in a CDC34- and CDC4-dependent manner, and phosphorylation by Cdc28-Cln serves as the recognition mark (9367986). BioGRID's 11080155 is a paper reporting that SCF-Cdc4 ubiquitinates Far1 in the nucleus, and Cdc34 does not appear in its abstract.
Far1 は G1 期だけ安定で、SCF-Cdc4・Cdc34 によるユビキチン: Far1 is stable only in G1 and undergoes ubiquitin-dependent degradation by SCF-Cdc4 and Cdc34. Far1-22, with the S87P mutation, has altered phosphorylation by Cdc28-Cln2, is stabilized, and causes G1 arrest without pheromone. Phosphorylation by Cdc28-Cln is thought to be part of the ubiquitination signal (9367986).
Far1 は G1 期だけ安定で、分解には Cdc34・Cdc4・Cdc53・S: Far1 is stable only in G1, and its degradation requires Cdc34, Cdc4, Cdc53, and Skp1. Wild-type Far1 is ubiquitinated in vitro in a CDC34- and CDC4-dependent manner (9367986).
Far3-7-8 亜複合体が Far11 を ER へ呼ぶ（23625923）: The Far3-7-8 subcomplex recruits Far11 to the ER (23625923).
Far3・Far7・Far8 の亜複合体は Far9/10 により ER へ呼ば: The Far3/Far7/Far8 subcomplex is recruited to the ER by Far9/10, and Far3-7-8 in turn recruits Far11 (23625923).
Far3・Far7・Far8 は部分複合体をつくり、Far9/10 によって小胞: Far3, Far7, and Far8 form a subcomplex that is recruited to the ER by Far9/10 (23625923).
Far3・Far7・Far8・Far9・Far10・Far11 を Ppg1 に: Far3, Far7, Far8, Far9, Far10, and Far11 were identified as Ppg1-binding proteins. Ppg1 and the Far complex cooperatively dephosphorylate Atg32 and suppress mitophagy (29925000).
Far3・Far7・Far8・Far9・Far10・Far11 を Ppg1 の: Far3, Far7, Far8, Far9, Far10, and Far11 were identified as Ppg1-binding proteins. Deletion of Far genes accelerates mitophagy (29925000).
Far9 と Far10 は小胞体に局在し、Far3・Far7・Far8 の部分: Far9 and Far10 localize to the ER and recruit the Far3/Far7/Far8 subcomplex to the ER. Far3-7-8 then recruits Far11 (23625923).
Fat1 と Faa1（または Faa4）は two-hybrid と共免疫沈降: Fat1 and Faa1 (or Faa4) bind by two-hybrid and co-immunoprecipitation, forming a fatty acid uptake complex (12601005).
Fat1p と Faa1p または Faa4p は共免疫沈降し、脂肪酸取り込みの: Fat1p co-immunoprecipitates with Faa1p or Faa4p, forming a fatty acid uptake complex (12601005).
Fbp1 の分解には Cdc48-Ufd1-Npl4 とユビキチン受容体 Dsk: Fbp1 degradation requires Cdc48-Ufd1-Npl4 and the ubiquitin receptors Dsk2 and Rad23, which act between polyubiquitination and proteasomal degradation (20206597).
Fcf1 と Fcf2 は 40S の形成因子 Faf1 の TAP 精製で同定: Fcf1 and Fcf2 were identified by TAP purification of the 40S formation factor Faf1; they localize to the nucleolus and are required for 18S rRNA synthesis (16762320).
Fcf2 は Faf1 の TAP 精製で共精製された。核小体に局在し 18S: Fcf2 co-purified with Faf1 in TAP purification. It localizes to the nucleolus and is required for processing of the 18S rRNA precursor (16762320).
Fcp1 が Rpb1 の CTD の Thr4P のホスファターゼであることを: It is suggested that Fcp1 is a phosphatase for Thr4P of the Rpb1 CTD. Rpb4 is required for association of Fcp1 with the CTD and correlates with Ser2P levels (25416796).
Fcp1 の C 末端領域は TFIIF の RAP74（Tfg1）に直接結合す: The C-terminal region of Fcp1 binds RAP74 (Tfg1) of TFIIF directly (11003641).
Fe/S クラスターの配位を壊すと Mak16 が不安定になり Mak16-Rp: Disrupting Fe/S cluster coordination destabilizes Mak16, impairs formation of the Mak16-Rpf1 complex, and reduces 25S rRNA (41231949).
Fes1 は Ssa1 の NEF。Ssa1・Ssb1 に同程度に結合し、Ssb: Fes1 is the NEF for Ssa1. It binds Ssa1 and Ssb1 to a similar extent and accelerates release of an ADP analog from Ssb1 35-fold (17132105).
Fhl1 と Ifh1 はほぼリボソームタンパク質遺伝子のプロモーターだけに結合: Fhl1 and Ifh1 bind almost exclusively to ribosomal protein gene promoters, and this binding depends on Rap1 (15616568).
Fhl1 のリボソームタンパク質遺伝子のプロモーターへの結合は Rap1 に依存: Fhl1 binding to ribosomal protein gene promoters depends on Rap1 (15616568).
Fin1-PP1 は Bub1 の相手 Bub3 の動原体からの除去も促すが、M: Fin1-PP1 also promotes removal of Bub1's partner Bub3 from kinetochores but has no effect on Mad1. Kinetochore localization of Bub1-Bub3 in anaphase requires Ipl1 activity, and Fin1-PP1 reduces it by promoting dephosphorylation of the Ipl1 substrate Ndc80 (34033659).
Fip1 の 206–220 番が Yth1 との結合と特異的なポリ A 付加に: Residues 206–220 of Fip1 are required for binding Yth1 and for specific polyadenylation (11238938).
Fip1 は Pap1 に結合し C 末端の RNA 結合部位への基質の接近を制: Fip1 binds Pap1 and restricts substrate access to its C-terminal RNA-binding site, inhibiting elongation. The Fip1 C terminus relieves this inhibition (11238938).
Fis1・Gem1 を見る画面で、Mpf1（YNL144C）を欠くとペルオキシソ: In a screen monitoring Fis1 and Gem1, loss of Mpf1 (YNL144C) increases the fraction going to peroxisomes (40175596).
Fis1・Gem1 を見る画面で、Tom70・Tom71・Mpf1（YNL144: In a screen monitoring Fis1 and Gem1, loss of Tom70, Tom71, or Mpf1 (YNL144C) increases the fraction going to peroxisomes (40175596).
Fkh1 のアミノ酸 51-125 が Sin3 の PAH2 に直接結合し、S: Residues 51–125 of Fkh1 bind the PAH2 of Sin3 directly and recruit Sin3. Sin3 binding to the CLB2 and SWI5 promoters depends on Fkh1 (33635403).
Fkh2 は CDK の標的で、リン酸化により共活性化因子 Ndd1 との結合が: Fkh2 is a CDK target, and phosphorylation strengthens its binding to the coactivator Ndd1, playing an important role in periodic expression of the CLB2 cluster (15509804). BioGRID's 14574415 is a large-scale screen.
Fks1 のクライオ電顕構造から Gsr1 が結合相手として見つかり、変異で結合: The cryo-EM structure of Fks1 revealed Gsr1 as a binding partner, and binding was confirmed by mutation. Gsr1 stabilizes Fks1 (41354657). Consistent with the GO direction.
Fld1 と Nem1 はどちらも、小胞体の小区画が TAG 合成酵素や Yft: Both Fld1 and Nem1 are required for ER subdomains to recruit TAG synthases and Yft2, Pex30, and others (32349126).
Flo8 と Sfl1 は PKA の直接の標的で、同じプロモーター要素を通して: Flo8 and Sfl1 are direct targets of PKA and regulate FLO11 expression in opposite directions through the same promoter element. Tpk2-mediated phosphorylation promotes Flo8 binding and activation of the FLO11 promoter, and prevents Sfl1 dimerization and DNA binding, relieving repression (12024012).
Flo8・Mss11・Rgt1 が SKS1 の正常な転写産物量に必要（2460: Flo8, Mss11, and Rgt1 are required for normal SKS1 transcript levels (24603354).
Flx1 と Hem25 の両方を失うと呼吸を要する培地で生育できず、電子伝達系: Loss of both Flx1 and Hem25 prevents growth on media requiring respiration and reduces some electron transport chain complexes (28404662).
Fmp30 と Mdm31・Mdm32 の物理的な結合を示す。Ups1 によらな: Physical binding of Fmp30 with Mdm31 and Mdm32 is shown. All three are required for Ups1-independent CL accumulation (29180659).
Fmp30 は Mdm31・Mdm32 と物理的に結合する。Ups1 非依存のカ: Fmp30 physically binds Mdm31 and Mdm32. Ups1-independent cardiolipin accumulation depends on FMP30, MDM31, and MDM32 (29180659).
Fmp40 は Prx1・Trx3・Grx2 を試験管内で AMP 化し、生体内: Fmp40 AMPylates Prx1, Trx3, and Grx2 in vitro and binds Trx3 in vivo. AMPylation of Trx3 T66 is required for its levels and precursor maturation under oxidative stress (38795545).
Fmp45 は Ptc2 と相互作用して Rad53 の脱リン酸化を促し、過剰な: Fmp45 interacts with Ptc2 to promote Rad53 dephosphorylation and prevents excessive cell cycle arrest (41386832).
Fmp45 は Ptc2 と相互作用して Rad53 の脱リン酸化を促す（413: Fmp45 interacts with Ptc2 to promote Rad53 dephosphorylation (41386832).
Fpk1 は Akl1 の 2 か所をリン酸化してその働きを抑え、Fpk1 の部: Fpk1 phosphorylates two sites in Akl1 to inhibit its function; Akl1 lacking the Fpk1 sites is more active and endocytosis is delayed (28069741). Upon TORC2 inhibition, Fpk1-mediated phosphorylation of Akl1 lowers Akl1 activity and reduces phosphorylation of Pan1 and others (29895620).
Fpk1 は Akl1 をリン酸化して抑え、Fpk1 にリン酸化されない Akl: Fpk1 phosphorylates and inhibits Akl1; Akl1 that cannot be phosphorylated by Fpk1 is hyperactive and increases phosphorylation of its known substrates Sla1 and Ent2. In this Akl1 mutant, Sla1 leaves endocytic sites early and endocytosis is impaired (28069741, abstract). The discussion in the full text states that Akl1 phosphorylates Sla1, Ent2, and Pan1 and impairs their function (cited from the PMC full text).
Fpk1p/Fpk2p がリン酸化によって P4-ATPase の Dnf1p/: Fpk1p/Fpk2p activate the P4-ATPases Dnf1p/Dnf2p by phosphorylation (32719316).
Fpr1 は RP 遺伝子のほぼすべてのプロモーターに結合し、一部の RP 遺伝: Fpr1 binds nearly all RP gene promoters and promotes binding of Fhl1 and Ifh1 to some RP gene promoters, independently of or cooperatively with Hmo1 (32603360).
Fpr1 は一部の RP 遺伝子のプロモーターへの Fhl1・Ifh1 の結合を: Fpr1 promotes binding of Fhl1 and Ifh1 to some RP gene promoters, independently of or cooperatively with Hmo1 (32603360).
Fpr4 は H3・H4 の N 末端の尾に結合し、試験管内で H3 の P30: Fpr4 binds the N-terminal tails of H3 and H4 and isomerizes H3 P30 and P38 in vitro. Isomerization inhibits K36 methylation by Set2, and catalytic inactivation increases H3K36me in vivo (16959570).
Fpt1 の tRNA 遺伝子への結合は TFIIIB と TFIIIC を要し: Binding of Fpt1 to tRNA genes requires TFIIIB and TFIIIC but not RNAPIII. Full text: depleting Brf1, Bdp1, Tfc1, or Tfc3 from the nucleus abolishes Fpt1 binding (37995691).
Fre6 は液胞からの鉄の汲み出しの 2 つの系（Smf3 と Fet5-Fth: Fre6 supplies Fe(II) to the two systems that export iron from the vacuole (Smf3 and Fet5-Fth1) (17681937).
Fre6 は液胞膜にあり Ctr2 による液胞の銅の放出に働く。fre6Δ は: Fre6 is in the vacuolar membrane and acts in Ctr2-mediated release of vacuolar copper. fre6Δ shows the same copper-deficiency growth defect as ctr2Δ (17553781).
Fth1 は Fet5 と共免疫沈降で結合し、FET5 破壊で Fth1 が小胞: Fth1 binds Fet5 by co-immunoprecipitation, and FET5 disruption causes Fth1 to accumulate in the ER (10608875).
Fun30 は Exo1 と Sgs1 に依存する DSB の長い削り込みを促す: Fun30 is the main nucleosome remodeler promoting Exo1- and Sgs1-dependent long-range DSB resection (22960743).
Fur4 の基礎的な分解とストレスで誘導される分解はどちらも Rsp5 に依存し: Both basal and stress-induced degradation of Fur4 depend on Rsp5, and in npi1 mutants, ubiquitination decreases and plasma membrane Fur4 increases (8631913).
Fus1 の細胞表面への輸送は Chs5（エキソマー）に依存。IXTPK の変異: Transport of Fus1 to the cell surface depends on Chs5 (exomer). Mutation of IXTPK abolishes binding to Chs5 and mislocalizes Fus1 (19812245).
Fzf1 は CS2 配列を認識して SSU1 などの発現を制御し、化学物質によ: Fzf1 recognizes the CS2 sequence and regulates expression of SSU1 and others, and chemical induction is Fzf1-dependent (39359679).
Fzf1 は DDI2/3 プロモーターの CS2 に生体内・試験管内で結合し、: Fzf1 binds CS2 in the DDI2/3 promoters in vivo and in vitro, and binding is enhanced by cyanamide. Fzf1 overexpression alone induces DDI2/3 (35809138).
Fzf1 は DDI2/3 プロモーターの CS2 に結合し、CY/MMS によ: Fzf1 binds CS2 in the DDI2/3 promoters and is required for CY/MMS-induced DDI2/3 expression (35809138).
Fzf1 は NO ジオキシゲナーゼ YHB1 の発現を制御して NO の恒常性: Fzf1 maintains NO homeostasis by regulating expression of the NO dioxygenase YHB1, and NO activates Fzf1 at the protein level (34245655).
Fzo1 のホモ 2 量体化は Ugo1 と GTP 結合に依存する（21385: Homodimerization of Fzo1 depends on Ugo1 and GTP binding (21385840).
G-patch タンパク質 Cmg1（YLR271W）は Prp43 の新しい補: The G-patch protein Cmg1 (YLR271W) is a new Prp43 cofactor that stimulates Prp43 RNA binding and ATPase activity (26821976).
G1 Cdk が Sic1 をリン酸化し、Cdc34 によるユビキチン化と分解の: G1 Cdk phosphorylates Sic1, marking it for Cdc34-mediated ubiquitination and degradation. Sic1 lacking three Cdk sites is not ubiquitinated, is stable, and blocks DNA replication (9334303). BioGRID's 9346238 is a reconstitution paper showing that SCF-Cdc4 recognizes phosphorylated Sic1.
G1 Cdk がリン酸化した Sic1 は Cdc34 に依存してユビキチン化さ: Sic1 phosphorylated by G1 Cdk is ubiquitinated in a Cdc34-dependent manner and degraded. Sic1 lacking phosphorylation sites is not ubiquitinated, is stable, and blocks DNA replication (9334303). SCF-Cdc4, together with the E2 Cdc34 and E1, acts as the ubiquitin ligase for Sic1 (9346238). BioGRID's 21453497 is a paper characterizing Cdc34 mutants.
G1 の CDK（Cln/CDK）が Ste5 の膜結合モチーフの周りの部位をリ: G1 CDK (Cln/CDK) phosphorylates sites around the membrane-binding motif of Ste5, disrupting its membrane localization and inhibiting mating MAPK signaling (17289571).
G1 の初めと終わりで Clb6 の分解に APC-Cdh1 が要る。試験管内で: Degradation of Clb6 in early and late G1 requires APC-Cdh1. In vitro, Clb6 is an APC-Cdh1 substrate (KEN and D boxes) (26994663).
G1 サイクリン Cln1・Cln2 の分解は Cdc28 に依存するリン酸化で: Degradation of the G1 cyclins Cln1 and Cln2 begins with Cdc28-dependent phosphorylation, and phosphorylated Cln1 and Cln2 are ubiquitinated by SCF-Grr1 and degraded by the proteasome (11527976). BioGRID's 10213692 is a reconstitution paper in which SCF-Grr1 ubiquitinates phosphorylated Cln1, and 9346238 shows that Grr1 binds phosphorylated Cln1 and Cln2 (neither abstract states the phosphorylating kinase).
G1 サイクリン（Cln1・Cln2）に特異的な K/R ドッキングモチーフを、: A K/R docking motif specific to the G1 cyclins (Cln1, Cln2) was found in G1-CDK substrates such as Ste7 of the mating pathway (34502421).
G1 初めの EGT2 の発現を担うのは Swi5 と、より小さい程度で Ace: EGT2 expression in early G1 is driven by Swi5 and, to a lesser extent, Ace2 (8668141).
G1 期から後期まで RENT は核小体にあり Cdc14 の活性は Net1: From G1 to anaphase, RENT is in the nucleolus and Cdc14 activity is blocked by Net1. At the end of anaphase, Cdc14 leaves RENT in a Tem1-dependent manner (10219244). Cdc14 is held in the nucleolus and kept inactive by binding to Net1 for most of the cell cycle (18595708).
G1 期では 9-1-1 複合体が Ddc2 を損傷 DNA に呼び込むのに要り: In G1, the 9-1-1 complex is required to recruit Ddc2 to damaged DNA, and upon entry into S phase, both Cdc28 and 9-1-1 support Ddc2 focus formation (18406328).
G1 期に ubp15∆ では APC-Cdh1 による Clb5 の分解が速ま: In G1, APC-Cdh1-mediated degradation of Clb5 is accelerated in ubp15∆. Ubp15 deubiquitinates Clb5 in a reconstituted system and aids Clb5 accumulation and S-phase entry (25877870).
G1 期のチェックポイントでの Mec1 の活性化は Ddc1 によって起こり: Mec1 activation at the G1 checkpoint is mediated by Ddc1 and does not require Dpb11. In G2, there are two routes: direct activation of Mec1 by Ddc1, and recruitment of Dpb11 via Ddc1 T602 phosphorylation. Ddc1 W352 and W544 are essential for Mec1 activation in vitro and for the G1 checkpoint (20005839).
G1/S に Cdc28 が SPB で Kar9 をリン酸化し、細胞質微小管の: At G1/S, Cdc28 phosphorylates Kar9 at the SPB, and Cdc28 activity is required to concentrate Kar9 at the plus ends of cytoplasmic microtubules and establish contact with the bud cortex (12554645). S496 phosphorylation concentrates Kar9 on one SPB, and Clb4-mediated phosphorylation of S197 is required for Kar9 to direct microtubules into the bud (17251549). In contrast, 12600318 reports that Clb4-Cdc28 prevents loading of Kar9 onto the mother-side pole, which locally amounts to inhibition.
G1/S 期に Cdk1 が Nth1 をリン酸化して活性化し、トレハロースを中: At G1/S, Cdk1 phosphorylates and activates Nth1, channeling trehalose into central carbon metabolism (27203178). Under nutrient-poor conditions where PKA is weak, Cdk1-mediated S66 phosphorylation creates a Bmh1-binding site and contributes to Nth1 activity (33441790).
G2 期では 9-1-1 が 2 通りで Mec1 を活性化し、その一つは Dd: In G2, 9-1-1 activates Mec1 in two ways, one of which is recruitment of Dpb11 through phosphorylation of Ddc1 T602 (20005839). Dpb11 phosphorylation after DNA damage is lost in the ddc1-T602A mutant (18541674).
