G2/M で DSB が起きると Mcd1 がリン酸化され、それが Eco1 に: When DSBs occur in G2/M, Mcd1 is phosphorylated, which triggers Eco1-mediated acetylation of Mcd1, antagonizing Wpl1 and establishing damage-induced cohesion (19450529). 11864574 only shows acetylation of cohesin components in vitro.
G2/M に Ipl1 は Cdc13 のテロメラーゼ呼び込み領域をリン酸化して: In G2/M, Ipl1 phosphorylates the telomerase-recruitment domain of Cdc13, causing dissociation of Est1 and TLC1, and together with Pph22-mediated dephosphorylation removes telomerase from telomeres. Without this control, telomere elongation is deregulated and M phase is prolonged (25387524).
G2/M に Pph22 は Tel1/Mec1 による Cdc13 のリン酸化: In G2/M, Pph22 removes Tel1/Mec1-mediated phosphorylation of Cdc13, weakening Cdc13–Est1 binding, and together with Ipl1 removes telomerase from telomeres. Without this, telomeres overextend and M phase is prolonged (25387524).
G2/M 期の SBF（Swi4-Swi6）の転写活性は Clb2-Cdc28: The transcriptional activity of SBF (Swi4-Swi6) in G2/M is inhibited by Clb2-Cdc28. Swi4 binds Clb2-Cdc28 in vivo via its ankyrin repeats (8649372). CLBs are required for G2 repression of the SBF-regulated CLN1 and CLN2; Swi4 binds Clb2 and is phosphorylated by Clb2-Cdc28 in vitro (8402888).
GAL 遺伝子の活性化因子 GAL4 は、GAL4 のプロモーターに結合する M: GAL4, the activator of GAL genes, is repressed by MIG1, which binds the GAL4 promoter (1915298).
GAL10 からの読み過ごしで GAL7 プロモーターから Gal4p が外れる: Readthrough transcription from GAL10 displaces Gal4p from the GAL7 promoter. Overexpressing Gal4p restores binding and GAL7 expression (10890898).
GAL4 は UASG の 4 か所に結合して隣の GAL1・GAL10 の転写: GAL4 binds four sites in UASG and activates transcription of the adjacent GAL1 and GAL10. One mechanism of glucose repression is inhibition of GAL4 DNA binding (3886158).
GAL4 はガラクトースで育てた細胞で GAL80 の UAS に強く結合し、グ: GAL4 binds the GAL80 UAS strongly in galactose-grown cells, weakly in glycerol, and not at all in glucose (8248154).
GAP の Gyp7 は体内で液胞の Rab Ypt7 を不活性化する。効率よく: The GAP Gyp7 inactivates the vacuolar Rab Ypt7 in vivo. Efficient inactivation is aided downstream by the inhibitory casein kinase I Yck3 (18809726).
GAP は GTP の GDP への加水分解を促して Cdc42 を不活性化する: GAPs inactivate Cdc42 by promoting hydrolysis of GTP to GDP. Rga2 was newly identified, and genetics and biochemistry confirmed that Rga1, Rga2, and Bem3 act as Cdc42 GAPs. Rga1 and Rga2 affect binding of Cdc42 to Ste20 (12455995). Consistent with the GO direction (inhibition).
GAP1 の転写はグルタミン培地では起こらず、グルタミン酸では Gln3、尿素で: GAP1 transcription does not occur on glutamine medium and is activated by Gln3 on glutamate and by Nil1 (Gat1) on urea. Two GATAAG sites are required for both activations (8636059).
GAP1 の転写は尿素を窒素源にした細胞で Nil1(Gat1) により活性化さ: GAP1 transcription is activated by Nil1 (Gat1) in cells grown on urea as the nitrogen source, using the same GATAAG sites as Gln3 (8636059).
GAT1 の発現は NCR を受け、一部 Gln3 に依存し、上流に Gln3: GAT1 expression is subject to NCR, partly depends on Gln3, and has Gln3-binding sites upstream (8622686). GAT1 expression depends on Gln3 and is regulated by Dal80 (9171383). GAT1 transcription is subject to NCR and activated by Gln3 and Gat1. It is higher on proline than on glutamine (24324255).
GCD5 は KRS1 と同じ遺伝子。gcd5-1 で GCN4 の翻訳が上がり: GCD5 is the same gene as KRS1. gcd5-1 increases GCN4 translation, and GCN4 promotes GCD5 transcription (1505029).
GCN2 の Ser577 のリン酸化が栄養が豊富なときに GCN2 を抑える。: Phosphorylation of GCN2 Ser577 inhibits GCN2 when nutrients are abundant. Rapamycin inhibits the TOR pathway, causing Ser577 dephosphorylation and GCN2 activation (TAP42 is involved).
GCN2 は eIF2α の Ser51 を in vitro・in vivo: GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2α Ser51 in vitro and in vivo (increased by amino acid starvation).
GCN3 はアミノ酸飢餓での GCN4 の発現上昇に要る正の制御因子で、GCN1: GCN3 is a positive regulator required for increased GCN4 expression under amino acid starvation and acts downstream of GCN1 and GCN2 (2249755).
GCN4 がないと ASN1・ASN2 の発現が数倍下がる（8951815）: Without GCN4, ASN1 and ASN2 expression decreases several-fold (8951815).
GCN4 は PHM8 プロモーターの認識配列に直接結合し、その配列の変異や G: GCN4 binds directly to a recognition sequence in the PHM8 promoter, and mutation of that sequence or GCN4 deletion increases PHM8 expression (26979516).
GCN4 は TRP4 プロモーターに結合し、UAS1 が GCN4 依存の活性: GCN4 binds the TRP4 promoter, and UAS1 is the main site of GCN4-dependent activation (2656261).
GCR1 の発現は gcr1・gcr2 の欠失で下がり、Gcr1p–Gcr2p: GCR1 expression decreases in gcr1 and gcr2 deletions and depends on the Gcr1p–Gcr2p complex (15789351).
GCV2 プロモーターのレポーターを欠失株の一式で調べ、グリシンによる活性化に: A GCV2 promoter reporter was examined across a deletion collection; activation by glycine requires BAS1 and others, and repression in the absence of glycine requires only SHM2 (15948949).
GCV3 は Lat1 と Kgd2 のリポイル化に絶対に必要で、リポイル化され: GCV3 is absolutely required for lipoylation of Lat1 and Kgd2, and lipoylated Gcv3 carries out this function (19570983).
GCV3 は Lat1 と Kgd2 のリポイル化に絶対に必要（19570983: GCV3 is absolutely required for lipoylation of Lat1 and Kgd2 (19570983).
GCY1 プロモーターの Reb1 結合部位は基礎発現を約 3 倍上げ、Gal4: The Reb1-binding site in the GCY1 promoter increases basal expression about 3-fold and does not affect activation by Gal4 (9435793).
GDH1 の十分な発現に HAP 複合体が要る。hap 変異で GDH1-lac: Full GDH1 expression requires the HAP complex. hap mutations greatly reduce GDH1-lacZ expression, and the growth defects of hap2 and hap3 mutants are corrected by GDH1 overexpression (8606156).
GDH2 の発現には Gln3 が必要（8416910）。大腸菌で作った Gln: GDH2 expression requires Gln3 (8416910). Gln3 produced in E. coli binds specifically to promoter fragments of NCR genes such as GDH2 (8655543).
GDH3 の発現は Gln3 に制御され、完全な脱抑制は炭素源により SAGA・: GDH3 expression is regulated by Gln3, and full derepression is determined by SAGA and SWI/SNF depending on the carbon source (15948967).
GDI で膜の Ypt1 を外すと膜に結合する Uso1 が減り、膜の Ypt1: Extracting membrane Ypt1 with GDI reduces membrane-bound Uso1, correlating with the amount of membrane Ypt1 (9545229).
GFD1 は rat8-2(dbp5) の多コピー抑圧遺伝子で、Gfd1 は D: GFD1 is a multicopy suppressor of rat8-2 (dbp5), and Gfd1 physically binds both Dbp5 and Nab2-N. Gfd1/Nab2 binding is important for Dbp5 activity (20463024).
GGTase-II の触媒サブユニット Bet2 の変異は Ypt1 と Sec: Mutations in Bet2, the catalytic subunit of GGTase-II, disrupt membrane association of Ypt1 and Sec4 and block membrane trafficking (8183917).
GGTase-II の触媒サブユニット Bet2p/Mad2p の変異は Ypt: Mutations in Bet2p/Mad2p, the catalytic subunit of GGTase-II, disrupt membrane association of Ypt1p and Sec4p and block membrane trafficking (8183917). The GGTase-II α subunit is BET4 and the β subunit is BET2; Rab prenylation is required for membrane association and subsequent function. Recombinant GGTase-II geranylgeranylates the two C-terminal cysteines of Ypt1 (8756702).
GID E3 の別の基質受容体 Gid10 は温度・浸透圧・栄養の変化で誘導され: Gid10, an alternative substrate receptor of the GID E3, is induced by changes in temperature, osmolarity, and nutrients. Without GID10, Art2 levels increase, and Gid10 directs the GID E3 to ubiquitinate Art2. GID affects amino acid transport (35437932). Full text: under heat shock, Art2 increases without Gid10, and Gid10 overexpression decreases Art2.
GID の Gid4 サブユニットがグルコースに戻したとき Fbp1・Icl1・: The Gid4 subunit of GID targets Fbp1, Icl1, and Mdh2 for degradation upon return to glucose (28126757).
GIM1-5 は tub4-1 との合成致死で得られ、共免疫沈降で複合体を作る。: GIM1–5 were obtained as synthetic lethal with tub4-1 and form a complex by co-immunoprecipitation. Gims are important for Tub4 function and bind overexpressed Tub4 (9463374).
GIM1/YKE2・GIM2/PAC10 などの Gim タンパク質は共沈降とゲ: Gim proteins such as GIM1/YKE2 and GIM2/PAC10 are in a common complex by co-precipitation and gel filtration (9463374).
GIM1/YKE2・GIM2/PAC10・GIM3・GIM4・GIM5 の産物は: The products of GIM1/YKE2, GIM2/PAC10, GIM3, GIM4, and GIM5 are in a common complex by co-precipitation and gel filtration (9463374).
The products of GIM1/YKE2, GIM2/PAC10, GIM3, GIM4, and GIM5 are in a common complex (9463374).
GIM3 を含む Gim タンパク質は共通の複合体にあり、Tub4 の働きに重要: Gim proteins including GIM3 are in a common complex, are important for Tub4 function, and bind overexpressed Tub4 (9463374).
GINS は Sld5・Psf1・Psf2・Psf3 からなる新しい複製の複合体: GINS is a new replication complex of Sld5, Psf1, Psf2, and Psf3 that first binds replication origins in S phase (12730134).
GINS は Sld5・Psf1・Psf2・Psf3 からなる新しい複製複合体（: GINS is a new replication complex of Sld5, Psf1, Psf2, and Psf3 (12730134).
GINS は Sld5・Psf1・Psf2・Psf3 からなる複製複合体で、S: GINS is a replication complex of Sld5, Psf1, Psf2, and Psf3 that first binds replication origins in S phase (12730134).
GIS1 を欠くと、栄養の制限での SSA3・HSP12・HSP26 の転写の脱: Without GIS1, derepression of SSA3, HSP12, and HSP26 transcription under nutrient limitation is defective. Expression from PDS elements depends almost entirely on Gis1 (10835355).
GLN1・SHM2・MTD1 の発現はアデニンで抑えられ、Bas1・Bas2 を: Expression of GLN1, SHM2, and MTD1 is repressed by adenine and requires Bas1 and Bas2. Bas1 and Bas2 bind the SHM2 and MTD1 promoters in vitro (9749667).
GLN3 のリン酸化と細胞質保持を SIT4 が打ち消す（10604478）。3: SIT4 counteracts phosphorylation and cytoplasmic retention of GLN3 (10604478). 31213504 reports a non-simple relationship in which Sit4 and PP2A dephosphorylate Gln3 even when nitrogen is sufficient.
GO の向きと一致。Hal3（SIS2）は Ppz1 の触媒ドメインに結合し、試: Consistent with the GO direction. Hal3 (SIS2) binds the catalytic domain of Ppz1 and inhibits Ppz1 phosphatase activity in vitro. Hal3 overexpression suppresses the growth reduction caused by Ppz1 overexpression and mimics ppz1 deletion (9636153).
GO の向きと一致。Rna1 は Gsp1 の GAP で、Gsp1 の GTP: Consistent with the GO direction. Rna1 is the GAP for Gsp1 and increases Gsp1 GTPase activity 10^7-fold (7744835). The C-terminal acidic region is required for binding Ran-GTP and for GAP activity (9305944). In vitro biochemistry.
GO の向きと一致。SHC1 は胞子形成でだけ発現し、胞子壁のキトサン層の合成に: Consistent with the GO direction. SHC1 is expressed only during sporulation and is required for synthesis of the chitosan layer of the spore wall. When overexpressed, it acts in place of Chs4 as an activator of CSIII activity. CHS4 and SHC1 are redundant in regulating CSIII activity (11918806).
GO の向きと一致。Sac7 は Rho1 の GAP で、SAC7 の欠失は: Consistent with the GO direction. Sac7 is a Rho1 GAP, and SAC7 deletion suppresses tor2 mutations. TOR2 signals to the actin cytoskeleton through a GTPase switch composed of ROM2, RHO1, and SAC7 (9038344).
GO の向きと一致。Sed4 の細胞質ドメインはヌクレオチドのない Sar1 に: Consistent with the GO direction. The cytoplasmic domain of Sed4 binds nucleotide-free Sar1, enhances both the intrinsic and Sec23-accelerated GTPase activity of Sar1, and accelerates dissociation of coat proteins from membranes. It does not act on cargo-bound Sar1 (21291503). In vitro.
GO の向きと一致。Sic1 は Cdc28/Clb の活性を抑えて S 期の早: Consistent with the GO direction. Sic1 inhibits Cdc28/Clb activity to prevent premature S-phase onset, and the minimal region required for inhibition in vivo is the C-terminal 70 amino acids (10503536). p40 (Sic1) binds Cdc28 tightly and inhibits its kinase activity (8421781). The cyclin is described only as Clb, without specification.
GO の向きと一致。Sls1（Sil1）は ADP 型 Kar2 に結合し、Se: Consistent with the GO direction. Sls1 (Sil1) binds ADP-bound Kar2 and promotes Sec63-mediated activation of the Kar2 ATPase (10958688). The ATPase activity of Kar2 is enhanced by two nucleotide exchange factors, Sil1 and Lhs1, and point mutations in the IIB region block only Sil1-mediated activation (20430899).
GO の向きと一致。Spp2 は Prp2 の RNA 依存の ATPase 活: Consistent with the GO direction. Spp2 enhances the RNA-dependent ATPase activity of Prp2 and couples Prp2 ATP hydrolysis to spliceosome remodeling (Bact to B*). Without Spp2, hydrolysis occurs but remodeling does not (25561498). Purified system.
GO の向きと一致。Srs2 と Mus81-Mms4 は試験管内と体内で結合し: Consistent with the GO direction. Srs2 and Mus81-Mms4 bind in vitro and in vivo, and Srs2 directly enhances Mus81-Mms4 nuclease activity independently of its helicase activity, aiding cleavage by removing Rad51. Conversely, Mus81-Mms4 inhibits Srs2 helicase activity (25765656).
GO の向きと一致。Stm1 はリボソームタンパク質遺伝子の転写活性化因子 If: Consistent with the GO direction. Stm1 activates Ifh1, the transcriptional activator of ribosomal protein genes. It binds Ifh1 directly in the nucleolus via its C-terminal intrinsically disordered region, and phosphorylation of this region under nutrient starvation disrupts binding to Ifh1 (40315826).
GO の向きと一致。TRAPPII 特有の Trs120 と Trs130 は、: Consistent with the GO direction. The TRAPPII-specific subunits Trs120 and Trs130 are required to switch the GEF specificity of TRAPP from Ypt1 to Ypt31. trs130ts has opposite effects on the localization of the two GTPases (17041589).
GO の向きと一致。Utp14 は Dhr1 と複合体をつくり試験管内でその巻き: Consistent with the GO direction. Utp14 forms a complex with Dhr1 and enhances its unwinding activity in vitro. utp14 mutants with weakened Dhr1 binding mimic helicase-inactive dhr1 and stimulate it less (26729466).
GO の向きと一致。Vta1 は体内と試験管内で Vps4 の正の調節因子で、V: Consistent with the GO direction. Vta1 is a positive regulator of Vps4 in vivo and in vitro, promoting Vps4 assembly via its VSL region and enhancing ATPase activity (16505166). Vta1 increases Vps4 ATPase activity 6- to 8-fold (16601096).
GO の向きと一致。ZNG1 の欠失で Map1 の働きが損なわれ亜鉛欠乏で増殖: Consistent with the GO direction. ZNG1 deletion impairs Map1 function and reduces growth under zinc deficiency. In vitro, Zng1 delivers Zn2+ to apo-Map1 in a GTP hydrolysis-dependent manner (35584675).
GO の向きと一致。chs4（SKT5）欠失で細胞壁のキチンと CSIII 活性: Consistent with the GO direction. Deletion of chs4 (SKT5) greatly reduces cell wall chitin and CSIII activity and lowers Vmax. Chs4 regulates CSIII activity post-translationally, not at the level of CHS3 transcription or translation (9234668).
GO の向きと一致。eIF4G は eIF4A に二か所で結合して構造を導き、律: Consistent with the GO direction. eIF4G binds eIF4A at two sites, guides its conformation, accelerates rate-limiting phosphate release, and enhances activity (21062831). eIF4B and eIF4G cooperatively enhance eIF4A ATP hydrolysis and RNA unwinding (24080224). eIF4G W579A, which weakens eIF4A binding, is temperature-sensitive (18606994).
GO の向きと一致。tsc3 欠失細胞はセリンパルミトイル転移酵素の活性が大きく: Consistent with the GO direction. tsc3 deletion cells have greatly reduced serine palmitoyltransferase activity, and their temperature sensitivity is rescued by sphingoid bases. Tsc3 co-precipitates with Lcb1/Lcb2 (10713067).
GO の向きと一致。エネルギーが限られると Snf1 が GEF として Arf: Consistent with the GO direction. When energy is limited, Snf1 activates Arf3 as a GEF. This is independent of the kinase domain; a C-terminal hydrophobic helix in the regulatory domain acts as a non-canonical GEF (26198097).
GO の向きと一致。減数分裂特有の Spo13 は Cdc5 に結合し、減数第一: Consistent with the GO direction. The meiosis-specific Spo13 binds Cdc5 and promotes phosphorylation of substrates (with variant Polo motifs) in meiosis I, remodeling the phosphorylation landscape (38413836). Phosphoproteomic analysis.
GO-CAM の向きと一致。Rqc1 と Ltn1 は Cdc48 を 60S: Consistent with the GO-CAM direction. Rqc1 and Ltn1 are essential for recruiting Cdc48 to 60S particles (23479637). Without Rqc1, Cdc48 recruitment is insufficient and aberrant proteins with CAT tails aggregate (27129255).
GO-CAM の向きと一致。Rqt4 と Cue3 は uS10 の K63 ユ: Consistent with the GO-CAM direction. Rqt4 and Cue3 bind K63 ubiquitin chains on uS10 and accelerate recruitment of the RQT complex (whose helicase is Slh1) to collided ribosomes. Their deletion abolishes RQT-mediated ribosome dissociation (36627279). This is a relation within a complex, so confidence is medium.
GOT1 は yip1-2 の多コピー抑圧因子として得られ、COPII 小胞に取: GOT1 was obtained as a multicopy suppressor of yip1-2; it is packaged into COPII vesicles and cycles between the ER and Golgi (19383723).
GO・UniProt の向きと一致。精製 Vps9 は GDP 型 Vps21: Consistent with the GO and UniProt directions. Purified Vps9 binds GDP-bound Vps21 and dose-dependently promotes GDP release and GTP binding, but not GTP hydrolysis (10329739).
GO・UniProt の向きと一致。精製タンパク質で Sml1 は酵母 RNR: Consistent with the GO and UniProt directions. With purified proteins, Sml1 is a strong inhibitor of yeast RNR and binds Rnr1 at 1:1 (10593972). Inhibition is of the mixed type and depends on the allosteric state (27155231).
GPCR の Gpr1 は Gpa2 と結合し、グルコースによる cAMP 合成: The GPCR Gpr1 binds Gpa2 and is required for glucose-induced cAMP synthesis. Constitutively active Gpa2 compensates for gpr1 deletion.
GPI を加えると Aly1 か Aly2 のどちらかが Git1 の液胞への輸: When GPI is added, either Aly1 or Aly2 promotes vacuolar trafficking of Git1 (34562280).
GPI トランスアミダーゼ複合体は Gaa1・Gpi8・Gpi16 からなり、G: The GPI transamidase complex consists of Gaa1, Gpi8, and Gpi16, and removing either Gpi8 or Gpi16 destabilizes the other (11598210).
GPI1 の破壊で GPI アンカーに依存する Gas1 の成熟が温度感受性に欠: Disruption of GPI1 causes a temperature-sensitive defect in maturation of the GPI-anchored Gas1 (8910381).
GPX2 は CaCl2 でカルシニューリン/Crz1 依存に誘導され、プロモー: GPX2 is induced by CaCl2 in a calcineurin/Crz1-dependent manner, and its promoter has a response element (15225652).
GRE1・GRE3 は Msn2・Msn4 で正に制御される（10407268）: GRE1 and GRE3 are positively regulated by Msn2 and Msn4 (10407268).
GRE1・GRE3 は cAMP-PKA 経路で負に、Msn2・Msn4 で正に: GRE1 and GRE3 are negatively regulated by the cAMP-PKA pathway and positively by Msn2 and Msn4 (10407268).
GRE2 など Sko1 の標的 5 つは酸化ストレスで誘導され、その誘導に Y: Five Sko1 targets, including GRE2, are induced by oxidative stress, and Yap1 is involved in this induction (11401713).
GRX6 の発現はカルシウム・ナトリウム・過酸化物で少し上がり、Crz1–カルシ: GRX6 expression increases slightly with calcium, sodium, and peroxide and depends on the Crz1–calcineurin pathway (18503006).
GSE 複合体は Gap1 を後期エンドソームから細胞膜へ送るのに要る。Gtr2: The GSE complex is required to deliver Gap1 from late endosomes to the plasma membrane. Gtr2 binds the C-terminal cytoplasmic region of Gap1, and a tyrosine-containing sequence there is required for both Gtr2 binding and sorting to the plasma membrane (16732272).
GSK-3 の Mck1 は自己リン酸化した形で PKA の触媒サブユニット T: The GSK-3 Mck1, in its autophosphorylated form, binds the PKA catalytic subunit Tpk1 and inhibits it directly without phosphorylating it (11877433).
GSK-3 の仲間 Mck1 は Cdc6 の分解に必要で、mck1Δ では C: The GSK-3 family member Mck1 is required for Cdc6 degradation; in mck1Δ, Cdc6 is stabilized, remains nuclear in late S phase and mitosis, and re-replication occurs. Mck1 overexpression causes Cdc6 degradation in a T368- and SCF-Cdc4-dependent manner (23236290). After CDK priming, Mck1 directly phosphorylates GSK-3 sites at the Cdc6 C terminus, creating a Cdc4-binding site for degradation in mitosis. This degradation is enhanced by MMS-induced DNA damage (25995377).
GSM1 はグルコース抑制を受け、グルコース脱抑制の条件で CCAAT 配列を介: GSM1 is subject to glucose repression and, under glucose-derepressing conditions, is expressed in a Hap2/3/4/5-dependent manner via a CCAAT sequence (39336719).
GST-Pyk1 と GST-Pyk2 はウシ PKA 触媒サブユニットと酵母: GST-Pyk1 and GST-Pyk2 are phosphorylated in vitro by the bovine PKA catalytic subunit and yeast HA-Tpk1. They are also phosphorylated in vivo in a PKA-dependent manner (12063246).
GST-Rrn11p は Rrn6p・Rrn7p に強く結合する。CF は Rr: GST-Rrn11p binds Rrn6p and Rrn7p strongly. CF consists of Rrn6p, Rrn7p, and Rrn11p (8702872).
GST-Rrn7p は Rrn6p・Rrn11p に強く結合する（8702872: GST-Rrn7p binds Rrn6p and Rrn11p strongly (8702872).
GST-Vma10 は無細胞系で発現させた Vma4 と強く結合する（15751: GST-Vma10 binds strongly to Vma4 expressed in a cell-free system (15751969).
GSY1 の発現は Rox1 で抑えられる（12697770）: GSY1 expression is repressed by Rox1 (12697770).
GSY1 の発現はグルコースに応じる Mig1 と酸素に応じる Rox1 で抑え: GSY1 expression is repressed by the glucose-responsive Mig1 and the oxygen-responsive Rox1 (12697770).
GTP 型 Rho1 が Pkc1 と結合し、Pkc1 をホスファチジルセリンで: GTP-bound Rho1 binds Pkc1 and allows Pkc1 to be activated by phosphatidylserine.
GTP 型の Gtr1 と GDP 型の Gtr2 のヘテロ二量体が TORC1: The heterodimer of GTP-bound Gtr1 and GDP-bound Gtr2 is the form that activates TORC1 (23716719). The function of Gtr2 alone has not been shown.
GTS1 誘導で Tup1-Cyc8 抑制遺伝子が上がる。Cyc8 が Gts1: GTS1 induction upregulates Tup1-Cyc8-repressed genes. Cyc8 is detected in Gts1 aggregates, and Gts1 inhibits Cyc8 function (21512249).
Gab1 と Gpi17 は小胞体にあり、生体内で同じ複合体に入る（150753: Gab1 and Gpi17 are in the ER and are part of the same complex in vivo (15075373).
Gal11 は基礎転写の一般的な活性化因子で、その働きは Sin4 に抑えられる: Gal11 is a general activator of basal transcription, and its function is inhibited by Sin4 (12715155).
Gal11 は領域 A で TFIIE の小サブユニット Tfa2 と結合する（: Gal11 binds Tfa2, the small subunit of TFIIE, via region A (9545282).
Gal11 は領域 A で Tfa2、領域 B で Tfa1 と結合する。領域: Gal11 binds Tfa2 via region A and Tfa1 via region B. Binding of region B to Tfa1 is required for stimulation of CTD phosphorylation by TFIIH (9545282).
Gal2 の減少の必須の段階は Ubc1・Ubc4・Ubc5 と Npi1/Rs: The essential step in Gal2 downregulation is ubiquitination by Ubc1, Ubc4, Ubc5, and Npi1/Rsp5, and monoubiquitination suffices for internalization (11325936). It is ubiquitinated on its N-terminal tail, and Bul1 and Rod1 appear to be Rsp5 adaptors (33791789).
Gal4 と結合できない Tra1 変異体はプロモーターに呼び込まれず、Gal4: Tra1 mutants unable to bind Gal4 are not recruited to promoters and cannot support Gal4-driven transcription (22308403).
Gal4 の S699 のリン酸化はガラクトースでの効率のよい転写に要り、この部: Phosphorylation of Gal4 S699 is required for efficient transcription on galactose; this site depends on Srb10 (Ssn3) in vivo, and purified Srb10/Srb11 phosphorylates it in vitro. The S699 mutation and srb10 show an epistatic relationship for GAL induction (10360183).
Gal83 は Sip4 と結合し（two-hybrid・試験管内）、グルコース: Gal83 binds Sip4 (two-hybrid, in vitro) and aids rapid Snf1-mediated phosphorylation and activation of Sip4 under glucose limitation.
Gat1 はラパマイシンで TOR を止めたときにだけ核に移る（16253991: Gat1 moves to the nucleus only when TOR is inhibited with rapamycin (16253991). On glutamine, Gln3 and Gat1 are cytoplasmic and move to the nucleus upon rapamycin addition. Gat1 localization does not change greatly with URE2 deletion, and its rapamycin-induced nuclear entry does not strongly depend on Sit4 (18245087).
Gat1-Myc13 の ChIP で AVT4 のプロモーターへの結合を示し、: ChIP of Gat1-Myc13 showed binding to the AVT4 promoter, and AVT6 was also found to be a direct target of GATA factors (33624780).
GatFAB 複合体で Gtf1p はサブユニット F で、Pet112p（B）: In the GatFAB complex, Gtf1p is subunit F and links Pet112p (B) and Her2p (A) (23850602).
Gbp2 と Hrb1 はスプライシング完了後に Mex67 を呼び込み、品質管: Gbp2 and Hrb1 recruit Mex67 after splicing is completed, enabling nuclear export of quality-controlled mRNAs (24452287).
Gbp2 の核への取り込みは受容体 Mtr10 と SR タンパク質キナーゼ S: Nuclear import of Gbp2 depends on the receptor Mtr10 and the SR protein kinase Sky1; loss of these genes or disruption of two of its RS sequences relocates Gbp2 to the cytoplasm (12634846). Sky1 binds Gbp2 via its docking groove and phosphorylates three serines in consecutive RS repeats (17517895, in vitro).
Gcd10 と Gcd14 は核に多い 1 つの複合体のサブユニットで、開始 t: Gcd10 and Gcd14 are subunits of a single, mainly nuclear complex required for m1A modification and maturation of initiator tRNA (9851972).
Gcd10・Gcd14 は翻訳開始と GCN4 mRNA の翻訳抑制に必要（98: Gcd10 and Gcd14 are required for translation initiation and for translational repression of GCN4 mRNA (9851972).
Gcd11 は Cdc123 と結合する相手で、その量は Cdc123・Chf1: Gcd11 is a binding partner of Cdc123, and its levels are controlled by Cdc123, Chf1, and Chf2. Loss of cdc123 function reduces Gcd11 (15319434).
Gcd1・Gcd2 は飢餓でないときに uORF による GCN4 の翻訳の抑制: Gcd1 and Gcd2 are negative regulators required for uORF-mediated repression of GCN4 translation in non-starved cells and, together with Gcn3, form the eIF2B complex (2038327, 2668117).
Gcd1 and Gcd2 are negative regulators required for uORF-mediated repression of GCN4 translation in non-starved cells and, together with Gcn3, form the eIF2B complex (2038327).
Gcn1 の 1060-1777 残基は Rps10A と two-hybrid: Residues 1060–1777 of Gcn1 interact with Rps10A by two-hybrid and co-precipitate with Rps10A and Rps10B in vitro in an RNA-independent manner (25437641).
Gcn1-Gcn20 複合体は Gcn2 を活性化し、Gcn2 は Gcn20: The Gcn1-Gcn20 complex activates Gcn2, and Gcn2 phosphorylates Gcn20, preventing formation of this complex (33743194).
Gcn2 と Gcn4 は NCR に感受性の Gln3 の核移行に要り、Gcn: Gcn2 and Gcn4 are required for nuclear translocation of NCR-sensitive Gln3, and Gcn2 appears to act upstream of Ure2. Bmh1/2 are also required for Gln3 nuclear translocation and appear to act downstream of Ure2. Without them, Gln3 phosphorylation decreases (28007891, genetic results).
Gcn2 はアミノ酸飢餓で eIF2α をリン酸化して GCN4 の翻訳を上げる: Gcn2 phosphorylates eIF2α under amino acid starvation and increases GCN4 translation. GCN2c mutations derepress GCN4 without starvation, and this effect depends on the eIF2α phosphorylation site (1448107). Rapamycin also activates Gcn2, increasing eIF2α-P and translationally derepressing GCN4 (12676950).
Gcn4 がないと ASN2 の発現が数倍下がる（8951815）: Without Gcn4, ASN2 expression decreases several-fold (8951815).
Gcn4 によらない基底の HIS7 転写に必須な d(CT) リピートに結合す: The factor binding the d(CT) repeat essential for Gcn4-independent basal HIS7 transcription was identified as Abf1 (9349705).
Gcn4 の分解（SCF-Cdc4 によるユビキチン化）には Pho85 による: Degradation of Gcn4 (ubiquitination by SCF-Cdc4) requires Pho85-mediated phosphorylation of specific sites. Mutating those sites stabilizes Gcn4.
Gcn4 は CRE(HAL1) に結合し、HAL1 の発現の上昇に必要（111: Gcn4 binds CRE(HAL1) and is required for increased HAL1 expression (11113177).
Gcn4 は Mediator の尾部の Gal11/Med15 に直接結合し、: Gcn4 binds the Mediator tail subunit Gal11/Med15 directly and uses three N-terminal parts of Gal11 (KIX, B-box, and others) to recruit Mediator to the ARG1 promoter in vivo (19940160). Consistent with the GO direction.
Gcn4 は富栄養の培地で速く分解され、それには E2 の Cdc34 と組む: Gcn4 is rapidly degraded in rich medium, which requires SCF-Cdc4 together with the E2 Cdc34. Degradation requires Pho85-mediated phosphorylation (10712509).
Gcn4 は速く分解され、その分解はアミノ酸飢餓で止まる。分解はユビキチン経路を: Gcn4 is rapidly degraded, and degradation stops under amino acid starvation. Degradation proceeds through the ubiquitin pathway and depends on two E2s, Cdc34 and Rad6. Purified Cdc34 and Rad6 specifically ubiquitinate Gcn4 in vitro (7813440).
Gcn5 と Elp3 は H3 のアセチル化を通して SSA3・SSA4 の転: Gcn5 and Elp3 regulate SSA3 and SSA4 transcription through H3 acetylation. Elp3 acts mainly on Pol II elongation (17910533).
Gcn5 の HAT 活性は標的遺伝子の転写活性化に体内で必須で、触媒ドメインの: Gcn5 HAT activity is essential in vivo for transcriptional activation of target genes, and point mutations in the catalytic domain abolish both histone acetylation at promoters and Gcn5-mediated activation (9499399). Derepression of FLO1 involves H3K14 acetylation dependent on Sas3 and Ada2(Gcn5); without it, transcription (elongation) decreases (28115623). BioGRID's 8805705 and others concern in vitro site specificity.
Gcn5 は Snf1 と Spt3 に調節される。Gcn5 の TSTY（T2: Gcn5 is regulated by Snf1 and Spt3. Mutations in Gcn5 TSTY (T203, S204, T211, Y212), like snf1 deficiency, cause Gcn5 hypophosphorylation, hypoacetylation at the HIS3 promoter, and defective HIS3 transcription. Snf1 overexpression suppresses these mutations (19841091). In 16287868, Snf1 phosphorylates Gcn5 in vitro.
Gcn5 を含む複合体は SWI/SNF の Snf2 を試験管内と体内で直接ア: Gcn5-containing complexes directly acetylate the SWI/SNF subunit Snf2 in vitro and in vivo; acetylation promotes dissociation of SWI/SNF from acetylated histones and reduces its promoter binding in vivo (21159817).
Gcn5（SAGA）の欠失はバルプロ酸・ラパマイシン処理での Sae2 の分解を: Deletion of Gcn5 (SAGA) counteracts Sae2 degradation under valproic acid and rapamycin treatment. Gcn5 is proposed to promote Sae2 degradation and indirectly weaken ATR signaling (21368826, full text).
Gcs1 と Age2 は TGN 輸送に重複して必須の ArfGAP の組（1: Gcs1 and Age2 are a pair of ArfGAPs redundantly essential for TGN transport (11756474). Full text: recombinant Age2 promotes hydrolysis of GTP bound to recombinant Arf1.
Gcs1 は Arf1・Arf2 の GTPase 活性を試験管内で促進する A: Gcs1 is an ARF GAP that stimulates the GTPase activity of Arf1 and Arf2 in vitro. It functions redundantly with Glo3 (9927415).
Gcs1 は試験管内で Arl1・Arf1 に GAP 活性を示し、GTP 依存: Gcs1 shows GAP activity toward Arl1 and Arf1 in vitro and binds Arl1 in a GTP-dependent manner (15975906).
Gds1 は NuA4 と共沈し、GDS1 欠失で生体内の H4 アセチル化が減: Gds1 co-precipitates with NuA4, and GDS1 deletion reduces H4 acetylation in vivo (34694912).
Gdt1（ゴルジの H+/Ca2+ 交換輸送体）の働きはカルシニューリンと Er: The function of Gdt1 (the Golgi H+/Ca2+ exchanger) is negatively regulated by calcineurin and Erd1 (29042410).
Gea1 は ARF への交換活性をもつ複合体の成分で、その活性はブレフェルジン: Gea1 is a component of a complex with exchange activity toward ARF; this activity is brefeldin A-sensitive, and Gea1 is required for ER–Golgi transport in vivo (8945477).
Gea2 の Drs2 C 末端への結合が TGN 膜標品でフリップ活性を上げる: Binding of Gea2 to the Drs2 C terminus increases flippase activity in TGN membrane preparations (19898464). Mutual binding of Arl1, Drs2, and Gea2 is essential for flippase activity (23345439).
Get1 と Get2 の細胞質ドメインが複合体を作ると Get3•TA への親: When the cytoplasmic domains of Get1 and Get2 form a complex, their affinity for Get3•TA rises greatly (34614151).
Get1 と Get2 の細胞質側領域が組むと、それぞれの Get3・TA への: When the cytoplasmic regions of Get1 and Get2 associate, their respective affinities for Get3 and TA rise strongly (34614151).
Get1 の細胞質ドメインは Get3 の構造を変え、Get1 と Get2 の: The cytoplasmic domain of Get1 changes the conformation of Get3, and both Get1 and Get2 are required for release of TA from Get3 (34614151).
Get2 の細胞質側領域の MoRF が Get3 を開かせ、Get3 からの: The MoRF in the cytoplasmic region of Get2 opens Get3, and both Get1 and Get2 are required for release of TA from Get3. MoRF mutations reduce TA insertion in vivo (34614151).
Get3-Get4-Get5 複合体の結晶構造から、Get4 が Get3 を基: The crystal structure of the Get3-Get4-Get5 complex shows that Get4 sets Get3 in a conformation optimal for substrate capture (24727835).
Get4/5 はリボソームに直接結合し、Sgt2 をトンネル出口の近くに置いて: Get4/5 bind ribosomes directly and position Sgt2 near the tunnel exit to aid capture of TA proteins (33542241).
Gex1 の発現は鉄欠乏で誘導され、主に鉄に応答する転写因子 Aft2 に依存（: Gex1 expression is induced by iron deficiency and depends mainly on the iron-responsive transcription factor Aft2 (21490148).
Gfa1 は Isr1 に依存してリン酸化され、その部位の変異で ISR1 過剰: Gfa1 is phosphorylated in an Isr1-dependent manner, and mutation of those sites alleviates the lethality of ISR1 overexpression (32579556).
Gga2-VHS に結合できない Pik1 の変異で、Pik1 の TGN への: Pik1 mutants unable to bind Gga2-VHS show reduced TGN localization of Pik1 and delayed PI4P accumulation and AP-1 recruitment (28289207).
Gic1 は Bub2 に直接結合して Tem1 の Bub2 への結合を妨げる: Gic1 binds Bub2 directly and prevents Tem1 binding to Bub2. The mitotic exit defect of cdc5-10 lte1Δ gic1Δ gic2Δ is rescued by inactivation of Bfa1-Bub2. Gic1 function depends on activation by Cdc42 and on its release from the bud cortex.
Gic1 は CRIB で GTP 型 Cdc42 に結合し、Cdc42 の経路: Gic1 binds GTP-bound Cdc42 via its CRIB and acts positively in the Cdc42 pathway. Binding to Cdc42 is important for Gic1 function but not required for its localization (9367979).
Gic1・Gic2 は CRIB を持ち GTP 型 Cdc42 に結合する。C: Gic1 and Gic2 have CRIB domains and bind GTP-bound Cdc42. CRIB mutations in Gic2 that prevent Cdc42 binding abolish Gic2 localization and function (9367980).
Gic2 は Bud6 と共分画し、共免疫沈降と two-hybrid で結合す: Gic2 co-fractionates with Bud6 and binds it by co-immunoprecipitation and two-hybrid. Localization of Bni1 and Bud6 to the presumptive bud site depends on active Cdc42 and Gic proteins, and the Gic2 W23A mutation prevents Bud6 assembly.
Gic2 は芽が出た直後にユビキチン依存の分解で消え、この分解には SCF の: Gic2 disappears right after bud emergence by ubiquitin-dependent degradation, which requires the SCF components Cdc34, Cdc53, Skp1, and Grr1 (not Cdc4). C-terminal phosphorylation is the signal, and binding to Cdc42 is a prerequisite for degradation (9736614).
Gid12 は基質受容体 Gid4 を足場に封じ込める広い面を作り、分解シグナル: Gid12 forms a broad surface that locks the substrate receptor Gid4 onto the scaffold, remodels the degron-binding site, and keeps Fbp1 and Mdh2 away from the ubiquitination active site (35650207).
Gid2/Rmd5 の退化した RING ドメインの変異で、体内での Fbp1: Mutations in the degenerate RING domain of Gid2/Rmd5 abolish polyubiquitination and disappearance of Fbp1 in vivo. GST-Gid2 causes polyubiquitination in vitro (18508925).
Gid4 は GID リガーゼの Pro/N 末端則の認識因子で、Pck1 は: Gid4 is the Pro/N-end rule recognition component of the GID ligase, and Pck1 is targeted via its second-position Pro (28126757).
Gim タンパク質は Tub4 の働きに重要で、過剰発現した Tub4 に結合す: Gim proteins are important for Tub4 function and bind overexpressed Tub4 (9463374).
Gin4 が G1 期後半から分裂後期の中ごろまで Gps1（Aim44）を芽の: Gin4 retains Gps1 (Aim44) at the bud neck from late G1 to mid-anaphase, after which Nba1 takes over (28148650).
Gip3 は Glc7 と結合し、過剰発現で Glc7 の局在が変わり、Dam1: Gip3 binds Glc7; its overexpression changes Glc7 localization, restores Dam1 phosphorylation, and arrests wild-type cells in metaphase (16537909).
Gip3・Gip4 の過剰発現で Glc7 の局在が変わり、両者は Glc7 の: Overexpression of Gip3 and Gip4 changes Glc7 localization, and both are thought to be regulatory subunits of Glc7 (16537909).
Gir2 は GI ドメインで Gcn1 に結合する（19448108）: Gir2 binds Gcn1 via its GI domain (19448108).
Gis4 は Grr1 と生体内で結合し、Grr1 依存にユビキチン化される。G: Gis4 binds Grr1 in vivo and is ubiquitinated in a Grr1-dependent manner. Gis4 is stable in both wild type and grr1 deletion (15890364).
Gis4 は Grr1 依存に Snf1 と相互作用し、SUC2 の脱抑制と S: Gis4 interacts with Snf1 in a Grr1-dependent manner and is involved in SUC2 derepression and Snf1-dependent transcription (15890364). Gis4 is genetically and physically linked to Snf1 (17030993).
Glc7 に結合できない Ref2F374A は ref2 の塩の表現型を戻さず: Ref2F374A, which cannot bind Glc7, does not rescue the salt phenotype of ref2, and Ref2's function in cation homeostasis is mediated by Glc7 (20028335).
Glc7 の調節サブユニット Reg1 を欠く細胞では Snf1 の Thr21: In cells lacking Reg1, the regulatory subunit of Glc7, Snf1 Thr210 is constitutively phosphorylated (Reg1-Glc7 inactivates Snf1).
Glc7 を除くと体内でポリ A 尾が短くなり、リン酸化された Pta1 がたま: Removing Glc7 shortens poly(A) tails in vivo and causes phosphorylated Pta1 to accumulate. Extracts lacking Glc7 cannot polyadenylate, which is restored by adding Glc7 or Pta1 but not phosphorylated Pta1. The Glc7 inhibitor protein Ypi1 and the Cka1 kinase block polyadenylation in wild-type extracts (16137619).
Glc7-Bud14 は SPOC の構成要素で、SPOC のエフェクター Bf: Glc7-Bud14 is a component of the SPOC and promotes dephosphorylation of the SPOC effector Bfa1, activating Bfa1 (34633288).
Glc7-Reg1 は生体内で Hxk2 を脱リン酸化する（10428955）。: Glc7-Reg1 dephosphorylates Hxk2 in vivo (10428955). Dephosphorylation of S14 lets Hxk2 enter the nucleus, and phosphorylation (by Snf1) makes it exit (23066030). The effect was classified as promoting its nuclear function (glucose repression) (SNF1 ⊣ HXK2 is already recorded).
Glc7（PP1）は HU による複製の停止のあと、リン酸化した Rad53 を: Glc7 (PP1) eliminates phosphorylated Rad53 after HU-induced replication arrest, promoting recovery. It is also required for recovery from DSB-induced arrest but not with MMS. Glc7 dephosphorylates γH2A (19884341).
Gle1 は Dbp5 の細胞内の活性化因子で、Dbp5 だけでは RNA に安: Gle1 is the cellular activator of Dbp5; Dbp5 alone cannot bind RNA stably and hydrolyzes little ATP, but adding Gle1 greatly stimulates it. gle1 point mutants unable to activate Dbp5 are defective in mRNA export in vivo, and Dbp5 activation is the essential function of Gle1. InsP6 enhances stimulation by Gle1 (16783364). Dbp5 mutants with weakened Gle1 binding show weaker ATPase stimulation, and the weakest cannot support growth (19805289).
Gle2 は塩基性の面で pre-60S に、別の面で Nup116 に FG: Gle2 contacts pre-60S via its basic surface and Nup116 via another surface, independently of FG repeats (23907389).
Gln3 のリン酸化と細胞質への保持は TOR の下流の Tap42 に依存し、: Phosphorylation and cytoplasmic retention of Gln3 depend on Tap42 downstream of TOR, and Sit4 antagonizes this (10604478).
Gln3 の核からの搬出には Crm1 が要る（11331291）: Nuclear export of Gln3 requires Crm1 (11331291).
Gln3 の核への取り込みには Srp1（カリオフェリン α）が、核からの搬出に: Nuclear import of Gln3 requires Srp1 (karyopherin α), and nuclear export requires Crm1. Srp1 preferentially binds hypophosphorylated Gln3 (11331291).
Gln4 の枯渇で GCN4 応答が起き、Gcn2 の活性化を示す。Gln4 の: Depletion of Gln4 triggers the GCN4 response, indicating Gcn2 activation. Reduced Gln4 allows uncharged tRNAGln to interact with Gcn2 (32016368).
Glo3 は ARF GAP 活性をもち、Gcs1 と重複して ER-ゴルジ輸送: Glo3 has ARF GAP activity and, redundantly with Gcs1, performs an essential function in ER–Golgi transport (9927415). Glo3 is one of the Arf1 GAPs (16735437).
Glo3 も ARF GAP 活性をもち、Gcs1 と ER-ゴルジ間の輸送で重: Glo3 also has ARF GAP activity and has a redundant essential function with Gcs1 in ER–Golgi transport (9927415).
Glr1 は細胞質とミトコンドリアにあり、TRR2 と GLR1 の両方を欠くと: Glr1 is in the cytoplasm and mitochondria; loss of both TRR2 and GLR1 causes partial oxidation of Trx3, and Glr1 and Trr2 act redundantly in mitochondria (15701801).
Gmh1p は Gea1p・Gea2p と結合し、Gea の保存された領域の変異: Gmh1p binds Gea1p and Gea2p, and Gmh1p overexpression compensates for defects of mutations in the conserved region of Gea (12808035).
Gno1/PINX1 は Prp43 と結合し、G-patch を通して ATP: Gno1/PINX1 binds Prp43 and activates its ATPase via its G-patch. It is required for ribosome formation (24823796).
Gon7 は Pcc1 と安定なヘテロ二量体をつくり、その結晶構造を決定。KEO: Gon7 forms a stable heterodimer with Pcc1, whose crystal structure was determined. KEOPS is a linear pentamer of Gon7-Pcc1-Kae1-Bud32-Cgi121 (25735745).
Gos1 は Sed5 と共沈し、組換えタンパク質で直接結合する（9755865: Gos1 co-precipitates with Sed5 and binds it directly as recombinant proteins (9755865).
Gpa1 は Gβγ の捕捉とは別に順応を促す。Gpa1 や Msg5 の過剰発: Gpa1 promotes adaptation independently of Gβγ sequestration. Overexpression of Gpa1 or Msg5 suppresses nuclear accumulation of Fus3-GFP in stimulated cells, which requires Kap104 (12556475). In pheromone-responding cells, Gα binds the mating MAPK directly and acts in signal regulation and chemotropism (12029138).
Gpa1 は Nmt1 でミリストイル化され、この修飾がないと Gpa1 はフェ: Gpa1 is myristoylated by Nmt1, and without this modification Gpa1 cannot inhibit pheromone signaling (1936988).
Gpa1 はエンドソームで Vps34・Vps15 と直接結合し PI3P の産: Gpa1 binds Vps34 and Vps15 directly at endosomes and increases PI3P production. Vps15 binds GDP-bound Gpa1 (16839886).
Gpa2 のリン酸化は窒素飢餓で大きく増え、GSK に依存する。GSK の働きを: Gpa2 phosphorylation increases greatly under nitrogen starvation and depends on GSK. Inactivating GSK reduces phosphorylation in vivo, and purified Mck1 and Ygk3 phosphorylate Gpa2 in vitro. Phosphorylation increases plasma membrane localization of Gpa2 and promotes PKA activation under nitrogen starvation (31690628). In vivo this reflects the contribution of GSKs as a whole, not Mck1 alone, so confidence is medium.
Gpa2 は GTP 結合型に依存して Ime2 の調節領域と結合し、試験管内で: Gpa2 binds the regulatory region of Ime2 in a GTP-bound-dependent manner, correlating with reduced Ime2 kinase activity in vitro. Co-overexpression of Ime2 and Gpa2 greatly reduces sporulation, showing that Gpa2 inhibits Ime2 function (10454558).
Gpa2 は窒素飢餓でリン酸化が増え、GSK（Mck1・Ygk3）が試験管内でリ: Gpa2 phosphorylation increases under nitrogen starvation, and GSKs (Mck1, Ygk3) phosphorylate it in vitro. Phosphorylation enhances membrane localization and PKA activation (31690628).
Gpb1/2 は Gpa2 を抑えて cAMP の信号を負に調節する。Gpa2: Gpb1/2 inhibit Gpa2 and negatively regulate cAMP signaling. The Gpa2 N terminus binds both Gpb2 and the Gpr1 C terminus, and Gpb1/2 binding prevents coupling of Gpr1 and Gpa2 (16030250).
Gpd1 と Gpd2 は別々のキナーゼのリン酸化で負に調節される。Gpd1 は: Gpd1 and Gpd2 are negatively regulated by phosphorylation by different kinases. Gpd1 is a target of the TORC2-dependent kinases Ypk1 and Ypk2 (22988299).
Gpd2 は栄養が限られるとき AMPK の Snf1 にリン酸化され、グリセロ: Gpd2 is phosphorylated by the AMPK Snf1 when nutrients are limited, suppressing glycerol production (22988299).
Gpi11 欠損でたまる脂質は Gpi7 欠損と似ており、Gpi11 の欠損が: The lipids that accumulate in Gpi11 deficiency resemble those in Gpi7 deficiency, and Gpi11 deficiency affects Gpi7-mediated addition of EthN-P to Man-2 (10793139).
Gpi18 と Pga1 は小胞体にあり、可溶化した膜から共沈する。Pga1 は: Gpi18 and Pga1 are in the ER and co-precipitate from solubilized membranes. Pga1 is an essential component of GPI-MT II (17615295).
